text: ![Home SUR ATLAS The SUR Atlas is an initiative by SUR Lab Bocconi and UN-Habitat designed to discover and investigate international exemplary projects of sustainable urban regeneration. ## Let's start Explore exemplary international sustainable urban regeneration projects and discover innovative approaches to address urban challenges. Whether you're a policy maker, developer, investor, researcher or practitioner, the SUR Atlas is your key source for inspiration and insights. Through the SUR Atlas, you can navigate through a list of regeneration projects and delve into unique aspects such as financing and economic instruments used, engagement methods, and impacts generated, alongside innovative technical and technological solutions. text: ![hero annual Course at Bocconi The Sustainable Urban Regeneration Course provides students with knowledge of sustainable urban regeneration processes. Through the SUR Lab's network of partners, students gain hands-on experience by working with real-world case studies. ![HP Mission We aim to develop and spread knowledge, methods, and best practices on Sustainable Urban Regeneration processes and how they generate value for the private sector and society. ## News and events \\ SUR Lab featured in Il Sole 24 Ore and Radiocor: measuring impacts to steer urban regeneration\\ \\ SUR Lab’s contribution to _Il Sole 24 Ore_ examines impact measurement as a key challenge in urban regeneration. It introduces the SUR Atlas, a repository of over 60 global case studies showing strong environmental, social, and economic outcomes. Tania Molteni highlights the lack of a shared urban-scale framework. The ESG Urban Track, developed within MUSA, is proposed to address this [![Presentazione libro \\ Housing as a right, not a privilege: Book presentation on Italy’s housing crisis\\ \\ On Monday, 13 April, Bocconi University hosted the presentation of _Right or privilege? Housing needs and local housing policies_, a volume exploring Italy’s housing crisis through the lenses of inequality, welfare and local governance. The discussion with the authors and invited discussants highlighted how housing can no longer be treated as a marginal issue, but as a structural dimension of social justice and urban sustainability. The event, organised in collaboration with IFEL and INAPP, offered a timely opportunity to reflect on how fairer and more inclusive cities can be built.](https://surlab.unibocconi.eu/news-events/housing-right-not-privilege-book-presentation-italys-housing-crisis) [![Evento \\ Libreria EGEA \| Viale Bligny 22 \| Milan\\ \\ \\ 13/04/2026, 17:00\\ \- 13/04/2026, 19:00\\ \\ Housing: right or privilege? title: Become a Startup Mentor | B4i Bocconi Milan
text: # **Become a Mentor** Support startups, share your expertise, expand your network **Mentorship** is a key pillar of B4i’s Acceleration and Pre-Acceleration programs. Our Mentors are **professionals** with specific **operational expertise**, a wide **industry network** and a deep **entrepreneurial or managerial experience**. They support startups pro bono, share knowledge and guidance, and open their networks when appropriate. If you’re interested, you can apply through the form at the bottom of the page. ![](https://www.b4i.unibocconi.it/assets/static-assets/0b54891f0f25696317117c68a765aa8d.jpg)b4i-mentor-01 ## A great opportunity for **Bocconi Alumni too** ![](https://www.b4i.unibocconi.it/assets/static-assets/480849278937755e39074ae65a076f4b.jpg)b4i-mentor-02 Our mentorship program is open to candidates with any background, but if you are part of the Bocconi Alumni community, joining the B4i mentoring program is a concrete and exciting way to take an active role in your university community, an opportunity to be more closely involved with your **alma mater** while keeping contact with innovative talents, business and skills from Milan’s startup ecosystem. ![](https://www.b4i.unibocconi.it/assets/static-assets/27516c3f5606450502ab74f2966c3910.jpg)b4-mentor-quote "I am very happy to be a mentor: the B4i programs are fascinating and I am pleased to be in contact with B4i and all these teams (very often very young) with interesting ideas and desire to get involved by launching a startup. They deserve to be supported." **Paolo Pascarelli**, Banker, Corporate & Investment Banking, UniCredit ## **What can you expect from** **becoming** a Mentor - **Providing strategic guidance** to fast-paced growing companies - **Expanding skills and network** by interacting with entrepreneurs and other mentors - **Developing a deep relationship with a group of entrepreneurs** to eventually be part of the team and/or invest in the company - **Giving back** by supporting the Bocconi community and local entrepreneurial scene ## What we look for **in a Mentor** We look for **skilled and motivated professionals** who want to join a dynamic and innovative environment to share their experience and skills to support the startups enrolled in our Acceleration and Pre-Acceleration program. ### Main types of expertise we look for: #### 1. Creating a new product/service - Problem definition and opportunity identification - Customer segmentation and value proposition - Market sizing and competitor analysis - Business model design and revenue/cost structure - Offer & solution validation - MVP design & go to market (GTM) - Marketing, growth hacking & communication #### 2. Building a business - Mission, culture, structure - Legal aspects of building a startup - Setup - Managing relationship among founders - Stock options - Intellectual property, copyrights, trademarks - Staff recruiting and compensation - Operations and product/service management - Financial modelling, startup metrics and traction #### 3. Going to investors - Raising funds: e.g. Venture Capital, angels, grants, crowdfunding, banks (term sheet clauses, cap table, how investors think, etc.) - Pitching and public speaking ## **Become a** Mentor Due to the overwhelming number of requests, we have temporarily stopped accepting applications to become a mentor. You can still join the waiting list: we will contact you as soon as new mentoring opportunities become available. Thank you very much for your interest! The goal is to make this area more functional, productive and patient-centered. ![Health & Life Sciences Knowledge Platform]( ## What it is and why it was started The Brain Health Policy and Management Nexus is a research and training platform created by SDA Bocconi with the non-conditional support of Lundbeck Italia. It aims to consolidate the knowledge and skills needed to address brain health challenges. Neurological and psychiatric diseases, which affect more than 1.5 billion people each year, need solutions based on innovative policies, exchanging of knowledge, and advanced training for professionals. text: # Co-designing the future of organizations At SDA Bocconi, partnerships with organizations are built on a deep understanding of their evolving challenges and long-term objectives. We consider learning not as a stand-alone intervention, but as an integrated lever for strategic transformation. Our multi-level, multi-tool, and multi-content methodology is designed to create learning paths that address the complex needs of people and organizations. #### Multi-Level We structure flexible learning partnerships according to organizational needs. We support the creation and management of in-company corporate schools. Moreover, we organize academies focused on specific targets or content areas. ![SDA Bocconi Custom Programs]( **Custom Corporate Schools** We partner with organizations to co-design comprehensive, tailored training systems aligned with strategic objectives. These programs integrate organization-wide or ecosystem-based learning architectures that foster innovation and alignment across the value chain. Multi-level learning pathways combine knowledge transfer, skill development, and cultural transformation, ensuring strong contextual relevance and practical application. **Target Academies** Target Academies are tailored learning programs designed for specific roles or career stages within an organization. SDA Bocconi covers the co-design process from needs assessment to delivery and follow-up, ensuring alignment with business priorities. Programs typically combine theoretical learning, experiential activities, and the engagement of internal faculty. **Content Academies** Content Academies focus on developing key capabilities across functional or cross-functional areas. Each academy is co-designed with the organization and may include customized learning pathways, blended formats, and experiential activities to ensure practical application. They can be structured as Functional Academies or Cross-functional Academies according to organizational needs. **Single Custom Programs** SDA Bocconi develops fully tailored programs to address specific strategic priorities, business challenges, or skill development needs. Each program follows a structured co-design process, including needs analysis, program design with customized content and methods, delivery by SDA Bocconi faculty and, when appropriate, internal or external experts, and evaluation to ensure measurable impact. #### Multi-Tool Our teaching methodologies combine a variety of formats — from experiential learning to digital solutions — adapting to different contexts, participant profiles, and strategic objectives. Training days are structured to alternate between moments dedicated to deepening concepts, models, tools, and professional methods, and moments of “action learning,” where participants apply their knowledge through individual or group exercises. This blended approach aims to: - Go beyond traditional teaching by leveraging participants’ experiences to identify areas for enrichment and alignment with business priorities and specific role requirements. - Build a common language and a coherent, distinctive approach through discussion, facilitation, and reflection on shared experiences. - Equip participants with tools to reassess their skills and cultivate a habit of self-analysis, enabling learning from their own experience. #### Multi-Content Each program integrates a wide range of topics, skills, and disciplines. We address cross-functional needs, allowing different departments to benefit from content tailored to their specific challenges, combining soft skills with technical expertise. title: Individual Performance Evaluation: Skills and Tools for OIVs | SDA Bocconi
text: # Individual Performance Evaluation: Skills and Tools for OIVs _Start date_ November 2025 _End date_ June 2026 _Location_ Online-Milan _Language_ Italian ![ragazzo che guarda un foglio]( An executive education initiative funded by the **Department of Public Administration** in Italy under the **National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR), Mission 1 – Component 1, Investment 2.2, Sub-investment 2.2.5.** The program is designed as a digital library offering training content and materials specifically developed for members of the **National Register of OIVs (Independent Evaluation Bodies),** with a focus on assessing and measuring individual performance within public sector organizations. What you will find in the digital library - **A structured and logical organization of content** across three progressive levels: 1\. Domains (“library shelves”) – broad thematic areas aligned with the main responsibilities of OIVs in evaluating individual performance. 2\. Topics (“books”) – specific learning units within each domain, focusing on key subjects and competencies. 3\. Sessions (“chapters”) – individual asynchronous video lessons exploring targeted aspects within each topic. - **A variety of learning formats**(video lectures, tests, and supplementary materials) to sustain engagement and accommodate diverse learning styles. - **A personalized learning experience**, including two proficiency levels (basic and advanced) and an initial profiling assessment for each participant. - **Flexible access** through predominantly asynchronous delivery, allowing participants to learn at their own pace, from any location, and according to their professional commitments. **Target audience** The program is intended for professionals enrolled in the **National Register of OIVs**, aiming to strengthen their capabilities to enhance systems for measuring and evaluating individual performance—contributing to a more effective and results-oriented Public Administration Structure and content ## Content overview Video lectures (40 hours) Individual activities Three in-person workshop days ## Program structure The digital library is organized into six domains, reflecting the core responsibilities of OIVs in individual performance evaluation systems: ### 1\. Introduction ### 1\. Introduction ### 2\. Design ### 3\. Evaluation ### 4\. Impact ### 5\. Behaviours ## Admission requirements and enrollment The **only requirement** for participation is registration in the **National Register of OIVs.** Upon enrollment, participant data will be shared with the **Department of Public Administration**, as the data controller, in accordance with Article 15 (page 14) of the governing agreement. Access to the course will be provided through **Bocconi University’s Blackboard platform**, where all training materials will be available. Before receiving your login credentials (username and password), confirmation of your registration in the National Register of OIVs must be issued by the Department of Public Administration. The first three modules will be released in **November 2025**, and the remaining three will be available from **January 2026**. Participation in the course requires active registration in the National Register of OIVs. Note: Upon completion of the program, the Department of Public Administration will grant **training credits** valid for renewing registration in the National OIV Register, in accordance with the provisions of Ministerial Decree of **6 August 2020** and subsequent amendments. text: ![Didattica e apprendimento]( # Didattica e apprendimento ## Il nostro approccio alla ricerca Tutte le attività di ricerca di SDA Bocconi, realizzate attraverso i Lab e gli Osservatori o in seguito a specifiche esigenze dei clienti, sono improntate su rigorose metodologie scientifiche. L’obiettivo principale è offrire al cliente modelli di ricerca didattica che possano trasferire conoscenze pratiche, in grado di ampliare le prospettive e modificare i propri schemi di business. Attraverso la ricerca applicata su aree tematiche omogenee, SDA Bocconi verifica e affina le teorie economico-aziendali producendo una solida base empirica, raccolta in specifiche pubblicazioni, sulla quale orientare scelte e strategie. ### I metodi di ricerca - ![Placeholder]( ###### Analisi quantitative Basandosi sui più moderni modelli di analisi statistica, vengono realizzati report, analisi di mercato, trend di settore e analisi predittive sia di specifiche decisioni aziendali, sia della performance dell’azienda. - ![Placeholder]( ###### Survey Consente di valutare opinioni e trend di più aziende o individui, garantendo un livello di profondità tale da portare a cambiamenti anche radicali nelle strategie e nelle decisioni aziendali; le survey possono essere realizzate su larga scala. - ![Placeholder]( ###### Case Study Estremamente utile per comprendere problematiche o situazioni complesse di una specifica azienda o istituzione. - ![Placeholder]( ###### Analisi sperimentali Per quei fenomeni che richiedano una migliore definizione della relazioni causa-effetto, ci si avvale di metodologie avanzate come l’analisi di scenari e veri e propri esperimenti condotti in azienda su determinati fenomeni o popolazioni di soggetti. - ![Placeholder]( ###### Modelli previsionali Permettono di realizzare previsioni su fenomeni interni o esterni all’azienda e a confrontare ciò che avviene realmente; possono migliorare significativamente la qualità e il risultato delle decisioni aziendali. ![Formazione manageriale su misura]( ## Formazione manageriale su misura SDA Bocconi progetta e realizza programmi personalizzati per organizzazioni pubbliche e private, nazionali e internazionali. [Scopri](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/) ## I metodi formativi Apprendimento frontaleApprendimento EsperienzialeApprendimento On-Field - ![Placeholder]( ###### Lecture in presenza La lecture è una tecnica frontale che consiste nel trasferimento delle conoscenze dal docente al partecipante, in modo partecipato, ma senza prevedere un decisivo livello di attivismo e autonomia nei partecipanti. Nell’executive education, si sostanzia in un momenti brevi, in cui il docente necessita di colmare alcune lacune di contenuti. - ![Placeholder]( ###### Lecture in distance learning La lecture in distance è comunque una tecnica frontale che consiste nel trasferimento delle conoscenze dal docente al partecipante. La lecture in distance può svolgersi in differita, può cioè essere registrata e messa a disposizione dei partecipanti, oppure può in forma ‘blended’ o ‘ibrida’, dove i partecipanti sono comunque presenti mentre la lecture si svolge e hanno opportunità di interagire con il docente e tra loro. Il grado di partecipazione in distance può variare a seconda delle tecnologie scelte a supporto della lecture. - ![Placeholder]( ###### Testimonianze La testimonianza consiste nel racconto di episodi aziendali significativi ed ‘esemplari’ per la loro rilevanza, sia positiva che negativa, da parte di una persona che sia stata protagonista dell’episodio stesso. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/doctorate-in-business-administration/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. title: DBA - Fees and scholarships | SDA Bocconi
text: Doctorate in Business Administration [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/it_IT/courses/course/1-dba-doctorate-business-administration) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/doctorate-in-business-administration/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/doctorate-in-business-administration/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Participation in the DBA program requires a substantial financial commitment. However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![DBA]( ## Fees and expenses The fee for the entire DBA program is 96,000 EUR payable in three installments as follows: - Academic year 1 **€32,000** - Academic year 2 **€32,000** - Academic year 3 **€32,000** **Application fee: €120** The fees include all academic materials, use of the Bocconi and SDA Bocconi libraries and online resources, lunches and coffee breaks during residential modules. Candidates are responsible for covering their travel and lodging expenses while in Milan. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 26 March 2026 _2nd round_ 28 May 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes a number of merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for candidates with outstanding profiles. Admission to the program is independent of the awarding of any scholarship or tuition waiver. For candidates admitted to the DBA 2026-2029, SDA Bocconi offers **seven "Outstanding Candidates Merit-Based Tuition Waivers" of up to €32,000 (33% of tuition fees).** **The waivers are awarded in two rounds:** - **1st Round: 3 waivers** for candidates who apply by the first deadline of **26 March 2026** - **2nd Round: 4 waivers** for applications submitted by the final deadline of **28 May 2026**(including those submitted by the first deadline of 26 March). To be considered for a tuition waiver in either round, candidates must both select the tuition waiver option in the DBA application and submit the application itself by the corresponding deadline listed above. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional record - Results of the DBA selection process ### Tuition Waivers DBA 2026-2029 - ###### Outstanding candidates 7 partial tuition waivers 33% [ ## Loans and funding SDA Bocconi provides opportunities for low-interest loans to admitted students, thanks to agreements with Italian Banks for [**residents of Italy**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/student-loans). Loan applications to Italian Banks must be submitted by the end of month that follows your Master starting date. Furthermore, the University provides [**international students**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/funding-country/) with information about possible sources for financing in several countries. General management and strategy _Start_ 05 October 2026 _Duration_ 3 years _Where_ Milano _Format_ Modular _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 25 years **SDA Bocconi DBA: from manager to thought leaders** The SDA Bocconi **Doctoral Program in Business Administration (DBA) is a 3-year, part-time program** designed for senior professionals aiming to become thought leaders by applying rigorous academic research to real-world business challenges. Unlike generalist programs such as Executive MBAs, the DBA offers deeper specialization in management research — ideal for those aiming to advance their careers, transition into academia, or pursue lifelong learning. What sets the program apart is its world-class faculty: internationally recognized scholars who shape both academic and managerial thinking. They regularly publish in top journals, hold editorial positions, and bring hands-on experience from advising leading global companies. These outstanding academic credentials provide a strong foundation for developing research skills that make a real impact. The flexible, part-time format is designed to fit around professional commitments, with each participant matched to an academic advisor who offers personalized guidance throughout the program. With expert mentorship and a focus on applied research, the SDA Bocconi DBA empowers professionals to deepen their expertise, gain strategic insights, and drive meaningful change — without stepping away from their careers. - ### Words from the Director ![DBA Direttrice]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/doctorate-in-business-administration/video-gallery/) ![classe DBA]( ## Who is it for The DBA is a 3-year part-time program aimed at successful international business professionals interested in developing the necessary skills to become thought leaders in their organizations and in their communities.by applying academic research to concrete managerial problems. Designed for accomplished international professionals—practitioners, consultants, and policy makers—who aim to elevate their impact through research-driven insights, the program is ideal for those seeking to become thought leaders or transition into academic or advisory roles. Coursework consists of four weeklong residential modules ( **Oct 2026, May 2027, Oct 2027, May 2028**) held at SDA Bocconi in Milan, and four virtual modules ( **January - April 2027, June-July 2027, January-April 2028, June-July 2028**). Residential modules run Monday through Friday, while virtual modules take place remotely between residential sessions. Recordings of virtual sessions will be available on the learning platform in case of scheduling conflicts. Thesis work is carried out throughout the Program and materializes in the development of three deliverables: the Literature Review (to be handed in at the end of Year 1), the Thesis Proposal (to be handed in at the end of Year 2), and the Final Thesis (to be handed in at the end of Year 3). ### Course work timeline Timeline Calendar ### Year 1 05 October 202609 October 2026 #### Residential 1: Research in organization theory and strategy - Introduction to Epistemology - Defining a Research Topic - Organization Theory - Strategy - Conducting Quantitative Research January 2027April 2027 #### Virtual 1: Applied research seminars - Applied research seminar - Organization Theory - Applied research seminar - Strategy 17 May 202721 May 2027 #### Residential 2: Research in organizational behaviour, entrepreneurship and innovation - Introduction to research design - Writing a literature review - Innovation and entrepreneurship - Organization behaviour - Conducting qualitative research June 2027July 2027 #### Virtual 2: Applied research seminars - Applied research seminar - Innovation and entrepreneurship - Applied research seminar - Organizational behaviour ### Year 2 04 October 202708 October 2027 #### Residential 3: Research methods - Quantitative tools for data analysis (online pre-course) - Developing a thesis proposal - Developing and testing theories with data - Conducting research using experiments - Conducting research using surveys - Big data for

text: # ETGN - European and Transnational Governance Network Seven partners, one certificate! Attend the courses of your choice at renowned higher education institutions across Europe and enhance your skills in policy-making beyond the state. ![ETGN]( The [ETGN](https://etgn.eui.eu/etgn-certificate) is a training and development partnership among seven prestigious European academic and research institutions, offering transnational perspectives on governance issues of the 21st century: - College of Europe, Bruges Campus - College of Europe, Natolin Campus - Hertie School, the University of Governance in Berlin - Institut National du Service Public (INSP) - School of Transnational Governance, European University Institute - SDA Bocconi School of Management Founded in 2018, the ETGN consortium partners share knowledge and competences and deliver collaborative executive education, providing participants with the opportunity to receive the ETGN certificate. text: ![Faculty e ricerca]( # Faculty & Research ## Excellence in research and teaching At the base of **SDA Bocconi**'s training models and programs lies one of the constituent elements of the School itself: research. Customized search, with templates tailored to each customer. It is a research that adopts rigorous scientific methodologies to create and spread knowledge. We believe this is the only way to **broaden our vision** and innovate cultural patterns and models. ![Faculty SDA Bocconi]( ## Faculty The faculty of SDA Bocconi School of Management aims to generate and spread knowledge through research and education, helping professionals, businesses and institutions increase their value [Discover](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty-research/faculty-knowledge/) ### Explore the Knowledge Groups The Knowledge Groups coordinate faculty members with diverse yet synergistic expertise in relation to interconnected research and teaching areas. - [![Humans at Work]( \\ **Humans at Work** \\ \\ The **Humans at Work Platform** focuses on all issues related to workplace transformation, particularly in light of the digital transition.\\ \\ Discover](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty-research/research/humans-at-work/) - text: - [Discover](https://www.sdabocconi.it/faculty-ricerca/ricerca/shield/#scopri) - [Activities](https://www.sdabocconi.it/faculty-ricerca/ricerca/shield/#attivit%C3%A0) - [People](https://www.sdabocconi.it/faculty-ricerca/ricerca/shield/#people) - [Output](https://www.sdabocconi.it/faculty-ricerca/ricerca/shield/#output) - [Events](https://www.sdabocconi.it/faculty-ricerca/ricerca/shield/#eventi) - [Media](https://www.sdabocconi.it/faculty-ricerca/ricerca/shield/#media) - [Restricted area](https://www.sdabocconi.it/faculty-ricerca/ricerca/shield/#areariservata) # SHIELD SHIELD is the research and strategic training center of SDA Bocconi School of Management, dedicated to national security, interinstitutional leadership, and systemic resilience. ![shield monitor logo]( ## Target The center was established through the synergy between academia, institutions, and industry, under the patronage of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation and with the collaboration of the Ministry of Defense. Changes in the geopolitical landscape that require greater investment in security, rapid technological developments in the military and dual-use domains with a dramatic shortening of innovation time to market, and the emergence of hybrid forms of confrontation with third countries all call for the development of strategic thinking capacity. This means the intellectual ability to define realistic objectives, align ends and means with appropriate leadership, anticipate adversaries, and adapt to uncertainty. SHIELD’s mission is therefore to develop advanced models of analysis and intervention in complex contexts, in line with the geopolitical, technological, and organizational transformations affecting the national system. ![shield]( ## Actitivies **In particular, SHIELD aims to:** **Strengthen the state’s strategic capacity** Enhance strategic, analytical, and decision-making capabilities through advanced training and research activities in the strategic and geopolitical fields. SHIELD seeks to develop skills that enable the interpretation of complex environments, the anticipation of threats, and the training of leadership groups capable of adapting to uncertainty and guiding decision-making processes in hybrid and multilevel scenarios. **Promote leadership and interministerial and industrial coordination** Encourage integration among national institutions through stronger interministerial coordination, extending structured dialogue to major industrial players operating in the security sector. The goal is to build an ecosystem in which public and private actors cooperate on a stable basis around national priorities for security and innovation. **Enable national industry and develop relevant industrial value chains** Support companies’ ability to engage more effectively with security policies by contributing to the development of dual-use technologies, operational frameworks, and data governance models. This includes promoting supply chain integration and technology transfer to small and medium-sized enterprises, in order to ensure resilience, innovation capacity, and reduced external dependencies in critical sectors. **Build a new integrated culture of security, including at the international level** Promote a national and European culture of security focused on strategic autonomy, the resilience of critical infrastructures, and public-private integration, positioning SHIELD as one of the reference actors within multilateral cooperation networks on security issues (EU, NATO, G7). ## People - [Carlo Altomonte\\ \\ Director, SHIELD\\ \\ ![Carlo Altomonte]( - [Walter Rauti\\ \\ Deputy Director and Head of Research, SHIELD\\ \\ ![rauti_walter_cv.jpg]( ## Output - 2025 ###### European Defense Spending Trilemma Security, affordability and domestic popularity: the case of Italy Andrea Gilli, A. title: European FS (Financial Services) Tech Hub - Structure | SDA Bocconi
text: ### Structure - ### Advisory Council Composed of authorities, regulators and industry associations, will address the vision and long-term strategy of the Hub, answering to the need expressed by the market. - ### Founding Sponsors Advisory Board Composed of members with high prestige and professionalism coming from leading Italian and international financial realities, that identifies the main topics of the research and interacts with the Advisory council. - ### Committee of Executive Sponsors It is characterized by “experience, vision, engagement, flexibility and complementarity” and is composed of hub’s founding and premium sponsors. The plenary Committee addresses the operations, drives the strategies for the academic researches and brings in the Hub the real day-by-day market’s needs. - ### Instructors & Researchers Responsible for directing and managing the FS Tech Hub’s scientific activities on the basis of the guidelines and objectives defined by the Advisory Council and the Founding Sponsor Advisory Board. - ### Supporters & Experts They can be both internal to ICE SDA Bocconi (student associations etc.) and from the external ecosystem. Their aim is to provide a pool of talent, skills and resources useful for the success of the initiative. ### Steps and Objects FS tech hub will be the reference point for the participants, and eventually also for external industry experts and students, interested in developing expertise in financial valuation and governance topic in the fast-growing world of tech applied to financial services. The Key phases are the following ones. [Discover ### Projectual Framework - Definition of the vision and long-term strategy of the Hub, in response to the needs and demands expressed by the market. - Identification of the primary research topics and engagement with the Advisory Council to represent the needs of the market. - Implementation of academic research implementation and exploration of market trends and emerging challenges for participants of the Hub. ![projectual_framework_ice_2023]( ### Deliverables - SHORT TERM (0-6 months) Launch Event, Induction Advisory Council, Workshop Kick-off, Committee Board, 1° Workshop Trend - MID TERM (6-12 months) Experience Day, Private Report For Sponsors, Public Event (Report), Innovative Start Ups Competition - LONG TERM (12-24 months) Research Main Output - Book ### Key Success Factors - CLEAR AND SHARED TARGETS FOR CUSTOMERS - EXECUTIVE SPONSORSHIP ICE SDA will address the research and provide outputs for Sponsors - RULES FOR ACTORS Clear roles and responsibilities (creation of a Board) that lead a constant growth - PARTICIPANTS ENGAGEMENT - WIN-WIN MODE Shared view and actions that bring results to the whole community - VALUE CREATION FOR ICE SDA BOCCONI - CONTENT PROGRAMMING Communication plan and scheduled contents production - ONLINE PLATFORM A channel for content sharing and value creation ### Calendar Timeline Calendar November 2023 #### European FS Tech Hub Official Launch February 2024 #### 1° Advisory Council, Advisory Board and COES meetings May 2024 #### 1° Workshop June 2024 #### 2° Workshop September 2024 #### 3° Workshop November 2024 #### Research Output Presentation Final Event Contacts [ice@sdabocconi.it](mailto:ice@sdabocconi.it) ![app]( ![Merchandising](

ICE has identified the area of Financial Services on which to position its role of innovation hub, and the FS Tech Hub of Milan wants to develop a path together with some partners. Within this path the FS Tech Hub wants to implement several initiatives with a modular approach that ensures the solidity and relevance of the overall program maximizing financial inclusiveness and internationality. Explore the hub ![icevideoscreen]( ### The initiatives of the FS Tech Hub of Milan are identified as follow: - ### Education Workshop, classes and training courses on «valuation in fintech, start-ups and tech innovation» - ### Innovation Innovative start-up competition - ### Editorial Annual Report of the Hub, research Papers (in the FS tech area) and a book over the FS tech sector The goal of the Hub is to study the industry - in great ferment - of financial tech services, combining all together the demands of market operators, the evolution of regulatory issues and the innovations proposed by the world of start-ups, with an international cutting-hedge approach and oriented to the value creation for the overall ecosystem. The final result will give participants access to studies, reports and insights with the latest state of the art in financial tech service. ### Ecosystem ICE SDA Bocconi aims to establish an ecosystem where it plays a pivotal role, with a specific focus on the latest advancements in innovation, valuation, and governance within the FinServ (FS) tech industries. The FS tech hub will: - **Address research and study initiatives** based on the needs expressed by the participants, aligning with market demands - **Enhance participants' growth** by introducing them to the latest technological innovations through a virtual connection with selected start-ups - **Provide** participants with regular **research findings**, workshops, and educational programs ![ecosystem_ice]( ### Manifesto The main targets for **ICE SDA BOCCONI European FS Tech Hub** are described in our **Manifesto**. - ###### COOPERATION FOR VALUE CREATION Creation of value based on the culture of collaboration and the exchange of knowledge between the main players of innovation in financial services, that represent a source of data and inspiration for research, also enabling the development of relationships within the ecosystem - ###### VALUE RESEARCH Enhancing the work of ICE SDA Bocconi researchers, placing them in contact with the subjects of their research and creating new sources of funding for research activities (output: scientific report) - ###### SHARE KNOWLEDGE Establish a place for sharing data and information, creating a bridge between supply and demand companies, innovative startups, researchers and the market at international level - ###### BUILD SKILLS AND COMPETENCES Offer a wide range of training opportunities, such specialized training courses and classes on the topic of "valuation in fintech, start-ups and tech innovation - If you are a fintech startup interested in joining the

text: - [Discover](https://www.sdabocconi.it/innovation-and-corporate-entrepreneurship/#scopri) - [Format](https://www.sdabocconi.it/innovation-and-corporate-entrepreneurship/#format) - [Vertical](https://www.sdabocconi.it/innovation-and-corporate-entrepreneurship/#vertical) - [Programs](https://www.sdabocconi.it/innovation-and-corporate-entrepreneurship/#programmi) - [Events](https://www.sdabocconi.it/innovation-and-corporate-entrepreneurship/#eventi) - [Team](https://www.sdabocconi.it/innovation-and-corporate-entrepreneurship/#team) - [Media](https://www.sdabocconi.it/innovation-and-corporate-entrepreneurship/#media) ICE # Innovation and Corporate Entrepreneurship ![logo_ice.png]( ## What is ICE? What can we do for you? It’s rare to encounter entrepreneurs in large organisations. More often repelled by the sheer number of rules, procedures, and hierarchies, preferring to work in small, agile firms or to start their own venture. If they do end up in a larger firm, it’s usually due to the young entrepreneur’s belief that it’s better to learn their trade at a big company, so that they can learn from their mistakes before starting their own venture. These preconceptions harm both entrepreneurs and corporations. Entrepreneurs often miss out on the chance to learn from large organisations, and corporations miss out on the energy, dynamism, and innovation that entrepreneurs create. It means that entrepreneurs lose out on skills, and corporations on profitable new ideas. So that, even though they have the most resources and know-how, groundbreaking ideas are much more likely to come from start-ups. And, in the face of climate change and the drive to net-zero emissions, being innovative has never been so important. In order to improve their sustainability and meet these new responsibilities, corporations must act now to unleash their entrepreneurial potential. **ICE, jointly founded by** [**Bocconi for **(B4i) and SDA Bocconi**, supports companies that want to figure out how to enhance their capability to innovate. By increasing their entrepreneurial energy, firms can harness their employees’ potential, break down inertia within their own firm, and replace passive reaction to market uncertainties with proactive action. **The corporate entrepreneurship equation** A key characteristic of entrepreneurs is that they act even if the outcomes are uncertain, but often they lack organization. Bureaucrats on the other hand are good at organizing a large number of people that need to work together but hate uncertainty. So the challenge large firms have is to: - hire people with entrepreneurial drive and create a culture that boosts their entrepreneurial energy; - reduce market-related uncertainties with modern market research tools; - develop administrative processes that reduce uncertainties to the extent that the energy entrepreneurs have to follow-up on their ideas is high enough. text: # Lendwise Students who have been admitted into one the following programs: MBA, EMBA, GEMBA, MAMA and MCF are eligible to apply for a Lendwise loan. ![MBA]( Students are eligible for a loan only if they reside outside Italy at the time of application. Any application for a loan made from within the Italian territory and/or by students currently residing in Italy will be rejected by Lendwise. Interest rates are personalized to the applicants’ profile and are fixed for the entire duration of the loan. In addition, there are no fees for making early repayments or settling your loan early. See more details about the terms and conditions, and how to apply for a loan on [Lendwise’s website](https://cta.lendwise.com/bocconi/apply-now). Main features of Lendwise loans: - Competitive and fixed interest rate - Loans can cover tuition fees and living costs, although amounts will be adjusted according to the profile of each individual applicant. Please note that loans cannot cover the deposit or first instalment paid by the student upon enrollment - No collateral or guarantees required - Easy online process - No payments during studies for those enrolled in a full-time course - 10 years repayment period Apply directly through [Lendwise’s website](https://cta.lendwise.com/bocconi/apply-now). For further information please refer to the FAQ section on Lendwise’s website. Want to know more? [Lendwise’s website](https://cta.lendwise.com/bocconi/apply-now) ![app]( ![Merchandising](

text: Executive MBA Programs [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/executive-mba-programs/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/executive-mba-programs/wishlist/) # \#EMBAWOMEN An association committed to the growth of female leadership, contributing to the creation of fairer and more equitable business models and organizations, building its mission on three key values: BE, GROW, EVOLVE. **EMBAWomen** was founded by a group of EMBA Alumnae who felt the need to give voice to their enterprising spirit as ambitious women, aware of the challenges society and the economic landscape present, but also conscious of the strength of a peer group and the power of networking. ![EMBA women]( ### Our Story Today, EMBAWomen represents an independent reality with **over 150 alumni and alumnae** united by an EMBA journey that catalyzes both personal and professional transformation. The community works in harmonious alignment with SDA Bocconi, a necessary partner to ensure gender equality is not just a slogan but a fundamental pillar for the leadership of tomorrow. Empowerment and managerial development for women go through education, fostering responsible, collaborative, and inclusive leadership that is capable of shaping economies and businesses. - The idea for **EMBAWomen** was born from a group of women EMBA candidates in 2019. - The initiative was presented to the Director and began to take shape under the name **#EMBAWomen**. - In December **2019**, the **first event** was organized. - In **2021**, driven by the same intention, a group of executive women relaunched the program with the goal of including and valuing the participation of all EMBA courses. - Development of the strategic plan. - This is how **EMBAWomen** came to life, growing richer in content day by day. ### Executive MBA and EMBAWomen focus on: - ### 1\. Gender equality, fairness and managerial sustainability Promoting and safeguarding equal opportunities, a “sustainable” and “fair” leadership model within organizations, and female empowerment. - ### 2\. More executive master business administration for women Increasing the number of women in Executive MBA classes, recognizing and communicating the real value and impact an EMBA has on women’s careers. - ### 3\. Network, community, and dialogue Being a space for meetings and exchanges between professionals from various sectors, promoting the value of gender diversity within the business, institutional, and social community, while fostering discussions on professional and personal challenges. - ### 4\. Professional development Strengthening the network of women and guiding and supporting the professional development of women leaders. - ### 5\. Mentoring & ambassadorship Enhancing the skills and preparation of community members by directing them toward activities (social, personal, cultural, corporate) that promote the improvement of women’s lives, both personally and professionally. - ### 6\. Eliminating discrimination Encouraging women to continuously strive to remove existing obstacles and any form of discrimination, whether in family, social, or work settings, in full compliance with current equality laws. - ### 7\. Charity and donations Encouraging charitable activities, distance support, and the free donation of goods or products. ### Scholarship offered Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management offers partial tuition waivers for the EMBA Weekend (Milan and Rome) and EMBA Modular programs.

We don’t just assess whether you are the right fit for the Executive MBA—we also want to ensure that the EMBA aligns with your expectations. The selection process involves a holistic evaluation of your application materials, along with other key factors such as professional experience, leadership potential, and personal drive. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/executive-mba/executive-mba-modular/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? But it is a strategic investment that certainly offers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![Graduation EMBA]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the 2026-2028 EMBA Modular is € 62,000 (VAT exempt), payable in five installments. - First installment **€ 10,000** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€ 13,000** by 18 December 2026 - Third installment **€ 13,000** by 30 April 2027 - Fourth installment **€ 13,000** by 30 September 2027 - Fifth installment **€ 13,000** by 4 January 2028 **Application fee: € 150** The fees include: - Internal educational materials - Use of the school's facilities Participants in the [PSM-Programma di Sviluppo Manageriale](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/on-campus-executive-education/programma-di-sviluppo-manageriale/) of SDA Bocconi who are interested in the Executive MBA can access the program with a 20% discount on the registration fee. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round:_ 4 May 2026 _2nd round:_ 9 July 2026 _3rd round (residual places):_ 25 August 2026 Thanks to the support of the Bocconi Alumni Community, each year SDA Bocconi offers scholarships and tuition waivers based on merit and other specific criteria, as outlined in the official calls for applications. For the upcoming EMBA edition, the following scholarships and tuition waivers are available for outstanding candidates: ### Tuition waivers EMBA Modular 2026-2028 #### Upon admission - ###### € 124,000 available in partial tuition waivers Partial tuition waivers (covering from 10% to 20%) [ #### Two rounds during the year - ###### 6 Partial tuition waivers Call for applications [ - ###### 6 partial tuition waivers Candidates from companies belonging to the China Chamber of Commerce in Italy [ **Criteria and assignment procedure:** The number of tuition waivers available for each phase and the criteria for their assignment are determined by a Commission, whose decisions are final. Beneficiaries will be notified of the outcome by the start date of the Executive MBA. **Requirements to apply for an exemption:** - The completed and required documentation for the Executive MBA application must be submitted. - The exemption request must be submitted in response to the call for applications, along with the specified documents, through the [Admissions portal]( - The request must be submitted within the deadlines and in compliance with the requirements outlined in the call. Requests that do not meet the requirements will not be considered. **Evaluation criteria** Exemption requests will be assessed based on the following factors: - The candidate’s academic and professional background - Motivation letter - Requirements defined in the call - Results of the Executive MBA selection tests The tuition waivers will be assigned during the selection process, within the deadlines specified in the call. **The request may be submitted even before the completion of the selection process.** **Admission to the Executive MBA is independent of the awarding of an exemption or scholarship.** ## Loans and funding The School assists candidates with their search

Guided by the claim "Transforming perspectives, fostering Impact," the program empowers executives to redefine their outlook, embrace change and create lasting impact within their organizations and beyond. Designed for ambitious professionals, the master equips students with leadership and management skills, while enhancing their ability to adapt, prioritize and strategize in today’s dynamic business environment. **Held in Milan and delivered entirely in English**, the **Modular format** is structured around alternating **intensive training weeks and weekend modules**, generally held once a month. It is ideal for those seeking to balance an investment in their skills and competencies with their professional commitments: individuals looking to gain knowledge that can be immediately applied in a professional context, fostering a productive synergy between study and work. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class Profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/executive-mba/executive-mba-weekend/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. We don’t just assess whether you are the right fit for the Executive MBA—we also want to ensure that the EMBA aligns with your expectations. The selection process involves a holistic evaluation of your application materials, along with other key factors such as professional experience, leadership potential, and personal drive. General management and strategy _Start_ May 2026 _Duration_ 18 months _Where_ Milano / Roma _Format_ Weekend _Language_ Italian, English _Avg. working experience_ 13 years SDA Bocconi’s Executive MBA is more than a master’s program—it is a pivotal step in personal and professional transformation. Guided by the claim "Transforming Perspectives. Fostering Impact," the program empowers executives to redefine their outlook, embrace change and create lasting impact within their organizations and beyond. It’s not just about meeting formal requirements, but also about aligning with the values and expectations of our dynamic MBA community. We evaluate a variety of factors, including your skills, motivation, enthusiasm, and potential for growth, both as a manager and as an individual. Ultimately, we aim to determine if this challenging yet rewarding path will help you achieve your career goals and personal aspirations. **DEADLINES** **Tuition waivers** 1st round: 4 Nov 2025 2nd round: 13 Jan 2026 3rd round: 3 Mar 2026 4th round: 18 May 2026 **Application** 18 May 2026 ![classe Full-Time MBA]( ## Your next steps - ### 1\. Online application form - ### 2\. Video Pre-interview - ### 3\. Detailed CV/Resume - ### 4\. Degree certificate & transcript - ![Business ### 5\. TOEFL, IELTS, CPE, PTE Academic - ![Track ### 6\. Interview ## What we need from you ### Application form ### Video Pre-interview ### Degree certificate and transcript ### Professional Experience, Detailed CV ### Proficiency in English ### GMAT or GRE ### Two References ### Sponsoring company application ### Interview ### Additional materials required ## Admissions results As soon as the selection process is completed, you will receive a formal letter from the Admissions Committee notifying you of the decision. Selection results are never communicated by telephone. All decisions made by the Admissions Committee are final. The selection process will result in one of the following outcomes: - **Admission:** you will receive the official admission notice along with the participation contract. If all available spots have been filled, the school may place you on a waiting list or offer admission for the following edition. Admission to the program is valid for the year the application is submitted. However, you can request deferment for the following year, but approval of deferment is on a case-by-case decision by the Admissions committee. - **Non-admission:** Admission to the program is highly selective. Our selection process evaluates each candidate’s individual profile while also considering the overall composition of the MBA class, which must be consistent with the quality and diversity the school requires. While we acknowledge the significant effort all candidates invest in the application and the selection process, we do not provide personalized feedback to non-admitted candidates. ## How to apply Fill out and submit the online application through our website. **Please note that the application portal is a separate platform, so your SDA Bocconi website (www.sdabocconi.it)credentials are not to be used. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class Profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/full-time-mba/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. Here, you don’t just learn—you live the experience. The MBA journey extends beyond the classroom, offering tailored **study tours** connected to specific concentrations. These immersive trips provide valuable hands-on exposure to global markets, innovative companies, and industry leaders, allowing students to apply their learning in real-world settings and explore business dynamics across different regions and sectors. **Industry Days** further enrich the experience by bringing students face-to-face with top executives, entrepreneurs, and experts. These events offer the opportunity to engage in discussions, share insights, and explore current challenges and trends within various industries. title: Full-Time MBA - Fees and scholarships | SDA Bocconi
text: Full-Time MBA [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/it_IT/courses/course/11-mba-mba-full-time) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/full-time-mba/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/full-time-mba/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Pursuing an MBA is a significant financial commitment, but one that yields substantial long-term rewards. Below is an overview of the costs. SDA Bocconi’s MBA is an intensive, full-time program that requires full dedication to maximize its impact. Given its rigorous structure, participants cannot engage in professional activities to provide financial support during the program. ![classe Full-Time MBA]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the Full-Time MBA 2026-2027 is €82,000 (VAT exempt), payable in four installments - First installment **€ 10,000** acceptance of your admission to the Program - Second installment **€24,000** by 30 October 2026 - Third installment **€24,000** by 29 January 2027 - Fourth installment **€24,000** by 30 April 2027 The fees include: - Most teaching materials (although some texts must be purchased separately) - Access to the school's databases Participants must provide their own laptop. Other costs: - **Admission Process Fee: € 120** - **Personal Expenses**: Of course, personal expenses will vary significantly depending on each individual's lifestyle. Based on recent input from MBA students, we aim to provide an accurate estimate of monthly personal expenses, which typically range between €2,000 and €2,500. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 4 Nov 2025 _2nd round_ 13 Jan 2026 _3rd round_ 3 Mar 2026 _4th round_ 18 May 2026 Each year, multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers are available for outstanding candidates, made possible by the ongoing support of companies and organizations, as well as of our alums and current students. Student and alum contributions form the foundation of SDA Bocconi’s commitment to supporting future leaders—individuals who will drive global change, starting in the classroom and continuing throughout their professional journeys. In this spirit, scholarship recipients may consider giving back to help the school develop new initiatives, enhance the program, and strengthen the community. Even a small contribution can make a lasting impact and change lives. Tuition waivers and scholarships are typically awarded before the start of the program. A dedicated commission determines the number of awards and the selection criteria for full or partial tuition waivers. Decisions are final and communicated to recipients according to the deadlines outlined in each “notice of competition” and no later than the start of the program. Tuition waivers cannot be combined; however, recipients may decline a waiver if awarded one of a higher amount. Admission to the MBA program is independent of the awarding of any scholarship or tuition waiver. **Applications for tuition waivers are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of academic and professional record - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Results of the MBA selection process **To be eligible for the scholarships/tuition waivers you must:** - Have submitted your application for the 2026-2027 MBA Program - Review the pre-requisites for each scholarship/tuition waiver - Apply for the scholarship or tuition waiver, once available, on the online Application Portal by the

We have a total budget of **€1.000.000** allocated for these awards, so we strongly encourage early applications to increase your chances of being considered. If you are awarded a smaller grant, you may still be considered for additional scholarships, including those of higher value - **up to 100% of the program cost**. These grants may be awarded during the final admissions rounds throughout the year. General management and strategy _Start_ September 2026 _Duration_ 12-15 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Full-time _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 5,5 years At SDA Bocconi, we believe in the power of transformation and impact. Our Full-Time MBA program, guided by the motto " **Change Together, Lead with Impact**" empowers you to unlock your potential for greatness. Embrace change fearlessly, harnessing it as a catalyst for innovation and personal growth. With a focus on **collaboration** and **diversity**, in an intimate and welcoming environment, you'll thrive in a **close-knit** setting where your unique perspective converges with others, forging **lifelong connections** and **strong networks**. You will nurture exceptional leadership skills and inspire others to excel, leaving a **lasting impact** on your organization and the community. Together, we will drive **positive change** that goes beyond the bottom line, creating a more sustainable and prosperous future for all. Our Full-time MBA is recognized as a game changer in the careers of its graduates. The program's **high level of relevance**, scientific prominence, innovative teaching methods, and impact in academic research has demonstrated consistent top-tier performance across multiple rankings in recent years, alongside strong graduate outcomes. - ### Words from the Director ![Words from the Director]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/full-time-mba/video-gallery/) ![MBA Class]( ## Who is it for For approximately 130-140 students from nearly 40 countries and diverse backgrounds, willing to invest in high-return management education, our intensive program spans from 12 to 15 months, effectively equipping them to tackle the challenges of the market. Our program is designed for professionals ready to make the famed ‘triple jump’ in their career - a change in industry sector, function, or country - or for those who want to take one step further towards a full-fledged career in general management. It is a transformational learning experience for highly motivated goal-achievers, empowering them to become drivers of organizational change. **MBA 2025-2026** 129 Students 40 Countries represented 43 % Women 6 years Average work experience 29 years Average age [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/full-time-mba/class-profile/) ## Why Full-Time MBA A Full-Time MBA offers intensive learning, networking, and personal growth opportunities. With a comprehensive curriculum, real-world experience, and faculty access, it provides a supportive environment for leadership development. A diverse student body and global exposure enhance business acumen, while networking and collaboration opportunities build a strong professional network. During these sessions, students gain valuable knowledge about how various industries operate, stay updated on the latest trends shaping their landscapes, and understand the challenges they face. Final admission decisions are based on a holistic evaluation of each candidate’s potential to contribute to and benefit from the program. Admission to the GEMBA represents a strategic investment in your future. It is designed not only to determine whether a candidate is a good fit for the program but also to ensure that the GEMBA aligns with their expectations and career goals. But it is a strategic investment that certainly offers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![classe GEMBA]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the Rotman–SDA Bocconi GEMBA 2026-2027 is USD 110,000, payable in five installments - First installment **USD 10,000** on acceptance of admission offer - Second Installment **USD 25,000** by October 30, 2026 - Third Installment **USD 25,000** by February 26, 2027 - Fourth Installment **USD 25,000** by April 30, 2027 - Fifth Installment **USD 25,000** by June 26, 2027 **Application fee: € 130** The fees include - Most teaching materials, access to the school's support facilities, class-day meals, and accommodation for modules held outside Italy and Canada. Not included - Travel visas, travel expenses, accommodation in Italy and Canada and incidentals. Participants must provide their own laptop. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 31 March 2026 _2nd round_ 7 May 2026 _3rd round_ 24 June 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi offers multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers. Thanks to the contribution of the Bocconi Alumni Community, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes available 300,000 USD in merit-based Tuition Waiversfor 2026-2027 Rotman-SDA Bocconi GEMBA candidates. **Tuition Waivers applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of academic and professional record - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Results of the Rotman-SDA Bocconi GEMBA selection process **Admission to the Rotman-SDA Bocconi Global EMBA is independent of the awarding of any scholarship or tuition waiver.** **For the assignment of (at least) 2 Tuition Waivers priority will be given to Women with an outstanding profile**. **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, you must:** - Have submitted your application for the 2026-2027 Rotman-SDA Bocconi GEMBA program - Review the pre-requisites for the tuition waiver - Apply for the tuition waiver on the online Application Portal by the indicated deadline. You can apply to the tuition waivers even if your GEMBA selection process is still in progress. The tuition waivers will be awarded in the rounds indicated in the notice of competition and within the Rotman-SDA Bocconi Global EMBA program's beginning. We encourage candidates to apply early to increase their chances of a Tuition waiver. ### Tuition Waivers GEMBA 2026-2027 (up to 25% of the GEMBA Tuition Fee) The tuition waivers are usually awarded during the admissions process and before the Program begins. text: gaining cutting-edge skills in areas where our schools excel - design thinking, luxury brand management, analytics, fintech, and more. Build a powerful international network and accelerate your career. - ### Eight residential modules The program is built around 8 residential modules. These take place at the Rotman School, at both SDA Bocconi Campuses in Milan and Rome, and on the campuses of our international afﬁliate academic partners, providing in-depth local perspectives on global management. Each module consists of several courses, and includes lectures, team discussions, and other dynamic, real-time learning opportunities. - ### Real-world experiences and learning safaris Classroom sessions are interspersed with real-world experiences - company visits, exchanges with local executives, and dynamic networking events - that we call 'learning safaris': an impactful formula blending standout site visits with direct interaction with top executives. It's the essence of experiential learning, where participants witness and engage firsthand. Evenings are ﬁlled with group projects, individual assignments and time to explore the local culture and cities. - ### Capstone Projects The integrative Capstone Project allows students to apply GEMBA learnings to a real-world challenge, often aligned with their professional context. Students define a meaningful problem - individually or in small teams - and develop a viable solution with faculty guidance. Projects run throughout the program (with some flexibility depending on scope) and are structured around a clear roadmap. They typically include problem definition, environmental and organizational analysis, a recommended solution, and an implementation plan. - ### Online learning Online learning predominates in the periods between modules: preparation begins for the next set of courses, with study materials delivered a month or two before class begins. The strength of the Rotman-SDA Bocconi GEMBA lies in its talented, diverse, and ambitious students. We invest considerable effort in the selection and admissions process to ensure a dynamic and enriching learning environment. **Requirements**: - Degree certificate (in any discipline), transcript of the grades - Application form - Detailed CV/Resume - 5+ years of full-time professional experience - 2+ years of mid-to senior management experience (people, project or budget experience) - Current full-time employment - Proficiency in English - GMAT or GRE - Two references - Interview - Strong motivation, good leadership and interpersonal skills [Go to selection process](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/mba-executive-mba/the-rotman-sda-bocconi-global-executive-mba/admissions/) ![classe GEMBA]( ## Fees and scholarships The Rotman-SDA Bocconi GEMBA represents a significant financial commitment, but it is a strategic investment in global business leadership with substantial long-term benefits. The tuition fee for GEMBA 2026-2027 is USD 110,000, payable in five installments. Thanks to the support of the Bocconi Alumni Community, 300,000 USD in merit-based tuition waivers are available for outstanding candidates. title: MBAs OPEN DAY | Milano | Online | SDA Bocconi | 2026-04-11
text: - [Agenda](https://www.sdabocconi.it/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/#agenda) - [Orientation Meetings](https://www.sdabocconi.it/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/#orientationmeetings) - [Campus Tour](https://www.sdabocconi.it/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/#campustour) - [Keynote Speakers](https://www.sdabocconi.it/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/#keynotespeakers) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/wishlist/) 11April2026 # MBAs OPEN DAY General management and strategy ![openday_26022026_1500x1000.jpg]( _Start_ 11 April 2026 09:00 - 13:45 Milan Milan (+01.00) _Language_ English Milano Via Roberto Sarfatti, 10 Online SDA Bocconi Platform **Transformation rarely starts with certainty.** **It starts with a doubt, an ambition, a quiet awareness that you are ready for more.** **At the heart of our MBAs lies transformation** — first and foremost of your competencies, but also of how you think, act, and lead. The SDA Bocconi **MBAs Open Day is designed around your questions** — offering the space to explore your aspirations and understand which path can shape your next move. Throughout the day, you will explore our portfolio of MBA programs — the **Full-Time MBA**, the **Executive MBA (EMBA)**, and **the Global Executive MBA (GEMBA)** — gain a clear understanding of each program’s structure, distinctive features, relevance, and learning philosophy, while **engaging with the people who enable this transformation**: **Directors**, the **professionals of the Guidance & Recruitment Team** and the **Career Development Center**, and **Alumnae and Alumni** sharing their journeys. Get an overview of the day: - [**MBAs Programs presentation**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/#agenda) - [**Orientation meetings with the Guidance & Recruitment Team**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/#orientationmeetings) - [**Guided Campus Tour**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/events/mbas-open-day-20260411/#campustour) We look forward to welcoming you — **whether on campus in Milan** for a fully immersive experience, **or online** from wherever you are — and supporting you as you move **from questions to decision** and take the next step in your professional journey. ## Agenda Format24H 24H12H 09:30 - 13:45 09:30 - 10:45 ### Full time MBA 11:00 - 12:15 ### Global Executive MBA 12:30 - 13:45 ### Executive MBA ## Orientation Meetings After registering for the event and selecting the Orientation Meeting, you will receive a confirmation email with a link to **reserve your preferred time slot**. The Orientation Meeting is a dedicated one-to-one conversation with our Guidance & Recruitment Team a meaningful moment of dialogue where _your goals truly meet our guidance_. It is designed to help you reflect on your aspirations, clarify your priorities, and explore which program best aligns with your professional background, ambitions, and desired transformation. This personalized exchange goes beyond information: it’s an opportunity to receive tailored insights, ask candid questions, and gain a clearer perspective on the path that can best support your next step. ![orientation_meetings_600x600.jpg]( ## Campus Tour Do you want to experience campus life like a real student? During the Open Day, you’ll have the opportunity to attend live classes, explore areas dedicated to the different programs, and discover the brand-new Bocconi Sport Center. A guided campus tour will allow you to experience firsthand the environment where your transformation could begin immersing yourself in the spaces, the atmosphere, and the vibrant community that define life at SDA Bocconi. ![campus]( ## Keynote Speakers - [Stefano Caselli\\ \\ Dean, \\ \\ SDA Bocconi School of Management\\ \\ ![stefano_caselli_cv.jpg]( - [Enzo Baglieri\\ \\ Associate Dean for Master Division, SDA Bocconi\\ \\ ![enzo_baglieri_cv.jpg]( -
