title: Measuring social impact to continue making an impact | SDA Bocconi
text: [![SDA Bocconi Insight Logo]( # Measuring social impact to continue making an impact **04 March 2025**/By **Filippo Giordano [F. Perrini](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?author=4432)**/5 minutes read [Sustainable practices](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?topic=4434) [Social Entrepreneurship & Philanthropy](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?topic=4435) ![shelf scaffale]( ##### The growing demand for accountability and disclosure has placed social impact at the center of attention for businesses, public administrations, and non-profit organizations. However, social impact measurement remains underdeveloped compared to environmental impact measurement, despite the increasing need for reliable metrics. With their book [_**Impatto sociale. Interventi di inclusione e strumenti per la misurazione**_](https://www.egeaeditore.it/ita/prodotti/management/impatto-sociale__.aspx), **Filippo Giordano** and [**Francesco Perrini**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty/francesco-perrini/) address this gap by providing a guide for practitioners, policymakers, CSR managers, and philanthropists who seek to rigorously assess the changes generated by inherently difficult-to-measure actions. > “This book combines scientific depth with an accessible writing style, making it both an interesting and useful resource for professionals measuring the social impact of their organizations and for researchers exploring these topics,” writes **Francesco Billari**, Rector of Bocconi University, in the introduction. Today, addressing the challenge of social impact measurement is crucial for all economic actors. Public administrations need it to adopt a systemic approach and assess long-term effects if they want to optimize resources and policies. Non-profit organizations, evolving from mere service providers to true agents of change, must be able to account for the magnitude of the transformations they drive. Businesses increasingly recognize the interconnection between economic and socio-environmental value, integrating social impact measurement into their sustainability strategies. The first part of the book provides a general framework for measuring social impact, while the second focuses on interventions aimed at rehabilitating and reintegrating individuals in the penal system. The book concludes with a practical guide on designing and evaluating inclusion initiatives. - **Publisher**: EGEA - **Publication date**: December 2024 - **ISBN/EAN**: 9788823889255 - **Pagine**: 196 - **Formato**: paper, e-Pub, Digitabook **FILIPPO GIORDANO** is Full Professor of Business Administration at LUMSA University in Rome, where he directs the interdisciplinary research center on social and penal systems _Diritto Alla Speranza_. His research and teaching focus on public and non-profit management, social enterprise governance, corporate sustainability, prison management, and the evaluation of social inclusion projects. He is a research affiliate at Bocconi University's ICRIOS research center and has been teaching at SDA Bocconi School of Management. [**FRANCESCO PERRINI**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty/francesco-perrini/) is Full Professor of Business and Management at Bocconi University’s Department of Management and Technology. He is Associate Dean for Sustainability, DEI, and ICE (Innovation and Corporate Entrepreneurship) at SDA Bocconi School of Management, where he leads the Strategy & Operations area, coordinates the ESG Knowledge Platform, and serves as Scientific Director of the Sustainability Lab. He is also Academic Director of the Master in Sustainability Management and the Master's in Transformative Sustainability, a joint program with Politecnico di Milano. ![Impatto sociale]( **Authors** ###### Filippo Giordano Department of Management and Technology ![Filippo Giordano]( ###### F. text: - [Goal](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/gepropi-net/#obiettivo) - [Activities](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/gepropi-net/#attivit%C3%A0) - [Meetings](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/gepropi-net/#incontri) - [Who should apply](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/gepropi-net/#fa-per-te-se) - [Information](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/gepropi-net/#information) - [Governance](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/gepropi-net/#governance) [Apply Now](https://forms.sdabocconi.it/ep/2025/gepropi/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/network/gepropi-net/wishlist/) ![SDA Bocconi]( # GePROPI Net Management of Implementation Processes of public works and infrastructure ##### We summarise more than 30 years of knowledge shared between GEPROPI and PREM Lab Public management **Specialized training course useful for qualification of contracting stations** GePROPI, Gestione Processi Realizzativi di opere pubbliche e infrastrutture (Implementation Process Management of Public Works and Infrastructure) has a history of more than 20 years. It is an educational path that includes related courses, some of which date back to 1985. Ten years ago, the **Osservatorio PREM Lab**, Public Real Estate Management, was born, closely related to the GePROPI experience. The birth of the PREM Lab stemmed from the realization that **prolonged training, without direct experience** in research and assistance to public bodies, could create a gap between training and application needs. The goal was to go beyond mere training, yet recognizing its essentiality in the creation of an operational-application culture. Today, GePROPI is evolving into a wider "container" alongside the GePROPI courses (RUP, Project Manager oo.pp, Contract Code), ready to address the new complexities and challenges that have been emerging in recent years. ![Logo network GePROPI]( ## Accreditamento SNA È stata **approvata** da SNA l’istanza di accreditamento per le attività formative in materia di contratti pubblici, ai sensi del decreto del Presidente della Scuola Nazionale dell’Amministrazione n. 22 del 13 febbraio 2024. ## The GePROPI Net offers: - ### 4 days of SPECIFIC TRAINING designed to strengthen the application of quality (and expertise) in the areas of infrastructure, public works, PPP/project finance, assets and procurement - ### 2 days of JOINT THEMATIC SESSIONS Designed to strengthen the application of quality (and expertise) in the areas of infrastructure, public works, PPP/project finance, assets and procurement. - ### 2 days of COACHING (individual support) On ongoing or start-up projects in public bodies, focusing on issues such as public works, infrastructure, asset management and complex contract-tenders such as PPP and Project Finance. - ### GePROPI CLUSTERS Based on the participants' work field, it will be possible to create customized clusters. In these clusters, participants will have the opportunity to share experiences through joint meetings organized in DISCUSSION TABLES. ## GePROPI Net meetings 16 - 19 September 2025 ### Specific training 13 - 14 November 2025 ### Joint thematic sessions 11 - 12 December 2025 ### Coaching ### Who should apply Il GePROPI Net è rivolto a professionisti provenienti da diversi ambiti della Pubblica Amministrazione — Enti Locali, Aziende Sanitarie, Università, altre stazioni appaltanti — e da operatori economici coinvolti nella realizzazione di opere e infrastrutture. In particolare, si rivolge a: - Dirigenti, quadri e funzionari pubblici. - Responsabili Unici di Progetto (RUP) e RASA. - Project manager pubblici e privati impegnati in contratti di lavori e servizi. - Società di progetto operanti in partenariati pubblico-privato, concessioni e contratti a lungo termine. - Consulenti di amministrazioni pubbliche e operatori economici. - Partecipanti, passati, presenti

I fondi sono quelli da prevedere obbligatoriamente (rif. art. 45, comma 2 del D.Lgs 36/2023) nel quadro economico di ciascuna opera pubblica ed infrastruttura (cfr. D.lgs 36/2023, art. 45 comma 5, comma 7 lettera a), b); Destinatari: allegato I.10; Voce del Quadro Economico: allegato I.7, art. 5 comma 1 punto 10) e, se non impiegati, potrebbero essere persi. Il D.lgs 36/2023, inoltre, rende obbligatorio ed auspicabile per il RUP e per il Project manager-RUP la formazione permanente e costante (art. 15 comma 5 e 7; art. 63 comma 7; allegato 1.2, art. 4 comma 1 e comma 4). Non si tratta quindi di fondi gestiti dal servizio formazione dell’ente, ma trovano - o potrebbero trovare - collocazione all’interno del quadro economico del singolo progetto di opera pubblica. ### The Topics The topics of the training days and discussion tables will be shared with the people and entities that will attend the course. The topics will include: ### Application of project management techniques and tools to public and private contracts. ### Setting up and managing Long-Term Contracts (LTC) ### Evaluation and assembly of PPP/PF, dividing them into different fundamental variables ### Digitization and effective application of BIM methodology. ### Regulatory news GEPROPI Net ## Information and registration ### Headquarters ### Corporate share ### Calendar ### How to enroll ### Information and registration ## Governance - Remo Dalla Longa Director **Area:** Government, Health and Not for Profit **Research domains:** Business Government Relations remo.dallalonga@unibocconi.it ![Remo Dalla Longa]( - Fabio Amatucci Affiliate Professor **Area:** Government, Health and Not for Profit **Research domains:** Business Government Relations fabio.amatucci@unibocconi.it ![Fabio Amatucci]( ### Scientific Direction and Steering Committee - [Niccolò Cusumano\\ \\ **Knowledge group:** Government, Health and Not for Profit\\ \\ **Research domains:** Business Government Relations\\ \\ niccolo.cusumano@unibocconi.it\\

Through advanced research and high-level training, the network provides a unique opportunity for dialogue, continuous learning, and the development of innovative strategies to address market challenges. ###### Network meetings The meetings are structured to offer a variety of learning and interaction formats: - **Informing**: Online sessions for strategic updates and scenario analysis. - **Reflecting**: In-person meetings with experts for in-depth thematic exploration. - **Experimenting**: Hands-on workshops to develop operational strategies. - **Leadership** **Team**: Sessions dedicated to top executives to tackle complex scenarios. ![logo_cergas]( ## The Network offers for MEMBERS: - ### 4 INFORMING meetings A format including 4 live synchronous online sessions focused on strategic INFORMATION and updates on key topics related to the Italian National Health Service (SSN) and the healthcare industry, open to all employees of member organizations. - ### 3 REFLECTING meetings Opportunities to attend in-person sessions with experts for deeper thematic discussions. - ### 1 EXPERIMENTING meeting A hands-on experience of strategic and operational planning through the development of a prototype for collaboration or partnership with a public healthcare provider. - ### 1 LEADERSHIP TEAM meeting Designed to support executive teams in analyzing scenarios and shaping business strategies. Format: Half-day session with CERGAS experts. The members of these strategic leadership teams constitute a community of practice capable of reinterpreting managerial challenges. The **DASP Network** acts as a platform that supports this process by providing insights derived from research activities, peer-to-peer dialogue, and exposure to international experiences. ![Network DASP]( ## Why the DASP Network? The Network of Directors of Public Healthcare Organizations is a physical and virtual space dedicated to the analysis, in-depth study, and discussion of phenomena that: - characterize the role and competencies of the General, Health Administrative and Social-Health Directors in Italian public healthcare organizations; - distinguish the management of healthcare organizations in achieving their goals under conditions of effectiveness, efficiency and sustainability; - influence the scenario and environment with which organizations engage and interact; - concern the contribution and motivation of people in corporate events and in the pursuit of corporate goals. ### POLIS Accreditation The DASP Network has been accredited as a training initiative for corporate strategic management teams, pursuant to Polis Lombardia Decree No. 933, 16 October 2019. The DASP Network represents an **experiential network** that focuses on the experiences of female directors in interpreting their role and corporate responsibility, supported by the expertise of SDA Bocconi faculty and the outcomes of Cergas Bocconi research. _"Management is a human practice that combines science, vision and common sense. When practised by the strategic apex, it can generate horizons of meaning (and of meaninglessness)."_ ## The DASP Network offers: - ### 4 meetings The format includes **four discussion meetings** held at SDA Bocconi, from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Each meeting is dedicated to exploring innovative managerial topics relevant to the roles and responsibilities of the strategic management and staff of healthcare organizations. - ### Case study in the OASI Report The opportunity to be featured as a **corporate case study in the OASI Report**, allowing preliminary discussion of Cergas SDA Bocconi’s research findings. - ### Field projects The chance to **participate in field projects** organized by EMMAS (Executive Master in Management of Healthcare Organizations). ### 4 discussion meetings Each meeting **will address topics selected by participating organizations upon registration**. The meetings will take place at SDA Bocconi’s Campus from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. and will include a networking lunch with faculty and participants to continue sharing themes, opinions, and experiences in corporate management. ###### **Presentation Event** [24 February ###### **Meetings dates** - Meeting 1: **27 March 2026** - Meeting 2: **18 May 2026** - Meeting 3: **25 September 2026** - Meeting 4: **9 November 2026** ![Network DASP]( ## Who should apply The DASP Network is designed for the **strategic management** teams of Italian Public Healthcare Organizations. text: - [Description](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-diss/#description) - [Structure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-diss/#structure) - [Governance](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-diss/#governance) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/network/network-diss/wishlist/) ![DISS]( # Network DISS Network di Direzione di Distretto Sociosanitario ##### Challenges and goals for DSS directors Healthcare The DISS Network, dedicated to Social and Healthcare District Directors, unites 25 high-level professionals and aims to build a solid community of Directors of Social and Healthcare Districts in Italian healthcare organizations. The community is recognized as a professional family with distinctive prerogatives and cutting-edge executive skills, promoting knowledge sharing, organizational practices and rituals, and discussing relevant and innovative topics connected to the ever-evolving context. As part of the transformation of community-based care services driven by the **National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR)** and **Ministerial Decree 77/22**, the **DSS (Social and Healthcare District)** is recognized as the primary organizational structure responsible for implementing and managing these innovations. It now plays a strategic role that in the past was often distributed among various institutional players. **DSS Directors** are now key figures in designing and executing the reorganization and development of territorial healthcare services, as well as managing innovations foreseen by the PNRR. These changes **require the development and enhancement of key functions and competencies, especially in managing complexity and transformation**. In fact, their role will be defined by challenges such as: - the heterogeneity of Social and Healthcare Districts (in terms of size and demographic, social, economic, and healthcare characteristics); - the need to handle broad management and coordination responsibilities; - the requirement to lead change and manage inter-institutional relationships effectively. ![Network DISS]( ## The DISS Network offers: - ### Creation of a dedicated non-institutional network - ### Sharing experiences through in-person meetings and an online platform - ### National and international speakers - ### Study tours and site visits to further explore innovative models - ### Community of Social and Health Care District (DSS) Directors with a unique identity, which continues to grow with alumni - ### Publication of key insights from the Network at the end of each two-year cycle ## Structure The Network runs over **two years**, with a total of **8 sessions** (4 per year). Sessions are held in-person at the SDA Bocconi Campus in Milano and Roma, and are complemented by study tours and site visits. Each year focuses on a **major thematic area**. text: - [Description](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-lops/#description) - [Program](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-lops/#program) - [Information](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-lops/#information) - [Governance](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-lops/#governance) [Apply Now](https://forms.sdabocconi.it/ep/2026/lops/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/network/network-lops/wishlist/) ![class]( # Network LOPS Logistica e operations del pronto soccorso Healthcare Established in 2023, the **LOPS Network** serves as a platform for dialogue and professional development for those who lead, manage, and design Emergency Department (ED) processes. Through a carefully designed combination of classroom teaching, experiential learning activities, and structured dialogue around national and international best practices, the Network supports ED leadership teams and coordinators in understanding the evolving healthcare landscape and advancing innovative managerial methods and tools to effectively govern and optimize Emergency Department operations. ![lops]( ### Why the LOPS Network The LOPS Network is a structured platform for professional dialogue and development designed for those who aim to: - Understand and anticipate the evolving trajectories of Emergency Departments within a rapidly changing regulatory and institutional landscape (DM77, 116117, PNRR, ministerial reforms, etc.) - Acquire, apply, and further innovate Operations Management methodologies and tools to address the core challenges facing Emergency Departments - Engage in peer exchange and test new managerial approaches ## The LOPS Network offers: - ### 5 workshop The format includes **5 meetings** at SDA Bocconi (10:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.) combining peer exchange and experiential learning. - ### Managerial innovation tools and strategies to enhance Emergency Department logistics and operations - ### System scenarios dialogue with key stakeholders to analyze ongoing system transformations (e.g., 116117, hospital system reforms, etc.) and assess their impact on ED management - ### Interactive methodology workshop-based sessions designed to foster peer benchmarking and hands-on learning ## 5 discussion workshops The LOPS Network is designed for **professionals and organizational teams** involved in **Emergency Department leadership and coordination, Nursing and Medical Leadership, Operations Management, Management Control, and Regional 118 Emergency Service management**. The format includes 5 workshops designed with a hands-on, lab-based approach, aimed at fostering interaction between participants and SDA Bocconi faculty, with a focus on industry dynamics and the promotion of executive innovation in the fields of logistics and operations. Each workshop combines theory, practice and exchange moments in an effective way and is divided into 6 steps: **Theoretical framework introduction and definition** by the course faculty **Group work** **Networking lunch** **Open discussion** on the topics addressed **Debriefing** and take home by the faculty **Post-event material sharing** and working document prepared by SDA Bocconi faculty. ![Network DASP]( ### Redesigning Emergency Department Processes for Long-Term Sustainability Now in its third edition, LOPS aims to further explore and develop—together with its Community—the innovation of emergency department processes, building on two key drivers. On the one hand, the opportunities enabled by technology (such as indoor navigation, telemedicine, and virtual assistants); on the other, the challenges arising from socio-demographic change (including population aging and growing social fragility). Each theme will be addressed across multiple sessions, allowing the Community to learn, experiment, and exchange insights on the application of methods and practices, in the spirit of a truly collaborative learning and transformation network. 9 June 2026 \| 10:00-16:00 ### 1\. Public management Planning, controlling and accounting for the activities carried out by public administrations is becoming increasingly complex due to the profound changes that are taking place. The implementation of reforms in recent years has shown a good ability by individual institutions to grasp the changes inspired by the many external stimuli, but it has also highlighted problems and critical issues which are not always adequately considered in institutional and academic circles. To respond to this concrete challenge - that of having discussions to improve, NETCAP Network Accounts & Checks in Public Administration was founded.aggiungi uno spazio The course was initially addressed to local governments, but the growing success has led us to extend participation to the Regions and central governments, with the aim of creating a synergistic collaboration. The lively participation obtained in previous years confirmed the validity of the formula: we brought together the knowledge of our researchers and lecturers, dedicated specifically to the public sector, with the experience of the Associated Public Bodies, with the conviction that the discussion and deepening of experiences help to facilitate the renewal and improvement of the planning, control and public finance processes. We have met, discussed and analyzed issues and experiences, providing innovative insight and concrete solutions. We have created a privileged relationship with Associates through the virtual community and the support of current information on the topics discussed. ![Logo NETCAP]( ## The NETCAP Network offers: - ### 5 meetings NETCAP organizes **5** annual **discussion days**. The first day coincides with a conference with free participation. - ### Providing COMPETENCES Innovation and updates of ongoing reforms in accounting, planning, control and finance, through the contribution of SDA Bocconi teachers and operators of the sector - ### Favoring DISCUSSIONS and the sharing of concrete experiences (benchlearning) between public and private sector actors, through meetings, workshops, targeted workshops, case studies, research and with the creation of a real Community (distance learning) - ### Giving voice to different INSTANCES of the operators of the Public Administrations, highlighting original solutions to common problems and choosing the topics to be covered in the classroom. ## 5 discussion meetings NETCAP organizes 5 annual comparison days. The first day coincides with a conference with free participation. The other four meetings have the following structure: - CHANGE MANAGEMENT section, which aims at describing the topic; - TOOLS section, which takes place in one or more parallel classrooms, with discussions on experiences and identification of operational tools; - PROBLEM SOLVING section, with plenary discussion and with the presence of relevant interlocutors, with respect to the subject matter. One day is dedicated to the Workshop, which provides a full immersion on a particularly relevant and highly topical issue, comparing ideas and experimenting

text: - [Goal](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-pari/#obiettivo) - [Activities](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-pari/#description) - [Meetings](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-pari/#program) - [Information](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-pari/#information) - [Governance](https://www.sdabocconi.it/network/network-pari/#governance) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/network/network-pari/downloadbrochure/) [Apply Now](https://forms.sdabocconi.it/ep/2026/pari/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/network/network-pari/wishlist/) ![PARI]( # Network PARI Public Affairs e relazioni istituzionali ##### In collaboration with Cattaneo, Zanetto, Pomposo & Co., a leading Italian company in the public affairs sector Public management The **PARI (Public Affairs and Institutional Relations) Network** was created as a response to the almost complete absence in Italy of spaces for reflection on the **management of the public affairs function**. It is designed for companies, institutions, trade associations, and nonprofit organizations interested in creating a space for dialogue and skill development in the field of institutional relations. The Network is evolving into a true community of professionals. Its goal is to explore and compare the effectiveness of models and tools for managing the corporate function responsible for relations with policymakers and regulators. While there are various occasions for discussing the role, competencies, and professional paths, there is a lack—unlike in other countries—of specific debate on the corporate dimension of this function and the management issues related to it, such as: - The role of the public affairs function in strategic planning - Criteria for choosing between make (in-house professionals) and buy (external specialists) - The choice between internalizing expertise and outsourcing to specialists. - Organizational structure and placement within the company. - **Budget-setting criteria**. - Metrics for monitoring and evaluating results - Issues related to recruiting and developing personnel in the public affairs function - Incentives for public affairs personnel - Differences in decision-making processes and institutional culture between Italy and other countries and the implications for designing the public affairs function - Coordination of public affairs in sectors with multi-level governance (State and Regions, or European Union and Member States) - Principles for coalition building and role distribution among stakeholders with converging interests - Models for effective collaboration between companies and trade associations in public affairs activities Despite significant progress in the professionalism of the public affairs function, conscious management of the choices that influence its effectiveness—particularly in terms of alignment with corporate strategic priorities—remains overlooked. It is therefore essential to promote the dissemination of best practices and the identification of significant innovations. The PARI Network – Public Affairs and Institutional Relations – offers an opportunity for dialogue and in-depth exploration, supported by SDA Bocconi research, aimed at developing relevant knowledge and skills in the field. ![Logo network PARI]( ## The PARI Network offers: - ### 3 THEMATIC WORKSHOPS Participate in 3 half-day thematic workshops, designed to foster dialogue between participants and SDA Bocconi researchers on the managerial issues of the public affairs function and to identify actionable solutions. - ### BENCHMARKING STUDY on the management models adopted by participating organizations. The study compares the benefits, limitations, and overall effectiveness of the adopted solutions, providing concrete insights for improvement. - ### Access to the PARI KNOWLEDGE BANK A dedicated repository collecting materials from all Network initiatives and useful documents to optimize the management of the public affairs function. - ### Personalized

title: Only when imagination takes the lead does managerial creativity flourish | SDA Bocconi
text: [![SDA Bocconi Insight Logo]( # Only when imagination takes the lead does managerial creativity flourish **03 December 2024**/By **[Gabriele Troilo](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?author=4436)**/6 minutes read ![SDA Bocconi Insight - placeholder podcast]( Companies expect their managers to be creative, meaning they must find innovative solutions to both recurring and new challenges. However, little attention is paid to the skill underpinning creativity: imagination. Imagination is the ability to construct new mental models in the absence of external stimuli—in other words, to envision new worlds or, in a business context, radically different business models, future markets, or products that today seem “unthinkable.” Unfortunately, the psychological traits associated with imagination—playfulness and open-mindedness—are rarely cultivated in corporate environments. Playfulness is not typically associated with professional behavior, while open-mindedness is often preached but seldom practiced. In this podcast (in Italian), [**Gabriele Troilo**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty/gabriele-troilo/), Marketing Professor at SDA Bocconi, explores imagination as a key driver of managerial creativity. **Authors** ###### Gabriele Troilo Marketing [View CV](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty-research/faculty-knowledge/gabriele-troilo/) ![Gabriele Troilo]( **Share** - [![il prezzo giusto]( [**The right price even in times of tariffs and **21 April 2026**/By [David Jarach](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?author=6937) [Marketing and business development](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?topic=5012) [Read more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/knowledge/the-right-price-even-in-times-of-tariffs-and-tensions/) - [![Sandro Castaldo]( [**Why “relationship” has become the watchword of **25 February 2026**/By [Sandro Castaldo](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?author=5111) [Marketing and business development](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?topic=5012) [Read more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/opinions/why-relationship-has-become-the-watchword-of-retail/) - [![La nuova fedeltà]( [**The new loyalty: digital becomes a strategic **23 February 2026**/By [Emanuele Acconciamessa](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?author=6324) [Marketing and business development](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/full-list/?topic=5012) [Read more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/sda-bocconi-insight/knowledge/the-new-loyalty-digital-becomes-a-strategic-enabler/) - [![Essenziale]( [**“Essential” or “if only I could”? title: Prodigy Finance | SDA Bocconi
text: # Prodigy Finance Students who have been admitted into one the following programs: MBA, MCF, MAMA, GEMBA are eligible to apply for the **Prodigy Finance Loan Program**, which offers an innovative way to finance your studies. Prodigy Finance offers loans funded by the School itself and other investors. These loans are available to international students from over 150 nationalities. ![MBA]( Students are eligible for a loan only if they reside outside Italy at the time of application. Any application for a loan made from within the Italian territory and/or by students currently residing in Italy will be rejected by Prodigy. Interest rates vary depending on individual applicants. See more details about the terms and conditions, and how to apply for a loan on [Prodigy’s website](https://prodigyfinance.com/get-a-loan/sda-bocconi-school-of-management/loan). Main features of the Prodigy Finance - SDA Bocconi Loan Program: - 150 nationalities covered - Competitive interest rates - Maximum loan size up to 100% of the cost of the program, although loans will be adjusted according to the profile of each individual applicant - No collateral or guarantees required - Easy online process - No payment due until six months after your graduation. The repayment period can be either 7, 10 years or 15 years, depending on your program and application. Apply directly through [Prodigy online platform](https://prodigyfinance.com/get-a-loan/sda-bocconi-school-of-management/loan). For further information please refer to the [FAQ section](https://support.prodigyfinance.com/hc/en-us/) on Prodigy Finance’s website. Want to know more? [Prodigy online platform](https://prodigyfinance.com/get-a-loan/sda-bocconi-school-of-management/loan) ![app]( ![Merchandising](

text: - [Goal](https://www.sdabocconi.it/programma-executive-management-del-calcio/#program) - [Who should apply](https://www.sdabocconi.it/programma-executive-management-del-calcio/#fa-per-te-se) - [Contents](https://www.sdabocconi.it/programma-executive-management-del-calcio/#contenuti) - [Calendar and information](https://www.sdabocconi.it/programma-executive-management-del-calcio/#informazioni) **BY FIGC (Italian Football Federation) IN PARTNERSHIP WITH SDA BOCCONI** # Executive program in "Football Management" _Start_ 17 March 2026 _End_ 26 June 2026 _Duration_ 18 Days _Where_ Milano _Linguage_ Italian ![calcio_italiano_774]( ### The need It is no longer just a matter of technical skill. By now, the management of a football club has long required executive skills comparable in all respects to those of an enterprise in which the strategic asset is human capital. Success in sports (too) is increasingly dependent on management equipped with the knowledge and tools to meet the new big challenges, on the field and beyond. ### The opportunity The Executive Program in Football Management, of the [FIGC Technical Department](https://www.figc.it/it/tecnici/) carried out in partnership with SDA Bocconi, aims to be the benchmark for **improving knowledge and skills for the management of professional organizations in football**. The objective of the Program is to provide managers and professionals of football clubs with the most useful executive tools to improve the quality of their choices. It aims to disseminate the most advanced executive knowledge in the world of football to help improve the performance of tangible and intangible assets, define innovative planning with all stakeholders in the football ecosystem, and work following principles of sustainability, enhancing the technical and human components of football. More information is available on the Italian Football Federation's website ### Why choose it? The Program in Football Management gives you the best methodological tools to govern complexity and make informed and effective decisions. In particular, it will help you to: - **Decide** which actors to relate to in the marketing perspective (fans, sponsors, and broadcasters). - **Identify** the best strategies for brand enhancement of a club or athlete. - **Define** a club's fan journey and communication tools in light of digital transformation. - **Outline** the organizational structure of a club. - **Evaluate** the potential and development of people working in a club and manage their behavior and performance, fostering the creation of an organizational environment suitable for the enhancement of individuals. - **Negotiate** with various players in the sports ecosystem. Establish economic-financial goals to be achieved over a given time horizon, meeting the constraints of financial fair play and identifying specific actions for revenue growth and cost containment. - **Choose** the most suitable technologies for the creation of a "data analytics" system functional for the development of athletes' performance and improvement of certain processes. Set a club sustainability policy geared toward medium- to long-term economic, social and environmental development, while also enhancing the educational function of football within the community. - **Understand** the interventions needed to ensure the environmental sustainability of their sports facilities while creating value for the community. ![Fa per te se]( ## Who should apply As stated in the FIGC notice, the Program is addressed to: All FIGC MEMBERS in particular: **Sports directors** **Coaches** **Other figures** with a qualified sports and/or professional background including: **Managers** of professional and amateur

text: ![premiazione bpa 2024]( # Best Performance Award 2018 Edition I vincitori dell’edizione 2018 ### Categoria Best Performer of the Year EPTA S.P.A. L’azienda è attiva nel settore della refrigerazione industriale e commerciale. La produzione varia dal piccolo frigorifero fino a grandi impianti dei supermercati e grandi centri di distribuzione refrigerata. La società è familiare ed è controllata da 2 famiglie. Ad oggi impiega 5000 persone ed è presente in tutto il mondo con 11 siti produttivi. È forte l’attenzione alle risorse dipendenti, con EPTAcademy offre formazione a circa 100 persone. Inoltre, ha un focus particolare su innovazione ed efficienza energetica grazie a sistemi a refrigerante naturale esclusivi e brevettati, che hanno già ricevuto diversi riconoscimenti a livello internazionale, tra cui i RAC Cooling Industry Awards in UK e il recente Deutscher Kältepreis del Ministero dell’Ambiente tedesco. ![vincitori bpa 2019]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2018 ### Categoria Best Performing Large Company BIESSE GROUP S.P.A. L’azienda è attiva nel settore meccanico, si occupa della produzione di macchinari per la lavorazione di legno, materiali avanzati, vetro, pietra e metallo. La società conta circa 4200 dipendenti e 39 filiali nel mondo. È quotata e quindi obbligata alla redazione del bilancio sociale. Ha un focus particolare sull’innovazione, con più di 300 persone coinvolte nelle attività di Ricerca e Sviluppo e collaborazioni con altri protagonisti del settore attraverso network e progetti di lavoro che uniscono esperti, centri di ricerca e Università sia in Italia che all’estero. ![vincitori bpa 2018]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2018 ### Categoria Best Performing Medium Company IRRITEC S.P.A. L’azienda di origine sicula è attiva nel settore dell’irrigazione tramite la logica di smart irrigation, che opera “a goccia”. È uno dei cinque maggiori player del settore dell’irrigazione nel mondo con una forte dedizione all’ambiente, ai temi del sostenibile e di utilizzo di energia verde; infatti, ha installato impianti fotovoltaici in tutti i siti e ha definito policy aziendali dedicate al recupero del materiale plastico presso l’agricoltore. La società ha intrapreso un percorso di digital transformation che la sta guidando verso il modern manufacturing, oltre all’implementazione di soluzioni avanzate come l’hybrid cloud. ![vincitori bpa 2018]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2018 ### Categoria Best Performing Small Company HAEMOTRONIC S.P.A. L’azienda è attiva nella produzione di dispositivi monouso in plastica ad uso medico e farmaceutico. Negli ultimi anni è stato forte l’impegno sul fronte dell’innovazione e ambientale a partire dall’interconnessione completa dalla produzione alla logistica in ottica di industry 4.0, attività di efficientamento energetico ed utilizzo di energie rinnovabili fino ad arrivare allo sviluppo di prodotti di nuova concezione per mantenere la flessibilità rispetto alle esigenze dei clienti. ![vincitori bpa 2018]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2018 ### Categoria Hot Topic “From steady to ready: Best Equity Capital Strategy” EOLO S.P.A. Eolo S.p.A. ha sede a Busto Arsizio e opera nel settore delle telecomunicazioni nel campo fixed wireless. L’azienda fornisce connessione Internet tramite antenne radio. In questo modo, Eolo è in grado di portare la connessione nelle regioni appennine ed alpine non ancora raggiunte dalle tecnologie ad oggi esistenti. L’azienda è controllata da un fondo. È forte l’attenzione al welfare e al benessere dei dipendenti, con programmi per lo sviluppo dello smart working, e mense aziendali gratuite, oltre a spazi di aggregazione e collaborazione come l’Eolo Bar e lo Spazio Eolo Garden. title: BPA edition 2019 | SDA Bocconi
text: ![premiazione bpa 2024]( # Best Performance Award 2019 Edition I vincitori dell’edizione 2019 ### Categoria Best Performer of the Year VALAGRO S.P.A. Azienda leader nella produzione e commercializzazione di biostimolanti e nutrienti speciali che stimolano i processi fisiologici della pianta a cui forniscono tutti gli elementi nutritivi di cui hanno bisogno per crescere. L’azienda investe circa il 6/7% del fatturato a favore della Ricerca e Sviluppo e ha istituito un Advisory Board Scientifico con lo scopo di individuare le eccellenze nei settori di maggior interesse. L’economia circolare è parte integrante del modello di business di Valagro, che rintraccia le materie prime in scarti dell’industria agroalimentare. Il ridotto impatto ambientale è sempre stato al centro delle politiche aziendali, pur operando in un settore fortemente estrattivo responsabile di emissioni CO2. L’obiettivo che si pone dunque l’azienda è quello di agevolare i clienti finali nel produrre di più, meglio e con minore impatto ambientale. Valagro ha inoltre organizzato varie iniziative per valorizzare il territorio in cui opera, tra le quali “Habruzzo” e “Ortiamo”. Dal 2002 ha attivato le prime acquisizioni strategiche finalizzate ad acquisire target di tecnologie per avere accesso a nuovi mercati ed Instaurare relazioni di lungo periodo con centri di eccellenza. La società ha recentemente aperto il capitale al fondo americano Metalmark. Valagro riserva una costante attenzione verso il benessere dei propri lavoratori, sostenuti da incentivi, meccanismi di feedback cadenzati e la fruizione di un programma di formazione ad hoc. ![vincitori 2019]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2019 ### Categoria Best Performing Large Company SIT S.P.A. Azienda che opera nel settore del riscaldamento, sviluppa e produce sistemi per la sicurezza, per il comfort e apparecchiature a gas per uso domestico e per la ristorazione; inoltre produce e commercializza contatori per il gas di nuova generazione. Il 65% del fatturato è realizzato al di fuori dell’Italia (Europa 41,3 %; Resto del Mondo 23,7 %). Sit è impegnata nella realizzazione di prodotti a basso impatto ambientale, nel ridurre il consumo di energia e nello sviluppo di sistemi per un’alta efficienza di combustione e un basso livello di inquinamento dell’aria. Possiede quattro sedi di Ricerca e Sviluppo con 100 persone dedicate, 90 brevetti depositati e 10,8€ milioni investiti; parallelamente una parte della crescita dell’azienda è stata perseguita tramite acquisizioni di aziende medio piccole, ma ad alto contenuto tecnologico. L’università di Padova rappresenta un forte vivaio per attrarre risorse, l’azienda infatti organizza giornate di orientamento nelle quali, in maniera informale, gli studenti vengono formati e indirizzati a preparare correttamente i colloqui. La società si è quotata nel 2017. ![vincitori bpa 2019]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2019 ### Categoria Best Performing Medium Company FLUID-O-TECH S.P.A. text: 2017. ![vincitori bpa 2019]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2019 ### Categoria Best Performing Medium Company FLUID-O-TECH S.P.A. Azienda attiva nella progettazione e produzione di pompe per pressurizzazione e trasferimento di fluidi, conta circa 200 collaboratori ed è presente in Italia, con lo stabilimento principale a Corsico, negli Stati Uniti, sia sulla costa orientale che occidentale, in Giappone e Cina. Negli ultimi anni, sta implementando un modello sempre più strutturato di corporate governance, mantenendo un’attenzione elevata al rapporto azienda-famiglia. L’azienda si è attivata per la creazione di una divisione dedicata di Ricerca e Sviluppo e ha investito risorse per la cybersecurity e la protezione dati. Fluid-o-tech, per aumentare il proprio know how tecnologico, ha acquisito due società inglesi. Visto il rallentamento del settore automotive, specialmente tedesco, legato alla regolamentazione sulle emissioni, la società sta cercando di diminuire l’esposizione verso questo settore e spingersi verso il medicale con nuove soluzioni innovative. ![vincitori bpa 2019]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2019 ### Categoria Best Performing Small Company SAFIM S.P.A. Azienda che opera nel mercato dei costruttori di valvole di frenatura. I principali settori di applicazione sono: agricolo, movimentazione terra e materiali, minerario, aeroportuale e delle spazzatrici stradali. Pur essendo basata in Italia, Safim è rappresentata all’estero da uffici strategici (USA, India, Germania, Francia). L’azienda ha scelto di crescere su larga scala nel 2017 con l’ingresso nell’azionariato del fondo di investimento Ambienta SGR, che affianca la famiglia Mamei. La società investe il 4% del fatturato annuo in attività di Ricerca & Sviluppo. L’innovazione attiene sia la sfera interna, attraverso l’implementazione di prodotti che possono essere brevettati e commercializzati, sia quella esterna attraverso possibili acquisizioni, con partnership strategiche nel settore, previste in futuro. Per quanto riguarda la sostenibilità, Safim soddisfa il 20-25% del proprio fabbisogno energetico attraverso un impianto fotovoltaico tra i più grandi della regione Emilia-Romagna, i prodotti utilizzati per le verniciature sono ad acqua e redigerà quest’anno un bilancio di sostenibilità e un bilancio ambientale. L’azienda è attiva nella formazione dei propri dipendenti, promuovendo corsi di formazione in grado di creare profili professionali di eccellenza, e nel benessere della work-life balance di questi ultimi. ![vincitori bpa 2019]( I vincitori dell’edizione 2019 ### Categoria Hot Topic “Managerial Excellence” ZUCCHETTI S.P.A Azienda italiana che produce soluzioni software, hardware e servizi per aziende, banche, assicurazioni, professionisti e associazioni di categoria. L’azienda ha l’obiettivo di crescere nei prossimi anni anche tramite acquisizioni in Italia e all’estero. La società, pur essendo di proprietà famigliare (di proprietà 50% Alessandro Zucchetti e 50% Cristina Zucchetti), ha da tempo deciso di introdurre manager esterni in posizioni apicali. Per Zucchetti la Ricerca e Sviluppo è fondamentale: ogni divisione del gruppo ha un budget di R&S e dispone di persone dedicate, infatti su 5000 dipendenti 1200 si occupano di queste attività; inoltre ha creato un team di data scientist che studia le ultime innovazioni e la possibile applicazione dell’intelligenza artificiale in azienda. The Best Performance Award is the annual award dedicated to Italian companies, which stand out for excellence in sustainable development understood in a broad sense, that is, as the ability to do business while ensuring business continuity (a necessary condition) in compliance with: - human and environmental dimensions (Green & Social); - innovation (Innovation & Technology); - economic management (Value Added). ![Logo BPA]( ## The five awards The **Best Performance Award** is conferred on Italian companies with revenues between 15 mln and 5 bn euros. To ensure a fair comparison, three **different size categories** were created **(Small, Medium and Large Company).** Each of the categories is given an award. There is also an award for the **best company in the sample regardless of size**. In addition to these, a fifth award is established to be given to the company that has distinguished itself in a **hot topic** decided annually by the Partners based on the year's major trends. - ### Award by size - Best Performing **Small** Company - Best Performing **Medium** Company - Best Performing **Large** Company - ### Best Company Award Best Performer **of the Year** - ### Award for the best company on a hot topic The Hot Topic of the 2025/2026 edition is “ **Scenari Macroeconomici Globali e Resilienza**’” ## Entry requirements ### Dimensional criteria: - Small: € 15-50 mln - Medium: € 51-100 mln - Medium-Large: € 101 mln – 5 bn ### Performance criteria: Performance criteria: - EBITDA margin above that of the industry average - Revenue growth above that of the industry average - Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/embe/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Francesca Roveda** is here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education—we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Francesca at [francesca.roveda@sdabocconi.it](mailto:francesca.roveda@sdabocconi.it). ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. Here, you don’t just learn—you live the experience. - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( - ![EMBE experience]( ## Student Clubs **Clubs** are a key part of the SDA Bocconi experience, fostering connections and sparking new ideas through exchanges among students, Faculty, Alums, and industry professionals. Arts, sports and events _Start_ Passed _Duration_ 16 months _Where_ Lausanne / Milano / Paris / Riyadh / Roma / Online _Format_ Executive _Language_ English The **Executive Master in Business of Events (EMBE)** is designed for Sports, Entertainment and Exhibitions Industries. It is a global experience taught over 16 months across 5 cities throughout Europe and the Middle East. EMBE is a unique program that offers participants with profound **exploration of the ecosystems** that scaffold the **events industry**, combining the managerial and entrepreneurial dimensions. The Advisory Council, global leaders with unique experiences in the field, and the Faculty will discuss theoretical models and empirical examples from leading companies and organizations to unfold and examine different dimensions of the complexity of the industry. For Academic purposes in collaboration with EMBE ![For_academiuc_purposes_logos]( - ### Word from the Director ![EMBE direttore]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/embe/video-gallery/) ![MBA - Who is it for?]( ## Who is it for The ideal candidate has international professional experience preferably in event related organizations (e.g. media companies, sports event organizations, entertainment companies and events agencies) and embraces the multicultural context of the international events industry. The ideal candidate should also have a strong desire to: **Become** an executive in event with enlarged perspectivesfor different industries **Develop** a business of events acumen **Generate** value drawing on sustainable principles **Experience** a top ranked School with connections worldwide **Nurture** its proactive mindset and seek out entrepreneurial opportunities **Make** a career switch towards the event business **Learn** from the Olympic knowledge, heritage and values 22 Students 34 years Average age 55 % Women [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/embe/class-profile/) ## Why EMBE - ### Develop a business event acumen The business of events is more than organizing the events. It is about having the right approach for an entrepreneurial and proactive mindset so that you can create additional values for the events you manage. - ### Access to international, high-profile networks Four countries. Five cities. Endless contacts. The program will connect you to established and growing markets of events and will interconnect you with the network of the key leaders of the industry. - ### Get a practical, hands-on perspective on events The program framework integrates managerial and entrepreneurial skills, offering a pragmatic, applied approach across various industry sectors. - ### Embrace the event mindset The event mindset is not only a business mindset. It involves a wide range of perspectives. You will develop a set of essential skills, tools and techniques to navigate the complex world of events. - ### Adopt a long-term vision of events Events should go beyond a moment in time. You will develop specific core competencies and soft skills that will leave a positive impact: a legacy that will last much longer than the event itself. ## Highlights - 6 Face-to-face modules

text: Executive Master in Finance [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/it_IT/courses/course/26-emf-executive-master-finance) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/wishlist/) EMF # C-Suite Forum The **EMF C-suite Forum** is an opportunity for dialogue and interaction on the phenomenon of business innovation with the top management of leading corporations and financial institutions representing the specializations of the Executive Master in Finance. Its objective is to foster a debate on business innovation, reflect on its underlying drivers, and explore how its impacts are managed within companies. The event takes the form of a discussion panel attended by EMF participants, who will engage in a Q&A session. Additional engagement takes place through preparatory studies, carried out in direct collaboration with participating companies, which culminate in a group report on business innovation across the relevant industries. ![emf_c-suite-forum-live-2025.jpg ]( ## Design Philosophy ### Why discuss Finance and Technology for value creation? Technology, strategic architecture, governance models, leadership styles, and the hard skills of talent are some of the levers companies use to innovate and reinvent themselves in order to create sustainable value. Implementing new and adaptable business models is a critical success factor for pursuing effective strategies capable of achieving corporate goals and ensuring long-term value creation. ![news_EMF_c-suite_29102025_13]( ## How? The class, gathered around the worktable in an interactive format (Forum), will discuss the initiative’s main topics with the support of moderators and technical tools provided during the program. Key questions include: - Does the evolution of the regulatory framework facilitate or hinder technological innovation within Corporates and Financial Institutions? - What are the challenges and opportunities for finance in managing technology within businesses across the EMF specialization tracks? - What are the expected short- and long-term costs and benefits of implementing technological innovation? - How does technology influence corporate financing decisions? - What are the main implications of integrating technological innovation into the transformation of business models and value chains? - These are some of the questions that EMF C-Suite Forum class will explore. ## What is the goal? Through this initiative, the EMF team aims to gather and understand the visions and challenges highlighted by the C-suite of Corporates and Financial Institutions regarding how technological innovation is influencing finance, strategy, and the management of successful companies—also considering its role within the broader value chain. The EMF C-Suite Forum constitutes the final part of the EMF project work, in which participants are involved through preparatory studies conducted also via direct interaction with participating companies. These activities lead to the development of a group report on Finance and Technology for Value Creation within the relevant industries. Specifically, the EMF project work consists of three phases: **EMF Assignment** Conducted within the courses Innovation in Finance Lab and Strategic Finance Lab, these assignments represent the preparatory work for the EMF C-Suite Forum and are presented to launch the participants’ activities. **EMF C-Suite Forum** During the Forum, the C-suite representatives of participating companies will debate the various topics under investigation. **EMF C-Suite Report – Finance and Technology for Value Creation** A document summarizing the key insights and

Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. title: EMF - Experience | SDA Bocconi
text: **Clubs** are a key part of the SDA Bocconi experience, fostering connections and sparking new ideas through exchanges among students, Faculty, Alums, and industry professionals. Led by students, they require strong management skills to secure funding, develop business plans, and handle relationships with the press and private firms, making them a dynamic platform for learning and collaboration. ### Professional - ![consulting-club_logo]( Fosters interaction between aspiring consultants and the industry, offering resources and networking occasions to enhance skills and foster valuable relationships in management consulting. - ![entrepreneurship-club]( Gathers students passionate about new businesses, technology and innovation, encouraging business creation, innovative ideas, and a startup mindset for personal and professional success. - ![financeclub]( Focuses on finance knowledge, training, and networking. Provides workshops, events, and resources to deepen financial expertise and prepare members for success in diverse finance roles. - ![healthcare-club]( Aims to broaden understanding of the healthcare industry and career, bridging theory and practice through networking, workshops, company visits, seminars and collaboration with experts. - ![lux_club_logo]( Delves into luxury and arts industries with hands-on exposure and a deeper insight into the field, broadening knowledge of high-end markets, cultural expressions, and brand strategies. - ![sustainable-industry-and-energy_logo]( Promotes knowledge and awareness of sustainability across all industries, strengthening relationships with key sectors that play a crucial role in fighting climate change. - ![tech-club_logo]( Gathers tech enthusiasts eager to explore emerging technologies, collaborate on digital solutions, and connect with industry pioneers, fostering a forward-thinking culture of innovation. ### Social Impact - ![ethicaclub]( Promotes ethical thinking and responsible leadership, guiding members to incorporate integrity, transparency, social responsibility, and a commitment to charity and giving back into business. - ![out_club_logo]( Elevates LGBTQIA+ visibility and inclusivity in business, providing supportive networks and alliances that foster respectful work environments and advocate for equality for all professionals. - ![club_women_in_business_logo]( Empowers women’s leadership through mentorship, networking, and development programs, equipping future leaders to overcome barriers and stereotypes and achieve gender parity in business. ### Sport & Leisure - ![sailing-club]( Leverages sailing as a leadership tool, orchestrating regattas, training, social gatherings and events to strengthen communication, strategic thinking, and team spirit on and off the water. - ![ski-club]( Gathers skiers and snowboarders for trips, competitions, and shared experiences in the mountains, using the slopes to foster community spirit and cultivate an active, adventurous mindset. ## Ambassador Reach out to our ambassadors for first-hand insights. However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![EMF graduation]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the EMF 2027-2028 program is €40,000 (outside the scope of VAT), payable in four installments. - First installment **€ 10,000** upon enrollment - Second installment **€ 10,000** by 31 March 2027 - Third installment **€ 10,000** by 30 June 2027 - Fourth installment **€ 10,000** by 30 September 2027 **The fee includes:** - Teaching materials - Leader series activities - HR series - Coaching - Media Experience Lab - EMF C-suite forum - Refinitiv platform (EMF's training partner) - Applications provided by the teaching project (JMP, Crystal Ball, MATLAB... - School equipment, including a light dinner offered on Friday evening and during full week when necessary for teaching purposes. Participants must have a personal laptop. Applications will be evaluated on the basis of:** - academic and professional curriculum; - requirements stated in the notice; - results of selection tests at EMF; - interview with EMF management. Admission to EMF is independent of whether a scholarship or tuition waiver is awarded. The tuition waiver will be awarded during the selection process within the round dates indicated in the announcement.

When submitting the admission application, the candidate may choose which Track to follow. The structure of each Track is divided into 3 parts: - **9 specialization courses** - **1 elective course** to complete the educational journey based on one’s skills and aspirations, chosen from the courses offered in the other Tracks - **1 Track-specific Business Simulation** aimed at applying all the tools and skills acquired ![aula SDA Bocconi]( ## The 4 EMF Tracks - ![emf_beltratti]( ###### Track in Asset/Wealth Management The [**Asset/Wealth Management Track**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/track/#track-asset-wealth-management) provides specialization in the Asset Management and Wealth Management sectors, which today rank among the leading financial industries worldwide. - ![img_sironi]( ###### Track in Banking & Insurance The [**Banking & Insurance Track**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/track/#track-in-banking-insurance) gives you a comprehensive overview of the complex management challenges faced by financial institutions, with a particular focus on banks and insurance companies. It offers a threefold perspective: - competitive and regulatory environment - organizational structure/areas of activity - strategy - ![micciche_img]( ###### Track in Corporate Finance & Control The [**Corporate Finance & Control Track**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/track/#track-in-corporate-finance-control) offers a 360-degree overview of the methods and tools typical of corporate finance and management control functions. It integrates expertise in financial reporting, management control, and corporate finance to support all phases of a company’s “life cycle”: start-up, organic and inorganic growth, maturity, and restructuring. - ![track_real_estate]( ###### Track in Corporate Finance & Real Estate The [**Corporate Finance & Real Estate is built on SDA Bocconi’s thirty years of research and teaching experience in the real estate sector. It offers participants the opportunity to specialize in corporate finance and the real estate industry by analyzing the transformation of business models, operational logics, and investment, financing, and management strategies. Particular focus is placed on the impact of finance on the industry from the perspective of banks, investors, and both real estate and non–real estate companies. ### Track in Asset/Wealth Management By choosing from a range of offered courses, you will be able to specialize in the production or distribution aspects of financial products and services. **Objectives** - Deepen your understanding of the main management techniques used in the international industry - Provide knowledge and tools useful for managing financial portfolios - Develop distinctive skills in the Asset/Wealth Management industries ![emf_beltratti]( ##### The structure of the Asset/Wealth Management Track is divided into two parts: 1A + 2A and the Business Simulation. - ### 1A - Asset/Wealth Management This part includes the core courses of the specialization: - Business strategy in asset management - Regulation - Risk management - Factor and long run investing - Exchanges and trading venues - Alternative and real assets - Portfolio optimisation & LDI - Household finance - Customer centricity - Private banking - ### 2A - Elective Courses You may choose one of the following courses offered by the other EMF

text: Using a well-established group business game, participants will reflect on the levers available to a bank and the constraints imposed by the market - competitors and clients - as well as by regulation. The final goal of the simulation is essentially to reproduce the work of an investment banking team specialized in FIG within the context of a hypothetical mandate to analyze the potential acquisition of a company operating in the banking sector. Participants will develop and present: the investment rationale, the impacts of the transaction, the key valuation considerations, the structure of the deal. ### Track in Corporate Finance & Control **Objectives** - Provide financial and economic training to support corporate strategy. - Equip participants with the skills and tools needed to invest in, manage, and develop companies. - Develop the ability to govern corporate finance, treasury, and risk management. ![micciche_img]( ##### The structure of the Track is divided into two parts: 1A + 2A and the Business Simulation. - ### 1A - Corporate Finance & Control This part includes the core courses of the specialization: - Planning & control - Advanced corporate finance & valuation - Taxation & business combination - Advanced management accounting - Private equity and venture capital - Extraordinary financial transactions - Asset and debt restructuring - Internal auditing and control - Infrastructure & project financing - ### 2A - Elective Courses You may choose one of the following offered by the other EMF specialization tracks: - Business strategy in real estate - Banks and insurance transformation and turnaround - Household finance - ### Business simulation applied Private Equity The objective of the Applied Private Equity business simulation is to integrate and apply all the concepts learned in the Corporate Finance & Control Track, engaging participants in the development of a project of professional quality. The simulation is the primary tool for assessing understanding of the discipline and for carrying out the analysis, study, and structuring of an M&A transaction from the perspective of a Private Equity operator. Key activities include: analysis of the business model, evaluation of synergies, definition of assumptions, preparation of the business plan, assessment of operational and financial risks, economic–financial planning, investment decision-making, negotiation post-deal management. These steps allow participants to “drive” their strategy and achieve business objectives. The Track concludes with the presentation of the assignment and a discussion of the actions taken before an evaluation committee and the EMF class. ### Track Corporate Finance & Real Estate **Objectives** - Provide industry-specific economic and financial training. - Equip participants with advanced and cross-functional skills and tools to invest in, manage, and develop real estate assets. - Build managerial and leadership capabilities in real estate and infrastructure. ![track_real_estate]( ##### The structure of the Track is divided into two parts: 1A + 2A and the Business Simulation. - ### 1A - Corporate Finance & Real Estate This part includes the core courses of the specialization: - Urban planning & regeneration value - Real estate investment - valuation & feasibility analysis - Real

The simulation serves as the main tool for evaluating mastery of the discipline. In this specific case, participants act as managers of an investment vehicle and are required to prepare a proposal for the acquisition of a property. They must develop a project that highlights its risk/return profile and outlines its management and value-enhancement plan over a predefined time horizon, based on the asset’s characteristics and investor return expectations. Key activities include: market analysis, identification of the optimal value-enhancement strategy, economic–financial planning. Finance and accounting _Start_ 8 February 2027 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Executive _Language_ Italian _Avg. working experience_ 10 years _Credits_ 62 ECTS/CFU The **Executive Master in Finance (EMF)** gives you all the tools you need to manage the challenges and take advantage of the opportunities in the world of finance. EMF is **a 12 month program**, in Italian, **alternating weekends**(62 CFU/ECTS) aimed at executive professionals who want to accelerate their careers while reconciling their professional activities. The educational project develops executive and leadership skills in the world of finance, while providing a high level of specialization in one of the **four different areas** characterizing the tracks: - [Asset/Wealth - [Banking & Insurance](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/track/#track-in-banking-insurance) - [Corporate Finance & - [Corporate Finance & Real [**Discover more**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/track/) Main partner ![LOGO INTESA SAN PAOLO]( Partner ![logo Deloitte]( Training Partner ![LSEG logo]( - ### Words from the protagonists ![Executive Master in Finance - Direttore]( - ### EMF C-suite Forum Live 2025 ![emf_c-suite-forum-live-2025.jpg ]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/video-gallery/) ![classe EMF]( ## Who is it for Future leaders ready to turn challenges into opportunities. The 60 days of classroom training spread over 22 weekends and two full-time weeks allow you to invest in your training while continuing your normal professional activity. You will then be able to gain an important competitive advantage in terms of knowledge, operational tools and relationships, expendable right away in your daily life. - ### To learn with "EMF flex-learning model" EMF provides an opportunity to manage the uncertainty associated with the inability to reach the SDA Bocconi Campus in physical presence. For proven and justified professional or medical reasons, EMF flex-learning is activated, which includes the ability to connect remotely without losing the opportunity to interact with Faculty and the EMF class group. - ### To develop the strategic perspective in finance EMF combines the rigor of learning the tools used in international best practices of professionals with methodologies firmly linked to economic and financial theory, and executive content that enables them to improve their performance in the company through experiential learning on issues of strategy (Strategic Finance Capstone), financial communication (Media Experience Capstone), negotiation, leadership & team building (Negotiation & Leadership Capstone). title: EMF Executive Master in Finance | SDA Bocconi
text: combines the rigor of learning the tools used in international best practices of professionals with methodologies firmly linked to economic and financial theory, and executive content that enables them to improve their performance in the company through experiential learning on issues of strategy (Strategic Finance Capstone), financial communication (Media Experience Capstone), negotiation, leadership & team building (Negotiation & Leadership Capstone). Leadership coaching (one-on-one activities) complements the educational project with the development of awareness of leadership style, the impact you have on others, and personal and professional strengths. - ### To enable "tailor-made" specialization EMF offers training tailored to your needs and aspirations with four different specialization tracks and the option to select one elective course. It combines SDA Bocconi university research and education with the best practice of companies, banks, investors and advisors, constantly drawing on professional operations. - ### To engage with frontier issues and innovative research Finance is a world that appears increasingly complex in structure, dynamics and interconnections. Understanding and managing this complexity requires specialized skills but also new conceptual models and professional approaches - ### To undertake career-switching A comprehensive training approach that pays attention to basic preparation as well as to specialized and leadership skills is EMF's trump card that you can play in your career in finance "tout court" (Investment Banking, Retail and Commercial Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Insurance), in the corporate sectors (Telecommunications, Media, Technology, Energy, Real Estate) and in consulting firms (Risk Consulting, Financial Advisory, Management Consulting). - ### To have academic excellence and global experience A large faculty composed of world-class academics and practitioners in close contact with leading companies, banks and investors, as well as a roster of leading guest speakers are a guarantee of the great value of a course like the Executive Master in Finance for a real change in professional perspective. - ### Being glocal: local community with global vision Access a very wide network of people around the world. Proximity and discussion with colleagues, faculty and guests form the basis of a network that offers valuable opportunities even after the Master through online activities and events of EMF CampUS the Community debating forum. - ### SDA Bocconi is an academic partner of the CAIA Association. The CAIA (Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst) Association offers 4 scholarships reserved for students of the Executive Master in Finance to support the CAIA certification exam. CAIA is the leading professional designation for those who wish to develop their careers in the field of alternative investments. Alternative investments include a wide range of emerging sectors in finance, such as Private Equity and Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, real estate investments, and Real Assets. The CAIA charter is awarded upon passing both levels of the exam and meeting the required professional experience. For more information: [http://www.caia.org/](http://www.caia.org/) ## Highlights - 62 ECTS/ CFU - 60 Days of training 22 weekends, two weeks full-time - 4 Specialization track in: Asset/Wealth Management Banking & Insurance Corporate Finance & Control Corporate Finance & Real Estate [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emf/track/)

We aim to ensure that EMiLUX is the right match for you and that it supports your goals, expectations, and career aspirations. Each year, this careful selection process builds a dynamic, international cohort of experienced professionals ready to take the next step in the luxury sector. **DEADLINES** **Tuition waivers** 1st round: 16 June 2026 2nd round: 26 November 2026 **Early Bird Fee** 15 September 2026 **Application** 26 November 2026 ![classe EMiLUX]( ## Your next steps - ### 1\.
