Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emilux/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![Classe EMiLUX]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the EMiLUX 2027-2028 program is € 46,000\*, payable in four installments - First installment **€ 11,500** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€ 11,500** by 26 March 2027 - Third installment **€ 11,500** by 16 July 2027 - Fourth installment **€ 11,500 (€ 7,500\*\*)** by 29 October 2027 \\* An “early bird fee” of € 42,000 will be granted to candidates that have enrolled and have paid the deposit fee before 15 September 2026. \*\*For "Early Birds" **Application fee: €120** The fees include: - Tuition - All teaching materials - Use of the infrastructure and services of SDA Bocconi - Catering (coffee breaks) during face-to-face modules The fees do no not include: - Travel and accommodation expenses Participants must provide their own laptop. **Early Bird Fee** SDA Bocconi offers an **Early Bird Fee** of **€42,000** for EMiLUX (full program fee: €46,000). The criteria for the early bird are the following: - Have completed the selection process; - Have been admitted by Recruiting & Admissions to the upcoming edition of the Master Program; - Have paid the first deposit fee of €11,500 on acceptance of your admission to the Master Program. All these requirements have to be completed **before 15 September 2026**. We invite you to apply on time. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round:_ 16 June 2026 _2nd round:_ 26 November 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for outstanding candidates, thanks to the ongoing support of companies, organizations, alums, and current students. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the EMiLUX selection process **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must:** - Submit their application for the EMiLUX 2027-2028 program - Review the pre-requisites for each tuition waiver - Flag the tuition waiver option through the online application portal by the indicated deadline **Important:** - Applicants will be considered eligible for a tuition waiver only after completing the EMiLUX application, including the online form and all supporting documents. - You can apply for scholarships and tuition waivers even if your selection process is still in progress. However, only admitted candidates will be evaluated for the awarding of a tuition waiver or scholarship. - If you meet multiple requirements, you may apply for more than one scholarship or tuition waiver. The tuition waivers will be awarded during the selection process and no later than the starting date of the EMiLUX 2027-2028 Program. Participants are encouraged to explore various funding opportunities available in different countries, such as employer sponsorships or scholarships

EMiLUX offers a unique opportunity to enhance your career in the luxury business by exploring **diverse cultural perspectives and markets**. Designed with utmost care, the program equips professionals with the skills and abilities needed to successfully meet the challenges of luxury: managing modern aspirations while preserving timeless values, combining aesthetic sensitivity and creativity with robust business processes and models. Through real-life examples, participants experience a careful blend of commitment to heritage and passion for modernity, journeying from historic luxury capitals such as Milan and Paris to fast-growing markets like Dubai. Throughout the journey, you will benefit from the academic excellence and industry insight of an international faculty, while gaining exposure to diverse cultural environments, emerging markets, innovative business models, and new luxury brands shaping the future of the industry. - ### Prestigious partnerships Collaborate with

text: Executive Master in Management delle Amministrazioni Pubbliche [Apply Now](https://admissions.unibocconi.it/admissions/Students/OpenFromExtUrl?concourseId=13936&ordType=) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/wishlist/) # Action Learning Projects (ALPro) ### Dall’esperienza d’aula al problem solving Gli Action Learning Project (ALPro) sono uno dei dispositivi didattici previsti all’interno del Master EMMAP e rappresentano un’occasione per i partecipanti per poter applicare le conoscenze e le competenze apprese nell’ambito del Master attraverso il confronto con "real-case scenarios". In particolare, attraverso gli ALPro, i partecipanti possono “toccare con mano” le sfide di cambiamento che caratterizzano enti diversi dalle organizzazioni di loro provenienza, sperimentando così il management pubblico all’interno di contesti differenti. Attraverso l’esperienza ALPro i partecipanti potranno: - Confrontarsi con una sfida manageriale per loro nuova; - Mettersi alla prova con un’attività di “diagnosi manageriale” delle dinamiche interne ed esterne che caratterizzano un contesto organizzativo diverso da quello di provenienza; - Identificare, insieme a un tutor della faculty EMMAP e ai manager pubblici che operano nell’organizzazione interessata, possibili futuri scenari di azione; - Proporre una soluzione o più soluzioni di intervento. - Rafforzare il loro network professionale, confrontandosi con manager di organizzazioni pubbliche e private. - Sperimentare quanto appreso nell’ambito del Master entrando in contatto con nuove realtà organizzative. ### Perché ospitare un ALPro nel tuo Ente? Candidando la tua organizzazione all’ALPro, potrai ricevere **una consulenza qualificata e gratuita** di quattro mesi (fine novembre 2025-marzo 2026) da parte dei diplomandi dell’edizione EMMAP in corso, coadiuvati da docenti della faculty EMMAP, su un progetto di cambiamento che desideri attuare all’interno del tuo ente. In particolare, potrai: - Ricevere un feedback esterno sul progetto e sulle sfide manageriali che intendi affrontare; - Ricevere una diagnosi del contesto interno ed esterno della tua organizzazione e delle dinamiche che lo caratterizzano; - Ricevere delle possibili linee e azioni di intervento da mettere in atto per la realizzazione del progetto; - Allargare il tuo network professionale. Puoi candidare progetti che riguardano tutti gli ambiti del public management: posizionamento strategico, riprogettazione di servizi, nuovi modelli organizzativi, mappatura e revisione dei processi, performance management, acquisti pubblici, sistemi di gestione del personale. Una volta ricevute le candidature, un comitato di valutazione (composto dal team di coordinamento e alcuni docenti della faculty EMMAP) valuterà e selezionerà i progetti ricevuti. In particolare, il comitato rifletterà **sul bisogno di cambiamento** delle organizzazioni proponenti e sulla **rilevanza delle sfide manageriali** proposte per i diplomandi EMMAP. Non farti sfuggire l’opportunità di ricevere **un feedback e un supporto qualificato** per accompagnare i processi di cambiamenti in atto all’interno della tua organizzazione! Le candidature sono rivolte ad organizzazioni pubbliche e organizzazioni private che si interfacciano con le dinamiche e con gli elementi di complessità che caratterizzano il management pubblico. Per candidarti, invia un’email a Francesco Vidè [(francesco.vide@sdabocconi.it](https://www.sdabocconi.it/(francesco.vide@sdabocconi.it) ) con i tuoi riferimenti e con la scheda di proposta che puoi trovare allegata. Il termine ultimo per l’invio della candidatura è il **venerdì 3 ottobre 2025**. Qualora la tua organizzazione venisse selezionata, verrai contattato per approfondire il tuo fabbisogno, condividere maggiori informazioni e avviare il lavoro. In particolare, si richiede

We assess not only whether you are the right profile for EMMAP, but also whether EMMAP meets your expectations. Admission is through a rigorous selection process that evaluates the professional background, motivation and personal aptitude of those who apply. Each year, EMMAP welcomes outstanding figures in PA: professionals, consultants, people in leadership and managerial roles, who choose to embark on the EMMAP journey with strong motivation and a cultural vision oriented towards change and innovation. Selection thus ensures the formation of a class group in which talented individuals can not only pursue their professional and personal goals but also enrich the on campus learning experience. **DEADLINES** **Tuition waivers** 1st round: 29 oct 2025 2nd round: 22 jan 2026 3rd round: 15 apr 2026 ![partecipanti EMMAP]( ## Your next steps - ### 1\. text: Executive Master in Management delle Amministrazioni Pubbliche [Apply Now](https://admissions.unibocconi.it/admissions/Students/OpenFromExtUrl?concourseId=13936&ordType=) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/wishlist/) # The EMMAP experience: learn, connect, transform - ![SDA Bocconi]( ## A world of perspectives: the value of diversity Diversity at SDA Bocconi is more than a value—it’s the driving force behind a transformative learning experience. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. title: PA 110 e lode: il cambiamento parte da te | SDA Bocconi
text: Executive Master in Management delle Amministrazioni Pubbliche [Apply Now](https://admissions.unibocconi.it/admissions/Students/OpenFromExtUrl?concourseId=13936&ordType=) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/wishlist/) # PA 110 e lode: il cambiamento parte da te Agevolazione del 30% sull'offerta formativa per la Pubblica Amministrazione ![pa_110_lode_logo]( SDA Bocconi continua a investire nello sviluppo delle competenze dei dipendenti della Pubblica Amministrazione per dare valore alla PA del futuro e contribuire alla crescita del Paese. A seguito della presentazione del piano strategico “Ri-formare la PA: persone qualificate per qualificare il Paese”, la Presidenza del Consiglio dei Ministri, Ministro per la Pubblica Amministrazione e Università Bocconi - SDA Bocconi School of Management hanno firmato il rinnovo del protocollo, iniziativa PA 110 e lode, che vuole valorizzare il ruolo del dipendente pubblico attraverso la possibilità di accedere, in modo agevolato, a programmi Master I e II livello e Corsi di Laurea su aree di forte interesse per le amministrazioni. Università Bocconi - SDA Bocconi School of Management propone per l’AA 2025-2026 il Master Universitario di II livello (60 CFU) [EMMAP - Executive Master in Management delle Amministrazioni Pubbliche](https://www.sdabocconi.it/it/master-specialistici-full-time-executive/emmap/). Tale protocollo si fonda sull’esperienza di 50 anni di attività che SDA Bocconi svolge in ambito PA e testimonia il costante impegno che la Scuola offre nel processo di trasformazione della Pubblica Amministrazione, come dimostrato dal progetto SDABocconi4Gov. A conferma di questo impegno, la Scuola ha voluto contribuire con un’ulteriore agevolazione a favore di tutti gli enti pubblici che intendano iscrivere i propri dipendenti all’offerta formativa di SDA Bocconi per il programma [EMMAP - Executive Master in Management delle Amministrazioni Pubbliche](https://www.sdabocconi.it/it/master-specialistici-full-time-executive/emmap/). ![Campus]( ## Perimetro dell’agevolazione PA 110 e lode L’agevolazione 30% sulla quota di iscrizione è prevista per tutti i dipendenti e gli enti pubblici per l'iscrizione al seguente programma della SDA Bocconi School of Management - Divisione Master per l’Anno Accademico 2026-2027: ["Executive Master in Management delle Amministrazioni Pubbliche" (EMMAP)](https://www.sdabocconi.it/it/master-specialistici-full-time-executive/emmap/) \- Master Universitario di II livello. ## Criteri di applicazione e modalità di ammissione e iscrizione È necessario presentare la propria candidatura dal portale admissions e partecipare al processo di selezione così come previsto per l'EMMAP. I criteri e le modalità di partecipazione alla selezione sono disponibili alla alla pagina " **Ammissioni**" del programma [www.sdabocconi.it/emmap](https://www.sdabocconi.it/it/master-specialistici-full-time-executive/emmap/). Le domande di ammissione sono valutate su base continua, si consiglia di procedere con l’application il prima possibile. L'esito di ammissione al corso consente l’iscrizione al programma con la conferma dell’agevolazione economica prevista. ### Per il partecipante che si iscrive e paga a titolo personale Il partecipante può godere dell’agevolazione del 30% su EMMAP. Per richiedere l'agevolazione è necessario inoltrare la **domanda di ammissione** seguendo la procedura di ammissione descritta alla pagina del programma: **EMMAP**: [clicca qui](https://www.sdabocconi.it/it/master-specialistici-full-time-executive/emmap/ammissioni/). Le domande di ammissione sono valutate su base continua, si consiglia di procedere con l’application il prima possibile. Public management _Start_ 17 June 2026 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano / Roma _Format_ Executive _Language_ Italian _Avg. working experience_ 16 years _Credits_ 60 ECTS/CFU **EMMAP** is an executive development pathway designed for those with management responsibility roles in public **agencies and companies.** Our goal is to help you consolidate and evolve your **strategic management** and leadership skills to revitalize your career path, become a driver of **innovation**, and build public value. - ### Words from the Director ![Silvia Rota]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/video-gallery/) ![partecipanti EMMAP]( ## Who is it for The EMMAP participant, a new figure of "public servant". EMMAP is the ideal meeting place for new public administration professionals, people who are highly motivated and culturally oriented toward the renewal of the public system. Managers with strong public ethics, aware of and respectful of the specificities and constraints of their role but far from the old bureaucratic mentality and capable of taking responsibility. Individuals committed to making public administration a place for building the country's welfare and development. **EMMAP edition XIII, XIV, XV** 24 Students 49 % Women 17 years Average professional experience [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmap/class-profile/) ## Why EMMAP - ### Work and learning in the field formula In its sixteenth edition, EMMAP offers a part-time and blended format that allows you to reconcile participation in the Master program with your professional and personal commitments and apply the learning developed on campus to your professional challenges right away. Alongside the irreplaceable on campus sessions, which allow, among other things, the exchange of experiences with other participants, several activities will be developed in distance learning. - ### Customized learning model Experience, interpretation, debate and implementation - these are the four dimensions that make up our learning model, developed over years of discussion with hundreds of public managers. YourSELF (Self Empowerment Leadership Program) is the customized public leadership skill-building course that we provide to meet your specific training needs, starting with an individual assessment and ending with a coaching course. - ### Concrete impact on organizations During the Master program, you will carry out project work and a concrete executive innovation project, identified on the basis of the needs of your home institution (or company) and the strategic challenges that it faces. The project is developed with the support of a faculty member who will individually follow you and your institution through the process of planning, implementing and evaluating the project. - ### \#SFIDE #SFIDE is a series of webinars dedicated to Alumni and professionals who work for and with the Public Administration, aimed at discussing current and future challenges and exploring possible tools to address them. ## Highlights - 60 Training credits - 50 + Years In the PA sector - 500 + Alumni and Alumnae

text: Executive Master in Management delle Aziende Sanitarie e Socio-Assistenziali [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmas/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmas/wishlist/) Admissions # Selection and admission process The selection process is based on comprehensive analysis of the documentation received and other elements and aims to have a highly qualified, motivated class capable of contributing to a dynamic and stimulating learning environment. We assess not only whether you are the right profile for EMMAS, but also whether EMMAS meets your expectations. Admission involves a rigorous selection process that evaluates the professional background, motivation and personal aptitude of those who apply. Each year, EMMAS welcomes leading figures in the health and social welfare sector: professionals, consultants, people in executive and managerial roles, who choose to embark on the EMMAS journey with strong motivation and a cultural vision oriented toward the renewal of the health and social welfare system. Selection thus ensures the formation of a class in which talented individuals can not only pursue their professional and personal goals but also enrich the classroom learning experience. **Admission deadline:** 10 March 2026 ![emmas class]( ## Your next steps - ### 1\. Online application form - ### 2\. Detailed CV - ### 3\. Degree certificate and transcript - ![Track ### 4\. SDA or GMAT test - ![Peer ### 5\. Interview ## What we need from you ### Detailed curriculum vitae ### Certificate of qualification (degree) ### "Sponsor Company" form ### Additional materials required ### SDA Test ### Interview ### Assessment ## Admissions results As soon as the selection process is completed you will receive a formal letter from the Admissions Committee, notifying you of the decision. Selection results are never communicated by telephone. All decisions made by the Admissions committee are final. The selection process will result in one of the following outcomes: - **Admission:** You will receive the official admission notice along with the participation contract. To confirm your participation, you must complete the registration process and payment of the first installment by the deadline specified by the committee. If all available spots have been filled, the school may place you on a waiting list or offer admission for the following edition. Admission to the program is valid for the year the application is submitted. However, you can request deferment to the following year, but approval of deferment is on a case-by-case decision by the Admissions committee. - **Non-admission:** The selection process evaluates not only the individual profile but also the overall composition of the EMMAS class. While we acknowledge the significant effort all candidates invest in the application and the selection process, we do not provide personalized feedback to non-admitted candidates. ## How to apply The Application for EMMAS is available **exclusively online** and must be completed with accurate and precise information regarding your personal and professional experiences, motivations for attending our master program, and other aspects of one's personality. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmas/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. title: EMMAS - Experience | SDA Bocconi
text: ![emmas class]( ## Student Clubs **Clubs** are a key part of the SDA Bocconi experience, fostering connections and sparking new ideas through exchanges among students, Faculty, Alums, and industry professionals. Led by students, they require strong management skills to secure funding, develop business plans, and handle relationships with the press and private firms, making them a dynamic platform for learning and collaboration. ### Professional - ![consulting-club_logo]( Fosters interaction between aspiring consultants and the industry, offering resources and networking occasions to enhance skills and foster valuable relationships in management consulting. - ![entrepreneurship-club]( Gathers students passionate about new businesses, technology and innovation, encouraging business creation, innovative ideas, and a startup mindset for personal and professional success. - ![financeclub]( Focuses on finance knowledge, training, and networking. Provides workshops, events, and resources to deepen financial expertise and prepare members for success in diverse finance roles. - ![healthcare-club]( Aims to broaden understanding of the healthcare industry and career, bridging theory and practice through networking, workshops, company visits, seminars and collaboration with experts. - ![lux_club_logo]( Delves into luxury and arts industries with hands-on exposure and a deeper insight into the field, broadening knowledge of high-end markets, cultural expressions, and brand strategies. - ![sustainable-industry-and-energy_logo]( Promotes knowledge and awareness of sustainability across all industries, strengthening relationships with key sectors that play a crucial role in fighting climate change. - ![tech-club_logo]( Gathers tech enthusiasts eager to explore emerging technologies, collaborate on digital solutions, and connect with industry pioneers, fostering a forward-thinking culture of innovation. ### Social Impact - ![ethicaclub]( Promotes ethical thinking and responsible leadership, guiding members to incorporate integrity, transparency, social responsibility, and a commitment to charity and giving back into business. - ![out_club_logo]( Elevates LGBTQIA+ visibility and inclusivity in business, providing supportive networks and alliances that foster respectful work environments and advocate for equality for all professionals. - ![club_women_in_business_logo]( Empowers women’s leadership through mentorship, networking, and development programs, equipping future leaders to overcome barriers and stereotypes and achieve gender parity in business. ### Sport & Leisure - ![sailing-club]( Leverages sailing as a leadership tool, orchestrating regattas, training, social gatherings and events to strengthen communication, strategic thinking, and team spirit on and off the water. - ![ski-club]( Gathers skiers and snowboarders for trips, competitions, and shared experiences in the mountains, using the slopes to foster community spirit and cultivate an active, adventurous mindset. ## Ambassadors Reach out to our ambassadors for first-hand insights. As current students or alums, they are willing to connect with prospective students, offering a genuine look into life at SDA Bocconi. text: Executive Master in Management delle Aziende Sanitarie e Socio-Assistenziali [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmas/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmas/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Participation in the EMMAS program requires a substantial financial commitment. However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns - both personally and professionally. ![Graduation]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the EMMAS 2026-2027 program is €25,000 (excluding VAT), payable in five installments. - First installment **€ 5.000** upon enrollment - Second installment **€ 5.000** by 30 May 2025 - Third installment **€ 5.000** by 30 September 2025 - Fourth installment **€ 5.000** by 31 December 2025 - Fifth installment **€ 5.000** by 28 February 2026 The participation fee includes teaching materials, use of the School's equipment, and the cost of accommodation for the Study Tour. Participants must provide their own laptop. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers SDA Bocconi provides scholarships and waivers for EMMAS applications through the publication of calls for applications. Special payment terms are awarded on the basis of merit criteria and any additional recognition modalities that are expressed by notice. Competition notices, if available, are posted on this page. The tuition waiver/scholarship request can also be submitted before the conclusion of the master selection process. If you meet more than one requirement among those listed in the notices, you can submit multiple requests for tuition waivers/fellowships. In addition, the School also participates in notices proposed by public administrations for scholarships/tuition waivers for EMMAS applicants. ### EMMAS 25 - Tuition Waivers To apply for a scholarship or tuition waiver, applicants must read the official call for applications (“bando di concorso”) to learn about the eligibility requirements and application procedures. Applications will be considered only from candidates who, by the deadlines stated in the call for applications, have: - submitted the admission application to the **Executive Master in Management delle Aziende Sanitarie e Socio-Assistenziali (EMMAS 25)**, duly completed and accompanied by all required documentation; - submitted the **Application for the Call**; - sent the application following the procedures and deadlines specified, and carefully verified that all eligibility criteria listed in the call are met—otherwise the application will not be accepted. If, at the time of publication of the call, the online admission application has already been submitted, candidates may access it again and complete the scholarship or tuition waiver request, provided it is within the deadline indicated in the call. title: EMMAS - YourSELF (Self Empowerment Leadership Focus) | SDA Bocconi
text: Executive Master in Management delle Aziende Sanitarie e Socio-Assistenziali [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmas/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmas/wishlist/) EMMAS # YourSELF (Self Empowerment Leadership Focus) La **leadership** si può imparare e allenare. Implica capacità personali e professionali che possono essere sviluppate partendo dalla consapevolezza dei propri punti di forza e di debolezza. Si sviluppa dalla riflessione sul rapporto tra le intenzioni di partenza, i comportamenti attivati e gli impatti generati. Per supportare questo processo, SDA Bocconi ti mette a disposizione master due strumenti: l’assessment e il coaching. ![Executive Master in Management delle Aziende Sanitarie e Socio-Assistenziali]( ### L’assessment L’assessment proposto di SDA Bocconi si basa sulla **rilevazione** e il **feedback** a 360 gradi del tuo approccio alla leadership orientata alla responsabilità interna (sviluppo del team, coerenza con gli obiettivi organizzativi) ed esterna (rispondenza alle aspettative degli stakeholder). Per conoscere meglio i tuoi punti di forza e di debolezza questo strumento ti offre la **possibilità di comparare i punti di vista di 8-10 persone** con cui collabori (collega, capo, collaboratore, partner, utente) scelte da te e chiamate ad indicare la frequenza di alcuni comportamenti che esprimono lo stile di leadership. Questi i principali **vantaggi** dell’assessment: - conoscere aspetti del tuo stile professionale sottovalutati o ignorati, - maturare una visione più profonda e consapevole del tuo profilo di leader all’interno dell’organizzazione - comparare i tuoi punti di forza rispetto ai diversi segmenti intervistati (partner esterni e colleghi interni possono offrire punti di vista diversi). A conclusione del processo ti sarà consegnato un report con la sintesi dei risultati, che saranno l’oggetto del lavoro successivo, il coaching. ### Il coaching Il coaching è uno strumento di sviluppo individuale che punta a supportare la persona (coachee) nel **riconoscimento e valorizzazione delle proprie risorse per realizzare obiettivi sfidanti**. SDA Bocconi ha deciso di allargare la propria offerta formativa attraverso questo servizio altamente personalizzato e focalizzato sulle tue sfide professionali. Il servizio di coaching è assicurato da docenti SDA Bocconi formati alla professione di coach e impegnati nella formazione manageriale a tutto campo. Il coaching è uno **strumento di apprendimento**, non una relazione di natura terapeutica: più che analizzare la storia passata, il coach supporta il coachee nella scelta delle azioni da compiere nel futuro, per raggiungere i propri obiettivi. Il coaching serve inoltre a **trovare le proprie soluzioni**: a differenza del consulente, del tutor o del mentore, il coach non dà risposte ma supporta il coachee nella costruzione delle sue. Il servizio di coaching si articola in genere in un **ciclo di 3 incontri** finalizzati al raggiungimento di uno o più obiettivi individuali, definiti all’inizio del percorso insieme al coach e monitorati nel corso dell’attività, anche alla luce di quanto emerso dal report di assessment. Il coaching è uno strumento utile soprattutto **nei momenti di trasformazione professionale** in atto o desiderati (nuovo lavoro, avanzamento di carriera, aumento delle responsabilità manageriali) o per lavorare sulle proprie competenze di leadership (gestione delle persone, gestione dei conflitti, gestione del cambiamento, comunicazione). Vuoi sapere di più su EMMAS? Since 1978, SDA Bocconi and [**CERGAS**](https://cergas.unibocconi.eu/)(Centre for Research on Health and Social Care Management) have jointly developed training and research/intervention to support healthcare management. And the EMMAS Faculty transfer methods and results into teaching. - ### A broad and well-established network of former participants and partner companies. Nearly 1,000 former participants make up the EMMAS Alumni network, which comes together during the Annual Conference and the annual presentation of the [OASI Report](https://cergas.unibocconi.eu/oasi-2025). In addition, participants meet around 30 companies and public and private institutions involved in each edition. - ### Work and study formula Comprehensive, integrated, modular, engaging and interactive training that does not interrupt your career path. For the participants, it is a great test of tenacity and organization. For EMMAS a challenge to make the pathway stimulating and effective in every step and activity. - ### From knowing to doing The didactic method is an essential component of EMMAS's training effectiveness, enabling you to develop your management skills in the context of situations typical of health and social welfare companies. text: challenge to make the pathway stimulating and effective in every step and activity. - ### From knowing to doing The didactic method is an essential component of EMMAS's training effectiveness, enabling you to develop your management skills in the context of situations typical of health and social welfare companies. Case study discussions, exercises, simulations and field projects (the well-known DSA-Diagnosis of Business Systems) are some of the classroom teaching tools that are accompanied by distance learning sessions designed to ensure continuity of learning, and activities designed to strengthen leadership (YourSELF - Empowerment Leadership Focus) and learn about international best practices (Study Tour) - ### From awareness to improving your leadership **YourSELF** (Self Empowerment Leadership Focus) is a leadership skills development program tailored to your specific needs. Leadership can be learned and trained. It implies personal and professional skills that can be developed from an awareness of one's strengths and weaknesses. It develops from reflection on the relationship between the starting intentions, the behaviors activated and the impacts generated. To support this process, SDA Bocconi provides you with two tools: assessment and coaching. - ### Always in the forefront of training for the health and social welfare sector. SDA Bocconi has historically been at the forefront of health and social welfare management education. Despite local specificities, there are problems common to all advanced countries. But it is not only about identifying possible alternative answers to common problems, but also about recognizing and valuing similar answers or even critically evaluating some solutions. The aim of the **Study Tour** is to open up to new frontiers while at the same time "discovering" the strengths of one's own organizations: fundamental requirements that a manager must possess in order to build a **solid vision of future healthcare**. The choice of destination is therefore made from within a narrow portfolio of **European best practices**, and the agenda includes a mix of lectures, testimonials and facility tours. - ### YourSELF - Empowerment Leadership Focus YourSELF is a leadership skills development program aimed at supporting master degree participants in a learning process about specific **individual needs**. To ensure a high-quality educational experience, SDA Bocconi applies a rigorous selection process based on clearly defined criteria. We select candidates from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds, as this diversity enriches the learning experience for all. In reviewing your application, we take a holistic approach—assessing your academic and professional history alongside your motivation, personal drive, and alignment with the program. We aim to ensure that EMMIO is the right match for you and that it supports your goals, expectations, and career aspirations. If all available spots have been filled, the school may place you on a waiting list or offer admission for the following edition. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmio/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![emmio_fees_and_scholarships]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the EMMIO 2026-2027 program is € 27,000, payable in three installments - First installment **€9,000** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€9,000** by 31 December 2026 - Third installment **€9,000** by 27 February 2027 **Application fee: €120** The fees include: - Tuition All teaching materials - Use of the infrastructure and services of SDA Bocconi - Catering (coffee breaks) during face-to-face modules The fees do not include: - Travel and accommodation expenses - Participants must provide their own laptop ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 27 Mar 2026 _2nd round_ 7 May 2026 _3rd round_ 16 July 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for outstanding candidates, thanks to the ongoing support of companies, organizations, and the Bocconi Alumni Community. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the EMMIO selection process **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must:** - Submit their application for the EMMIO 2026-2027 program - Review the pre-requisites for each tuition waiver - Flag the tuition waiver option through the online application portal by the indicated deadline **Important**: - Applicants will be considered eligible for a tuition waiver only after completing the EMMIO application, including the online form and all supporting documents. - You can apply for scholarships and tuition waivers even if your selection process is still in progress. However, only admitted candidates will be evaluated for the awarding of a tuition waiver or scholarship. - If you meet multiple requirements, you may apply for more than one scholarship or tuition waiver. The tuition waivers will be awarded during the selection process and no later than the starting date of the EMMIO 2026-2027 program. Participants are encouraged to explore various funding opportunities available in different countries, such as employer sponsorships or scholarships provided by private foundations, international organizations, or local governments. ### Tuition Waivers 2026-2027 SDA Bocconi School of Management is making available 9 partial merit-based tuition waivers up to EUR 9,000 to 2026/27 EMMIO candidates with an outstanding profile. - ###### Outstanding Profiles 6 Partial Tuition Waivers [ - ###### Diversity and Inclusion 3 Partial Tuition Waivers [ ## Loans and funding for candidates The school assists candidates with their search for funding by supplying the necessary documentation and encouraging them to explore all scholarship and loan possibilities. text: Executive Master in Management of International Organizations [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/en_US/courses/course/23-emmio-executive-master-management-international-organizations) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmio/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emmio/wishlist/) EMMIO # Main Partners - ![Ahrmio logo]( ### AHRMIO SDA Bocconi is a proud academic partner of the Association for Human Resources Management in International Organizations (AHRMIO); the association is dedicated to furthering the management of people and human talent in not-for-profit international organizations in the governmental and non-governmental sectors. It does this through the generation and sharing of knowledge, the provision of professional development opportunities, and the organization of events to discuss and advance the state-of-the-practice in HR management. - ![Food security logo]( ### Global Food Security Cluster SDA Bocconi is a proud partner of the Global Food Security Cluster (GFSC), established to coordinate the food security response during a humanitarian crisis, addressing issues of food availability, access, and utilization. The GFSC is an innovative inter-agency, across-the-board mechanism continuously experimenting with innovative ways to boost preparedness, fight vulnerability of national systems, increase humanitarian assistance effectiveness, and increase UN and non-UN cooperation. The EMMIO participates in the intense knowledge exchange and generation of the cluster, and brings the valuable lessons it learned to the classroom. - ![CDR logo]( ### Career Development Roundtable SDA Bocconi is proud to partner with the CDR to develop original content and to advance knowledge on human resources management, aiming to contribute to continuously improve management practices in international organizations. The CDR does so by creating a network dedicated to sharing best practices, and generating and spreading knowledge on human capital topics and issues. - ![Global Careers fair logo]( ### Global Careers Fair SDA Bocconi and Global Careers Fair, the largest online recruitment events and job board of its kind, are working hand-in-hand to train the leaders of the future and to offer them career opportunities in International Organisations (IOs), the International Public Sector (IPS) and Non-Profit Organisations (NGOs). Public management _Start_ 28 September 2026 _Duration_ 9 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Executive _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 14 years The **Executive Master in Management of International Organizations (EMMIO) is a part-time blended program** that successfully prepares participants to **tackle the biggest managerial challenges of modern international organizations**, such as: United Nations, International NGOs, International Financial Institutions, Intergovernmental and Supranational Organizations. Compacting an impressive workload and a fully-fledged executive master program into a **nine-month educational path**, EMMIO is **compatible with full-time employment**. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emms/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. Here, you don’t just learn—you live the experience. - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( - ![EMMS experience]( ## Student Clubs **Clubs** are a key part of the SDA Bocconi experience, fostering connections and sparking new ideas through exchanges among students, Faculty, Alums, and industry professionals. Led by students, they require strong management skills to secure funding, develop business plans, and handle relationships with the press and private firms, making them a dynamic platform for learning and collaboration.

However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![Classe EMMS]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the 2027-2028 EMMS program is € 42,000, payable in four installments \* - First installment **€10,500** upon acceptance of admission (non-refundable deposit fee) - Second installment **€10,500** by 31 March 2027 - Third installment **€10,500** by 31 May 2027 - Fourth installment **€10,500 (€4,500 \*\*)** by 4 January 2028 \\* An “early bird fee” of € 36,000 will be granted to candidates that have enrolled and have paid the deposit fee before 10 November 2026. \\*\\* For "Early Birds" **Application fee: €120** The fees include: - All teaching material used during the program - Access to both schools’ facilities - Catering (coffee breaks and lunches) during face-to-face modules The fees do not include: - Travel and accommodation expenses. Participants must provide their own laptop. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round:_ 30 Jun 2026 _2nd round:_ 30 Sep 2026 _3rd round:_ 15 Dec 2026 _Early bird:_ 10 Nov 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for outstanding candidates, thanks to the ongoing support of companies, organizations, alums, and current students. Applications for tuition waivers are evaluated according to the following criteria: - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the EMMS selection process To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must: - Submit their application for the EMMS 2027-2028 program - Review and meet the pre-requisites for each tuition waiver - Prepare a motivation letter explaining why you should be awarded a tuition waiver - Flag the tuition waiver option through the online application portal by the indicated deadline **Important**: - All candidates who meet the requirements can apply for the tuition waivers. Applicants will only be considered eligible for a tuition waiver after completing the EMMS application (including the online form and all supporting documents). - You can apply for scholarships and tuition waivers even if your selection process is still in progress. However, only admitted candidates will be evaluated for the awarding of a tuition waiver or scholarship. - The tuition waiver is not compatible with the "early bird fee". Candidates enrolled by 10 November 2026 who are subsequently awarded a tuition waiver are no longer eligible for the early bird fee. ### Tuition waivers EMMS 2027-2028 - ###### International Candidates 3 partial tuition waivers [ - ###### Outstanding Candidates 1 partial tuition waiver [ ## Loans and funding The School assists candidates with their search for funding by supplying the necessary documentation and encouraging them to explore all scholarship and loan possibilities. The Executive Master in Marketing & Sales (EMMS) is designed precisely for this challenge. combining top-tier European business education with real-world industry impact, this dynamic, part-time master lets you accelerate your career without pausing your professional life. You’ll master strategic and sales tools, immediately turn deep customer insights into tangible business results, and power your potential into action starting now. ![esade_sdabocconi_logo]( - ### Words from the Directors ![Executive Master in Marketing and Sales video]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emms/video-gallery/) ![Who is it for?]( ## Who is it for The ideal candidates have a strong background in marketing and sales, with established professional experience at a senior level in B2B and B2C companies or are entrepreneurs seeking to broaden their expertise in these areas and take the next step in their career. **EMMS 2026** 26 Students 33 years Average age 13 Countries represented 8 years Average working experience [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emms/class-profile/) ## Why EMMS - ### Upgrade your knowledge Through exposure to new managerial models, analysis of international cases across different sectors and markets, and exchange of experiences with peers, faculty, and practitioners, to enhance your strategic vision. - ### Enhance your professional development By delving into managerial areas that complement your existing expertise, enabling you to build a comprehensive understanding of how to effectively integrate and manage all marketing and sales levers. - ### Prepare for leadership By developing the necessary skills to make a significant career leap, taking on roles with greater responsibility and impact. ## Highlights - 2 Top ranked European B-School Esade and SDA Bocconi - 13 months Part-time format Combining an Immersive learning experience (on-campus sessions in Milan, Barcelona, Rome, Madrid) with an Extensive learning experience (to revise and apply key frameworks in your daily professional environment) - 16 Courses - 5 Workshops and 1 field project with top international companies Want to know more about EMMS? [Contact us](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emms/requestinformation/) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/emms/downloadbrochure/) Program ## Calendar and contents 21st edition 2027-2028 EMMS offers a dynamic **two-phase learning journey**. In the **Immersive Learning phase** (on campus), you'll dive into interactive, on-campus sessions, working side-by-side with expert faculty to explore cutting-edge managerial models, theoretical frameworks, and impactful real-world cases. You’ll further enrich your experience with **Company visits**, gaining first-hand insights from industry-leading organizations, and the exclusive **Leadership series**, where top executives share personal experiences, challenges, and strategies from the front lines of marketing and sales leadership.

You’ll further enrich your experience with Company visits, gaining first-hand insights from industry-leading organizations, and the exclusive Leadership series, where top executives share personal experiences, challenges, and strategies from the front lines of marketing and sales leadership. During the Extensive Learning phase, you'll translate insights into action. Individual and group projects give you space to apply, internalize, and deeply reflect on classroom concepts, empowering you to tackle professional challenges with new tools, methods, and confidence. Live classes provide continuity, deepen your understanding, and highlight key topics, supporting you effectively throughout your learning journey. - ### The Faculty EMMS professors are experts in the fields of marketing and sales, combining rigorous academic research with deep industry expertise. They bring real-world insights directly into the classroom through cutting-edge teaching methods, interactive sessions, and practical experience. Beyond academia, our faculty actively engage in industry through consultancy and executive roles, ensuring that every lesson is relevant, impactful, and immediately applicable. The program’s professors carry out non-academic work in their respective fields and have significant professional experience in areas related to the subjects addressed in the program. The work of the EMMS faculty is grounded in: 1\. Research – challenging boundaries and exploring new ideas 2\. Publishing – sharing influential insights widely 3\. Teaching – preparing the next generation of marketing and sales leaders 4\. Consultancy – continuously validating theories in real-world contexts - ### Field projects Company-driven field project puts your learning immediately into action. During the EMMS program, you will act as consultants, working closely with real companies under the guidance of an EMMS faculty member, to tackle authentic marketing and sales challenges. This project tests your analytical thinking, business expertise, and communication skills, providing companies with innovative, independent solutions delivered by talented international teams, coordinated through a single point of contact at SDA Bocconi. The main goal is to empower you to apply classroom theories and skills directly into a real corporate scenario. You'll collaborate with teammates and company representatives, preparing impactful presentations and comprehensive reports, delivering concrete value to the company and enriching your Executive Master in Marketing and Sales journey. - ### Individual executive coaching EMMS provides individual assessment and development of professional competences and sales skills, so that each participant will develop a plan to improve his/her professional profile. The applications used are Predictive Index, PRO and SSAT provided by PI Worldwide. These combine tests and personal guidance conducted by Prímula Asesores. The workshop has two parts: Leading People and Leading Yourself. During the Leading yourself section, students will use Esade Lead, a platform for the development of leadership skills. text: International Master in Management, Law and Humanities of Sport [Apply Now](https://www.cies.ch/education/fifa-master/apply-to-the-fifa-master) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/fifa-master/wishlist/) ![fifa_774.jpg]( **FIFA MASTER** # International Master in Management, Law and Humanities of Sport ## Where sports meet management. Arts, sports and events _Start_ 15 September 2026 _Duration_ 10 months _Format_ Full-time _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 3 years **The FIFA Master**\- International Master (MA) in Management, Law and Humanities of Sport, established in 2000, was created to promote management education within the sports world. It has grown to become a top graduate academic program developing all-round managers who can cope with the increasingly complex world of sport. The FIFA Master is organized by the International Centre for Sport Studies (CIES) in partnership with three universities, De Montfort University in Leicester (UK), SDA Bocconi School of Management in Milan (Italy) and the University of Neuchâtel (Switzerland). Every year, the FIFA Master class - approximatively 30 postgraduates from 25 different nationalities – embarks on a unique journey throughout Europe to study sport.Three distinguished universities in England, Italy and Switzerland, which are among Europe's most sports-oriented countries, have come together to provide a one-year program that combines top-class academic teaching and practical case studies supplemented by guest lecturers and field visits. The course focuses on three key and inter-related aspects of sport humanities, management and law. The fourth and final part of the course also takes place while the students are still in Neuchâtel and under the supervision of academic staff of the three universities. This dissertation is an academic research project which involves working in small groups on a chosen topic, considering it from all angles, and then preparing and completing a joint project. Program lecturers are some of the leading university authorities in the study of sport and guest lecturers include speakers from top organizations in world sport. This course has an excellent record of students finding jobs in sports management across leading global sporting organizations such as FIFA, the IOC, UEFA, AFC, CAF and F1, many sports marketing, sponsoring, consulting, and media & events agencies. The dynamic and thriving alumni association provides a valuable network both during and after the course. **Partnerships** The FIFA Master - International Master (MA) in Management, Law and Humanities of Sport is organized by the International Centre for Sport Studies (CIES) in partnership with three universities, De Montfort University in Leicester (UK), SDA Bocconi School of Management in Milan (Italy) and the University of Neuchâtel (Switzerland). Our selection process involves a holistic evaluation of your application materials, considering key factors such as skills, professional experience, personal drive, and leadership and growth potential. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mafed/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## MAFED: a bouquet of experiences Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. Here, you don’t just learn—you live the experience. As a MAFED student, you’ll enjoy a rich array of extracurricular activities, including study tours to fashion capitals like Paris, Madrid, and New York, as well as corporate visits to leading global brands. title: MAFED - Fees and scholarships | SDA Bocconi
text: Master in Fashion, Experience & Design Management [Apply Now](https://sda42.dreamapply.com/en_US/courses/course/16-mafed-master-fashion-experience-design-management) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mafed/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mafed/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Participation in the MAFED program requires a substantial financial commitment. However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![Ragazzi in aula che ascoltano]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the MAFED 2027 program is € 40,000, payable in four installments - First installment **€ 10,000** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€10,000** by 26 February 2027 - Third installment **€10,000** by 30 April 2027 - Fourth installment **€10,000** by 30 June 2027 **Application fee: €120** **The fees include:** - Internal teaching material used during the program (some books are not included) - Visits to companies and institutions (includes organization and transport – excludes lodging and food) - Access to the Bocconi University library and online database. Participants must provide their own laptop. **Other expenses:** Fees do not include accommodation or living expenses. Personal expenses will vary significantly depending on your lifestyle. In general, the cost of living in Milan is comparable to that of other major European cities. We aim to provide you with a forecast of monthly expenses as experienced by MAFED students in recent years: - Housing: € 800-1500 - Meals: € 450 - Transport: € 100 - Misc. Expenses: € 350 Total € 1,700 - €2,400 ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 20 April 2026 _2nd round_ 30 June 2026 _3rd round_ 12 October 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for outstanding candidates, thanks to the ongoing support of companies, organizations, alums, and current students. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the MAFED selection process **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must:** - Submit their application for the MAFED 2027 program - Review the pre-requisites for each tuition waiver - Flag the tuition waiver option through the online application portal by the indicated deadline **Important**: - Applicants will be considered eligible for a tuition waiver only after completing the MAFED application, including the online form and all supporting documents. - You can apply for scholarships and tuition waivers even if your selection process is still in progress. However, only admitted candidates will be evaluated for the awarding of a tuition waiver or scholarship. - If you meet multiple requirements, you may apply for more than one scholarship or tuition waiver. Fashion, design and luxury _Start_ 18 January 2027 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Full-time _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 3 years The **Master in Fashion, Experience & Design Management**(MAFED) is an intensive 1-year full-time program offering 70 ECTS/ CFU credits. It provides you with solid management skills tailored for highly creative industries. MAFED empowers you by combining the power of imagination with enhanced methodologies and analytical capabilities. It fosters consistent strategies and carefully targeted marketing initiatives, enabling you to create lasting, engaging, and imaginative brands that stand the test of time. ### MAFED partners Main partner ![altagamma_logo_1.png]( Knowledge Partner ![bain_logo_1.png]( Mentoring Program ![]( - ### Words from the Director ![MAFED - Direttrice]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mafed/video-gallery/) ![ragazza del master MAFED che parla]( ## Who is it for MAFED is the right Master for you if: - You want a managerial role in a fashion, luxury, or design company. - You want to work in organizations that create unique customer experiences. - You want to launch your own venture in these symbol-intensive industries. - You want to engage with the power of industry. - You want to prepare for all this in Milan, an international and challenging environment, and the well-recognized symbol of Italian style and excellence worldwide. **MAFED 2026 (25th edition)** 84 students Class size 87% International students 26 years Average age 3 years Average work experience [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mafed/class-profile/) ## Why MAFED - ### Build a solid career in a fast-moving business world The program provides **specific training for creative managers, bridging the gap between managerial and creative roles**. You will gain a comprehensive understanding of new managerial approaches, enhanced analytics, and digital technologies, while recognizing the unique DNA of fashion and design companies, often rooted in their successful, well-established histories. - ### A powerful network of industry leaders and alums MAFED is supported by SDA Bocconi, Università Bocconi, and Fondazione Altagamma, a network of top-tier Italian brands. This ecosystem provides **exclusive access to business leaders, top scholars, and a strong network of alumni and alumnae**, ensuring lifelong professional connections and opportunities. - ### World-class faculty and top guest speakers The program is led by **globally recognized facult** y and enriched by insights from **top managers and industry leaders**, who share real-world business cases, providing a dynamic and hands-on learning experience. - ### Experiential learning: study tours, corporate visits, and field projects You will engage in **study tours to major fashion capitals** like Paris and New York, depending on your concentration. Additionally, **corporate visits and field projects** will immerse you in leading brands' strategies, allowing you to apply your classroom knowledge in real-world settings. - ### Italian excellence and an international learning environment Milan, the **heart of international

As a class, you will travel to Paris for the **Haute Couture study tour** and to another destination for a second Tour. For the " **Go to Market in a Fashion and Design Global Landscape**" concentration, you will join the Retail New York Study Tour, while those in " **Food, Experience & Hospitality Management**" will travel to Tuscany. **Study tours are optional and not included in the program fee**. October 2027November 2027 #### Field projects: bridging theory and practice To ensure effective learning, MAFED students apply classroom theories to real-world business challenges through **in-company group projects**. Over eight weeks, teams of two to five students tackle key corporate aspects such as brand positioning, pricing, and market entry, under the guidance of an SDA Bocconi professor and a company executive. These projects provide companies with innovative solutions, access to highly motivated and skilled students, and a chance to assess potential future hires. At the conclusion, teams present their findings through a final report and presentation, delivering valuable insights to the company. This rigorous approach aims to meet your expectations while providing a foundation for personal and professional growth. We select candidates from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds, as this diversity enriches the learning experience at both the individual and group levels. Our selection process involves a holistic evaluation of your application materials, considering key factors such as skills, professional experience, personal drive, and leadership and growth potential. Through this process, we aim to create a class of outstanding individuals who will benefit from the program—not only to achieve their career goals and personal aspirations but also to enrich their peers' learning experience. **DEADLINES** **Tuition waivers** 1st round: 16 December 2025 2nd round: 12 February 2026 3rd round: 16 April 2026 4th round: 11 June 2026 **Application** 11 June 2026 ![ragazzo che ascolta]( ## Your next steps - ### 1\. Selection results are never communicated by telephone. All decisions made by the Admissions committee are final. The selection process will result in one of the following outcomes: **Admission:** You will receive the official admission notice along with the participation contract. You must confirm your participation by the deadline specified by the Admissions committee. If all available spots have been filled, the school may place you on a waiting list or offer admission for the following edition. Admission to the program is valid for the year the application is submitted. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mama/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## MAMA: a bouquet of experiences Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. Here, you don’t just learn—you live the experience. MAMA benefits from the partnership and collaboration of different kinds of arts and cultural institutions, which provide participants with unique experiences.
