However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![ragazzi in gruppo che parlano]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the MAMA 2026-2027 program is € 30,000, payable in four installments. - First installment **€ 7,500** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€ 7,500** by 26 November 2026 - Third installment **€ 7,500** by 28 January 2027 - Fourth installment **€ 7,500** by 29 April 2027 **Application fee: € 120** **The fees include:** - Teaching material - Courses in Italian language, with the possibility of attaining the CILS qualification of Italian language proficiency - MAMA Grand Tour in Italy Participants must provide their own laptop. **Other expenses:** Fees do not include accommodation or living expenses. Personal expenses will vary significantly depending on your lifestyle. In general, the cost of living in Milan is comparable to that of other major European cities. We aim to provide you with a forecast of monthly expenses as experienced by MAMA students in recent years: - Housing: € 800 - 1500 - Meals: € 450 - Transports: € 100 - Misc. Expenses: € 350 **Total € 1,700 - 2,400** The Program may involve company presentations and visits to Italian cultural institutions. Those extracurricular activities (held in the period October- May) will be day trips from Milan: transportation costs are to be covered by students. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 16 December 2025 _2nd round_ 12 February 2026 _3rd round_ 16 April 2026 _4th round_ 11 June 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for outstanding candidates, thanks to the ongoing support of companies, organizations, alums, and current students. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the MAMA selection process **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must:** - Submit their application for the MAMA 2026-2027 program - Review the pre-requisites for each tuition waiver - Flag the tuition waiver option through the online application portal by the indicated deadline **Important**: - Applicants will be considered eligible for a tuition waiver only after completing the MAMA application, including the online form and all supporting documents. - You can apply for scholarships and tuition waivers even if your selection process is still in progress. However, only admitted candidates will be evaluated for the awarding of a tuition waiver or scholarship. - If you meet multiple requirements, you may apply for more than one scholarship or tuition waiver. The tuition waivers will be awarded during the selection process and no later than the starting date of the MAMA 2026-2027 Program. SDA Bocconi partners with a number of financial institutes offering low-interest loans to admitted and eligible students. Our partner institutes are: - [Prodigy Finance](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/prodigy-finance/) for international students (please refer to the eligibility criteria); - [Lendwise](https://lendwise.com/borrow/education-funding/university/bocconi-university/) for international students; - Italian Banks for [Italian](https://www.unibocconi.it/it/studenti-iscritti/agevolazioni/finanziamenti-master-universitari-e-sda) and [international students](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/student-loans) (please note that applications for loans issued by Italian Banks must be submitted by the end of the month following the starting date of your Master); - Bocconi offers Support Programs to student-athletes who participate in sport competitions at regional, national and international level. Find out more [here](https://www.bocconisport.eu/en/support-programs-student-athletes) Furthermore, the University provides information about [financing sources](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/funding-country) for international students from a large number of countries. Its members reflect Italian style and culture in their own company management and products. They stand out for their innovation, quality, service, design, and prestige. Today, Altagamma has **76 member companies** in the world of fashion, design, jewelry, automobiles, and gourmet food specialties, along with a prestigious network of around 200 leading global luxury brands, which form the Altagamma Honorary Council. Altagamma is the official sponsor of the MAMA and contributes to the Master not only financially – by funding scholarships and financing field projects – but also with business testimonials and seminars on key issues, facilitating access to companies to allow program participants to visit them, and to let faculty compile case studies. In addition, Altagamma assists in setting up activities specifically to promote the career development of participants. Arts, sports and events _Start_ 23 September 2026 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Full-time _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 5 years _Credits_ 70 ECTS/CFU Leveraging Italy’s excellence in cultural heritage and artistic production, the **Specialized Master in Arts Management and Administration (MAMA)** is a full-time 1-year program in English, offering **70 ECTS/CFU credits**, designed for talented students from all over the world, with international vocation profiles and a passion for the arts. MAMA aims to **support artistic innovation and cultural development worldwide**, by strengthening the leadership and management skills required for arts organizations to thrive, and for your career to flourish in a wide range of organizations operating in the arts sector. **Discover MAMA's specific qualifying goals.** ## Partnerships Many institutions in the fields of Heritage and Performing Arts are participating in the MAMA program with lectures, company visits, research projects, and internships for students. The aim of the MAMA seminars is to strengthen your leadership and communication in order to support your personal and professional growth. Seminars are held throughout the year and include the following topics: Strategic Heritage Management Business Ethics & Diversity, Equity and Inclusion March 2027June 2027 #### Concentration Track in Art Markets and Finance This innovative track in _Arts Markets and Finance_ prepares future arts leaders with specialized skills to navigate the global art market. It offers a comprehensive understanding of market dynamics, including taste trends, cultural influences, and the roles of galleries and auction houses. The program emphasizes legal and ethical considerations such as authenticity, provenance, copyright, and cultural heritage, along with institutional and regulatory frameworks. Participants explore emerging trends like financialization and tokenization (e.g. Non-Fungible Tokens), and gain insights from key market players—collectors, investors, advisors, and more—to effectively understand and operate within the evolving international art world. - The program consists of two learning modules for a total of 12 full days. Each module consists in a week (Monday to Saturday from 8:30 to 4pm). - Extra visits or trips to Art Fairs could be organized on top of the classes (i.e. in other days) and will be elective. - The Concentration Track in Art Markets and Finance is also offered as an [Open Executive June 2027 #### MAMA Grand Tour in Italy Immerse yourself in the world of art management by joining a unique 10-day Grand Tour Experience, aimed at offering a managerial perspective of Italian best practices in the arts sector. Hosted by some of the most relevant Italy-based cultural institutions - such as Vatican Museums, Pompei Archeological Site, Teatro San Carlo di Napoli, Museo Opera del Duomo di Firenze, etc. - the MAMA Grand Tour offers participants the opportunity to learn from managers in the field and internalize the skills and knowledge acquired throughout the year. Internships last a minimum of three months (June–December) and let you apply cross-disciplinary knowledge to drive innovation in the arts. You can also find your own internship tailored to your career goals—just get it approved with a detailed proposal. Whichever path you choose—internship or entrepreneurial venture—you’ll showcase your project in a final presentation before graduation and submit a written report demonstrating your impact and insights. MAMA’s **network of partners and institutions** actively selects interns for dynamic field projects. ## A comprehensive learning experience - ### A challenging program to build a solid career MAMA wants to offer you solid foundations in management, including practical, creative, and professional skills, by creating a stimulating environment, focusing on an international market with a multidisciplinary approach, and enriching it all with unique experiences such as the **Grand Tour** in world-famous centers of Italian culture, or **MAMA internships**, a chance to work for one of **MAMA's main partners or collaborating institutions**. [Internships in the last two editions](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mama/internships/) - ### Learning model MAMA is an intense full-time program that combines interactive class sessions, case studies, and hands-on experiences such as company visits, field projects, and business simulations. You will learn from SDA Bocconi’s expert faculty, international professors from top business schools, and professionals from the arts and culture sector. The program blends theory with practice through teamwork, business games, role-playing exercises, and real-world assignments. You’ll also have access to complementary courses like Italian (with CILS certification) and Excel, as well as cultural development and skills enhancement seminars. With mandatory attendance from Monday to Friday (8:30 AM – 2:30 PM), plus additional study time, you will be fully immersed in the learning process. Engaging with Milan’s vibrant cultural scene and completing a 10-week internship, field project, or launching your own arts startup will further enrich your experience and prepare you for leadership roles in the industry. - ### Arts & Culture Knowledge Center The Knowledge Center is an international hub that addresses arts management related topics and attracts experts from academia and professionals from this industry. It generates knowledge, skills and attitudes in the Arts & Culture sector and offers activities, programs, as well as professional and educational projects, targeting international participants with a passion for the arts and the willingness to make a difference in the sector. The final goal is that of empowering Arts & Culture leaders, helping them to increase their effectiveness and improve their decision making. We select candidates from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds, as this diversity enriches the learning experience at both the individual and group levels. Our selection process involves a holistic evaluation of your application materials, considering key factors such as skills, professional experience, personal drive, and leadership and growth potential. You must confirm your participation by the deadline specified by the Admissions committee. The selection process begins on **October 2025**. **Applications are examined on a rolling basis**. Those received well in advance of the deadline have a greater chance of being admitted. Therefore, it is in your best interest to submit your application as early as possible. When we receive your application, we carry out a **pre-selection** based on the documents you sent. The Admissions Committee lets you know if you are considered suitable to proceed with the selection process. If so, you will be required to have an **interview**, which may be held at SDA Bocconi in Milan or remotely (by phone or Microsoft Teams). This will allow you to show that you have the essential skills, talents, and motivations that are essential to getting the most out of our MCF program. The **final result** will be communicated once the application is complete, which means all documents must have been received and tests completed. text: Master in Corporate Finance [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/en_US/courses/course/17-mcf-master-corporate-finance) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mcf/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mcf/wishlist/) # The MCF experience: learn, connect, transform - ![SDA Bocconi]( ## A world of perspectives: the value of diversity Diversity at SDA Bocconi is more than a value—it’s the driving force behind a transformative learning experience. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mcf/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. title: MCF - Fees and scholarships | SDA Bocconi
text: Master in Corporate Finance [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/en_US/courses/course/17-mcf-master-corporate-finance) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mcf/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mcf/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Attending the program entails a significant amount of financial commitment but always repays itself with a wide margin. The SDA Bocconi's MCF is an intensive program requiring a hefty investment in time and money. ![Ragazzo seduto che ascolta]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the MCF 2026-2027 program is € 40,000, payable in four installments - First installment **€10,000** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€10,000** by 05 January 2027 - Third installment **€10,000** by 25 February 2027 - Fourth installment **€10,000** by 29 April 2027 **Application fee: €120** The fees include: - Most teaching material (although some texts must be purchased separately) - Access to SDA Bocconi’s facilities and database. Participants must provide the own laptop. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 11 December 2025 _2nd round_ 12 February 2026 _3rd round_ 16 April 2026 _4th round_ 25 June 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management offers multiple scholarships and tuition waivers. These are awarded on the basis of merit to candidates with an outstanding profile. SDA Bocconi School of Management makes available partial merit-based tuition waivers to 2026-2027 candidates with an outstanding profile. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the MCF selection process **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must:** - Have sent the application to the MCF 2026-2027 - Look at the pre-requisites for the tuition waiver - Flag the tuition waiver option through the Application Portal by the deadline indicated The tuition waivers will be awarded during the selection process and no later than the starting date of the MCF 2026-2027 Program. **You can apply to the scholarship / tuition waivers even though your selection process is still in progress.** In order **to be considered for a tuition waiver**, not only you must **choose the tuition waiver option** in the application, but also you **must submit your MCF application within the deadline indicated**. Admission to the program is independent of the awarding of any scholarship or tuition waiver. If you meet more than one requirement, you can apply to multiple scholarships / tuition waivers. **Tuition waivers for candidate Athletes** SDA Bocconi School of Management is also making available **2 merit-based tuition waivers** of **€ 20,000 each** to all **2026/27 Full-Time Specialised Masters**’ candidates with an outstanding athletic background who can offer clear evidence of **significant athletic activities**(preferably in one of these 3 sports: **basketball, volleyball and waterpolo**) **at a competitive level**, such as participation in or selection for competitions or tournaments organized at national or international level prior to the date of enrollment ### Tuition waivers MCF 2026-2027 - ###### Female 3 partial tuition waivers [ - ###### Outstanding 3 partial tuition waivers [ - ###### Merit-based tuition waivers Partial tuition waivers [ - ######

Finance and accounting _Start_ 30 September 2026 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Full-time _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 3 years _Credits_ 70 ECTS/CFU The Master in Corporate Finance (MCF) is an intensive and stimulating one-year program in English, offering 70 CFU/ECTS credits, designed to provide you with the knowledge and skills to master the techniques and tools of international finance management and to drive innovation, whether you work for a company or an institution. We train an élite of highly skilled finance professionals, well-equipped to take their future career to the highest levels. - ### Words from the Director ![words-from-the-director_mcf_federico-pippo_copertina.jpg ]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mcf/video-gallery/) ![Who is it for?]( ## Who is it for The MCF class is made up of people who love challenges and know how to get completely involved in a demanding experience. The spectrum of nationalities, ages, genders, professional experiences, and academic backgrounds in our MCF classes brings a fruitful exchange and an extraordinary energy. **MCF 2025-2026** 83 Students 27 % Women 25 years Average age 3 years Average work experience [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mcf/class-profile/) ## Why MCF - ### A challenging program to build a solid career MCF is a specialized Master, 100% finance-focused, that gives you the chance to tackle financial tasks directly, without any additional training. It offers articulated content, and differentiated teaching methods to guarantee the best learning. - ### MCF is part of the CFA Institute University Affiliation Program The CFA Institute is the most important association of investment professionals (most notably security analysts, money managers and investment advisers), which has a world-renowned certification known as the CFA Institute (CFA) Exam. The CFA Institute was born in the United States in the 1960s and the CFA Exam is now one of the most well known certifications in the financial profession. Each year, tens of thousands of candidates enroll in the CFA Program and sit for the exams in test centers all over the world. The CFA Institute recognizes as CFA University Affiliation Program those Finance courses that cover 70% of the CFA Candidate body of knowledge in their programs. MCF students will benefit from this opportunity with a level one complimentary sample exam, financial news briefs, access to ethics modules, and scholarships to take the level one exam at a reduced price. - ### An ideal structure for effective learning The program is divided into 4 stages, from pre-courses in finance to seminars. The structure of the program is flexible and includes conferences, company visits and company presentations, mock interviews with HR, coaching, team building and other leisure initiatives. You will complete an intensive program in financial studies in one year, and you will benefit from the prestige of Università Bocconi and SDA Bocconi in Finance. - ### An engaging learning model

title: MCF Master in Corporate Finance | SDA Bocconi
text: - ### An ideal structure for effective learning The program is divided into 4 stages, from pre-courses in finance to seminars. The structure of the program is flexible and includes conferences, company visits and company presentations, mock interviews with HR, coaching, team building and other leisure initiatives. You will complete an intensive program in financial studies in one year, and you will benefit from the prestige of Università Bocconi and SDA Bocconi in Finance. - ### An engaging learning model Different methodologies are used throughout the program: class sessions, case study discussions, simulations and role-playing exercises. The experience is also enriched with visiting professors and professional guest speakers, individual and group “hands on” assignments. - ### MCF is a CAIA Association Specialized Course **Benefits for Students** - Finance students nominated by SDA Bocconi representative can apply for **CAIA Academic Partner Program Scholarships**, substantially reducing the exam fee for both Level I and Level II exams. - Scholarship recipients can sit for the exam during any of the **three upcoming exam cycles** following their award date. - Scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis, with **up to eight student scholarships** available each calendar year. **Application Details** - Applications for both faculty and student scholarships must be approved **before** exam registration. - Student eligibility requires **current enrollment** at the School and **nomination** by the School’s representative. **Complete details on the CAIA Academic Scholarship Program can be found here:** [https://caia.org/scholarships](https://caia.org/scholarships) - ### A growing network, treasuring teamwork and diversity The MCF network includes participants from several countries and widely varied professional backgrounds, lecturers, guest speakers, and the entire Bocconi Alumni Community. Bocconi professors, tutors, and visiting professors will offer a broad perspective. Business consultants, company managers and entrepreneurs will bring you their daily experience of managerial life: a fine blend of theory and practice, international network, treasuring teamwork and diversity. - ### Milano: not just a financial capital The MCF gives you the chance to live and study in the heart of one of Europe’s most dynamic and productive regions. You will have the opportunity to discover everything that Milan has to offer as a symbol of Italian culture and style, in addition to being Italy’s financial and industrial capital. Although the program is very demanding, learning more about the city will certainly be an interesting part of your stay. - ### Mumbai As part of our commitment to offering a global finance education, the Master in Corporate Finance program provides students with the exclusive opportunity to join the **SDA Bocconi Asia Center** in Mumbai from June to October 2026. The main goal of the MCF Field project is to give students the opportunity to test their knowledge and apply the lessons learned in class to a specific business case, while collaborating with their team members and the company representatives within a real corporate environment. - ### Leaders in Finance Series This initiative is organized to expose our students to knowledge and experience from top leaders of international companies. - ### Seminars These seminars have been carefully designed to enhance your academic curriculum, offering you unique insights and practical skills that are essential for success in the dynamic field of finance. Throughout the duration of your program, you will have the opportunity to participate in a series of seminars led by industry experts and esteemed faculty members. - ### Financial Databases & Data Analytics Within the program you will have the chance to access top international financial databases and use software for simulations and for data presentation. text: Master of International Healthcare Management, Economics and Policy [Apply [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/wishlist/) Admissions # Selection and admissions process The admission requirements and selection process for the MIHMEP program are designed to ensure strong alignment between the program and your aspirations. This rigorous approach aims to meet your expectations while providing a foundation for personal and professional growth. We select candidates from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds, as this diversity enriches the learning experience at both the individual and group levels. Our selection process involves a holistic evaluation of your application materials, considering key factors such as skills, professional experience, personal drive, and leadership and growth potential. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. text: Master of International Healthcare Management, Economics and Policy [Apply [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Attending the program entails a significant amount of financial commitment but always repays itself with a wide margin. The SDA Bocconi's MIHMEP is an intensive program requiring a hefty investment in time and money. ![MIHMEP graduation]( ## Fees and expenses The total fee for the MIHMEP 2026-2027 program is € 30,000 to be paid in five installments - First installment **€ 3,500** upon acceptance of admission offer to the Master Program - Second installment **€ 7,500** by 30 October 2026 - Third installment **€ 7,500** by 18 December 2026 - Fourth installment **€ 7,500** by 26 February 2027 - Fifth installment **€ 4,000** by 30 April 2027 **Admission process fee: €120** **The fees include** - All teaching material - Access to SDA Bocconi’s facilities Participants must provide their own laptop. **Fees do not include** Accommodation or living expenses. Personal expenses will vary significantly depending on your lifestyle. In general, the cost of living in Milan is comparable to that of other major European cities. We aim to provide you with a forecast of monthly expenses as experienced by MAMA students in recent years: - Housing: € 800 - 1500 - Meals: € 450 - Transports: € 100 - Misc. Expenses: € 350 **Total:** 1.700-2.400 € ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round:_ 10 December 2025 _2nd round:_ 02 February 2026 _3rd round:_ 02 April 2026 _4th round:_ 28 May 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for outstanding candidates, thanks to the ongoing support of companies, organizations, alums, and current students. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the MIHMEP selection process **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must:** - Submit their application for the MIHMEP 2026-2027 program - Review the pre-requisites for each tuition waiver - Flag the tuition waiver option through the online application portal by the indicated deadline **Important:** - Applicants will only be considered eligible for a tuition waiver after completing the MIHMEP application, including the online form and all supporting documents. - You can apply for scholarships and tuition waivers even if your selection process is still in progress. However, only admitted candidates will be evaluated for the awarding of a tuition waiver or scholarship. - If you meet multiple requirements, you may apply for more than one scholarship or tuition waiver. title: MIHMEP - Specializations | SDA Bocconi
text: Master of International Healthcare Management, Economics and Policy [Apply [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/wishlist/) MIHMEP # Specializations Students complete their specialization courses: [Global Health & Development](https://www.sdabocconi.it/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/specializations/#globalhealth), [Healthcare [Pharmaceutical & Medical Technology](https://www.sdabocconi.it/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/specializations/#pharmaceutical). - ![Viviana Mangiaterra]( ###### [**Global Health & Development**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/specializations/\#globalhealth) Viviana Mangiaterra, Coordinator - ![lucia_ferrara_cv.jpg]( ###### [**Healthcare Lucia Ferrara, Coordinator - ![patrizio_armeni_cv.jpg]( ###### [**Pharmaceutical & Medical Technology**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mihmep/specializations/\#pharmaceutical) Patrizio Armeni, Coordinator ### Global Health & Development (GH&D) Through examining structures, policies, strategies, and managerial approaches of both public and private global actors (WHO, World Bank, Foundations such ad Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation or the Global Fund, and Non-Governmental Organizations), the GH&D specialization prepares students to become active actors in the **achievement of equity in health for people worldwide**. This Specialization provides students with an overview of challenges in the changing global scene in health-related policy making and management at the global level. It allows students to understand the key issues of healthcare systems, policies and management in low-income and emerging countries, and to develop most relevant skills to engage with international institutions and transnational non-state actors (including public-private partnerships, global philanthropies, corporations and non-governmental organizations). If the students choose this specialization, they are likely to pursue a career in international organizations and institutions (e.g. the WHO), International NGOs, Global partnerships and other organizations involved in GH&D issues. ## Healthcare Management (HCM) The HCM specialization is designed to develop managerial competences and create leaders and managers prepared to tackle all kinds of challenges. The program equips participants with the **hard skills** needed to shape and lead healthcare organizations effectively. From strategic and operational management to quality and performance improvement, from insurance and financial control to consulting, innovation, and communication, participants build a comprehensive toolkit to navigate and transform the healthcare landscape. Students will also gain a deep understanding of the **soft skills** required to be successful managers in healthcare environments, such as change management practices, group leadership, management of interpersonal relationships and individual appraisal. The specialization is designed with particular attention to the specificities of hospitals, primary care organizations, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers, health maintenance organizations, and other integrated healthcare delivery systems, as well as consultancy firms. It also prepares participants for emerging opportunities in healthcare start-ups and digital technology providers that are driving innovation and transforming healthcare organizations and service delivery models. ### Pharmaceutical & Medical Technology (P&MT) The P&MT specialization is focused on the dynamics of **different industries** (pharmaceuticals, biopharmaceuticals and other technologies produced through biotechnological processes, medical devices and other medical technologies). Students learn about the **regulatory environment, management issues and tools** to assess and promote added value of emerging technologies: HTA (Health Technology Assessment), economic evaluation, pricing strategies, stakeholders’ management and marketing strategy. Students choosing this specialization are likely to find positions in **pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical technology companies or consulting firms** in areas such as Health Economics and Outcome Research, Market Access, Marketing Strategy, Public Affairs. We assess not only whether you are the right profile for MiMS, but also whether MiMS meets your expectations. Admission involves a rigorous selection process, which evaluates the personal motivations, educational background, and professional experience (including brief) of candidates, with special emphasis on interest in the healthcare field. Each year, MiMS welcomes young, highly motivated, and culturally innovation-oriented people, qualities essential to understanding the logic of how the industry operates and contributing to its constant evolution. The selection thus ensures the formation of a class in which talented individuals can not only pursue their professional and personal goals but also enrich the classroom learning experience. ###### Deadlines **Tuition waivers** 1st round: 30 June 2026 2nd round: 30 September 2026 3rd round: 25 November 2026 **Application** 25 November 2026 ![Direttrice MIMS]( ## Your next steps - ### 1\. Selection results are never communicated by telephone. All decisions made by the Admissions committee are final. The selection process can result in one of the following outcomes: **Admission:** You will receive the official admission notice along with the participation contract. You must confirm your participation by the deadline specified by the Admissions committee. If all available spots have been filled, the school may place you on a waiting list or offer admission for the following edition. Admission to the program is valid for the year the application is submitted. However, you can request deferment to the following year, but approval of deferment is on a case-by-case decision by the Admissions committee. **Non-admission:** the selection process evaluates not only the individual profile but also the overall composition of the MiMS class. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mims/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. Here, you don’t just learn—you live the experience. ## Student Clubs **Clubs** are a key part of the SDA Bocconi experience, fostering connections and sparking new ideas through exchanges among students, Faculty, Alums, and industry professionals. text: Master in Management per la Sanità [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/it_IT/courses/course/29-mims-master-management-per-la-sanita) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mims/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mims/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Participating in MiMS requires a significant financial commitment, but it is a strategic choice that guarantees a high return, both personally and professionally. ![Classe MIMS]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for MiMS 2027-28 is €24,000 (excluding VAT), payable in four installments. - First installment **€ 6,000** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€ 6,000** by 31 March 2027 - Third installment **€ 6,000** by 31 May 2027 - Fourth installment **€ 6,000** by 30 July 2027 The fee includes: - in-house teaching materials, use of the School's facilities - Study Tour costs (travel and lodging). Participants must have a personal laptop. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers Based on exclusive merit criteria, SDA Bocconi makes available concessions on the fee for the Master in Healthcare Management by offering partial waivers for outstanding profiles. Applications must be submitted at the application stage by the deadlines specified in the competition notices. **To apply for a waiver, you must:** - Have completed and submitted the Application for Admission to MiMS, with all the documents required. - Submit the application in response to the notice, attaching the documentation indicated, via the Application portal. - Meet the deadlines and carefully check the requirements, without which the application cannot be accepted. If, when a notice is published, the online application has already been submitted, the candidate may access it again and make the waiver request by the deadline stipulated in the notice. **Applications will be evaluated on the basis of:** - Academic and professional curriculum. - Requirements stated in the notice. - Selection test results at MiMS. The allocation of waivers will take place during the selection process, by the dates indicated in the announcement. It is possible to apply even before the conclusion of the selection process. Admission to MiMS is independent of any waiver or scholarship award. ### Tuition waivers MiMS XXVI Edition ### Tuition waivers SDA Bocconi ### Tuition waivers for excellent athlete candidates ## Loans and funding SDA Bocconi assists candidates and applicants in their search for funding by providing the necessary documentation to finalize applications for financial support. For more information you can consult the section on funding on the Bocconi University website (for [Italian](https://www.unibocconi.it/it/studenti-iscritti/agevolazioni/finanziamenti-master-universitari-e-sda), for [international applicants](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/student-loans)). The application for funding must be received by the School by the end of the month following the course start date. The University also makes information available to international students regarding [possible sources of funding](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/funding-country) in different countries of the world. ![Contacts]( Contact us If you need further clarification on program fees, scholarships, and funding opportunities, please contact the Admissions team: [+39 02 5836 3119](tel:+390258363119) [admissions.mims@sdabocconi.it](mailto:admissions.mims@sdabocconi.it) ![app]( ![Merchandising](

Healthcare _Start_ 25 January 2027 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Full-time _Language_ Italian _Avg. working experience_ 2 years _Credits_ 70 ECTS/CFU The Master in Healthcare Management (MiMS) is the 12-month undergraduate Master program that will enable talented young people to acquire and develop the skills and abilities needed for a successful career in public and private healthcare companies, technology provider companies, research and training centers, and the world of healthcare consulting. - ### Words from the Director ![Francesca Lecci - Direttrice MiMS]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mims/video-gallery/) ![MBA - Who is it for?]( ## Who is it for Any MiMS student, a new health manager profile. Participants in the Master in Healthcare Management are young graduates and professionals from any disciplinary background. The class consists of motivated people who want to play an active role in renewal of the Italian healthcare system, its companies and institutions. **MiMS editions: XXII - XXIII - XXIV - XXV** 27 Students 60 % Women 2 years Average work experience 28 years Average age [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/mims/class-profile/) ## Why MiMS - ### Quick placement The MiMS course includes an internship in companies in the industry that often turns into or gives access to a professional opportunity. 97% of participants find employment within the first year, and of them 62% with permanent contracts. - ### Action learning MiMS not only provides you with theoretical knowledge, but also allows you to continuously put your skills into practice in a real professional setting. The second part of MiMS is in fact entirely dedicated to Action Learning: a unique educational experience that combines lectures, testimonials from companies and professionals, field research in collaboration with partner companies, site visits and study tours, and finally internship. - ### Entrepreneurship MiMS offers an innovative path towards working on your business idea in healthcare, starting with an elective Business Planning course and involvement with challengers and mentors from the MiMS Alumni Community and Bocconi Faculty. - ### A Path to Self Management MiMS provides a pathway to support you as you enter the job market by developing both the skills most in demand and awareness of your professional aptitudes. The self-management course includes individual and group counseling on CVs and job interviews. [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/node/14549/) - ### Solid experience and constant contact with the world of healthcare MiMS is an in-house part of an executive school of the caliber of SDA Bocconi and has a dedicated faculty that has been working in the healthcare sector in Italy for about 50 years. Educational content is constantly updated through CERGAS research and training activities of the Government, Health and Non-Profit Division. Frequent participation of testimonials, field project partners and recruiters is provided for. - ### Membership of the large SDA Bocconi network

May 2028 #### Graduation ## A comprehensive learning experience - ### The transformative process: from models to practices The MiMS learning model is composite, interactive and coherent. It includes: - Classroom lectures - Guided discussions of case studies - Testimonials from healthcare professionals - Exercises, case studies, simulations, group work - Field research - In-company field projects (internships) - Distance learning via a dedicated online platform - Examinations for each of the courses activated, with individual and group tests. - ### Sector-wide Pathway: Self Management and Leadership in Healthcare (Feb - Sept 2027) The objective of the course is to provide you with the tools to support your entry into the labor market by developing useful skills, increasing awareness of your professional aptitudes and knowledge of industry-specific characteristics. Individual and group counseling on CVs and job interviews are provided - ### Study Tour In an industry that is constantly changing and innovating, engaging with companies and professionals from different backgrounds becomes essential. The study tour pursues this goal by selecting the destination from a wide range of best practices and by means of a combination of lectures, testimonials and site visits. - ### In-Company Project The in-company project completes the program through a hands-on experience that allows students to join a company and develop a field-based training project. The final phase of MiMS is dedicated to Field Projects, in which each student applies and leverages the knowledge and skills developed during the Master’s program. The strong and long-standing relationships with partner companies enable MiMS to identify opportunities across a wide range of organizations (from public and private healthcare providers to technology suppliers and consulting firms) within the complex healthcare sector. For participants who already work in healthcare, it is possible to carry out the field project within their current organization. - ### Field Research Targeted research on a topic assigned based on individual preferences, carried out in groups of 5–6 participants under the supervision of an SDA Bocconi tutor. We assess not only whether you are the right profile for MISA, but also whether MISA meets your expectations. Admission is through a rigorous selection process that highlights personal motivations and aptitudes and ensures each year the creation of a class group in which talented individuals can not only pursue career goals and personal aspirations, but also enrich the class group learning experience. **DEADLINES** **Tuition waivers** 1st round: 23 April 2026 2nd round: 15 July 2026 3rd round: 12 November 2026 **Application** 12 November 2026 The information regarding the next edition will be available shortly. ![MISA]( ## Your next steps - ### 1\. Interview ## What we need from you The following documents must be uploaded to the relevant section of the online Application portal and submitted to the Admissions team: ### Curriculum vitae ### Degree Certificate, Transcripts ### GMAT / GRE result ### TOEFL / IELTS / PTE / CAE result ### Additional materials required: Upon receipt of the application, the Admissions team will initiate **pre-selection** based on the documentation submitted. If this is found to be suitable you will be contacted for the next steps in the selection process consisting of a **test and an individual interview**. ### SDA Test ### Interview ## Admissions results As soon as the selection process is completed you will receive a formal letter from the Admissions team, notifying you of the admission decision. Selection results are never communicated by telephone. All decisions made by the Admissions committee are final. The selection process can result in one of the following outcomes: **Admission:** You will receive the official admission notice along with the participation contract. You must confirm your participation by the deadline specified by the Admissions committee. If all available spots have been filled, the school may place you on a **waiting list** or offer admission for the following edition. Admission to the program is valid for the year the application is submitted. However, you can request deferment to the following year, but approval of deferment is on a case-by-case decision by the Admissions committee. **Non-admission:** the selection process evaluates not only the individual profile but also the overall composition of the MISA class group. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class Profile**]( reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. Here, you don’t just learn - you live the experience. The MISA learning experience is further enriched by the International Camp, a week of study abroad at an international Business School. Through seminars with the local faculty, meetings with managers and prominent business leaders, and company visits to internationally significant firms, participants have the opportunity to deepen their understanding of a specific market, engage directly with global realities, and broaden their perspectives - ![misa]( - ![misa]( - ![MISA]( - ![misa]( - ![misa]( - ![misa]( ## Student Clubs **Clubs** are a key part of the SDA Bocconi experience, fostering connections

However, it is a strategic investment that delivers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![MISA]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the MISA 2027 is €30,000 (outside the scope of VAT), payable in four installments - First installment **€ 8,000** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€ 8,000** by 26 March 2027 - Third installment **€ 7,000** by 28 May 2027 - Fourth installment **€7.000** by 30 July 2027 The fee includes: - Enrollment in the Master's Program; - All teaching materials; - Use of the infrastructure and services of SDA Bocconi. Participants must provide their own laptop. ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 23 Apr 2026 _2nd round_ 15 Jul 2026 _3rd round_ 12 Nov 2026 To apply for a waiver you must: - have completed and submitted the MISA Application for Admission, with all required documents; - submit the application in response to the notice, attaching the indicated documents, through the Application for Admission portal; - meet the deadlines and carefully check the requirements, without which the application cannot be accepted. Applications will be evaluated on the basis of: - academic and professional resume; - letter of motivation; - requirements stated in the announcement; - selection test results at MISA. The tuition waivers will be awarded during the selection process, by the dates indicated in the announcement. It is possible to apply even before the conclusion of the selection process. Admission to MISA is independent of any waiver or scholarship award. ### Tuition waivers MISA 2027 - ###### Profiles of excellence €15,000 Open competition call [ - ###### Profiles of excellence €10,000 Open competition call [ - ###### Profiles of excellence €5,000 Open competition call [ - ###### Candidate - Athlets Open competition call [ ## Loans and funding SDA Bocconi assists candidates and applicants in their search for funding by providing the necessary documentation to finalize applications for financial support. Entrepreneurship and family business _Start_ January 2027 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Full-time _Language_ Italian _Avg. working experience_ 3 years **Sustainability, digital transformation, technological revolution:** in an ever-changing environment, interpreting change and turning it into opportunities requires creativity, strategic vision and entrepreneurial skills. The speed with which new trends develop makes it necessary to be able to read these changes and create innovative solutions, putting innovation at the center of one's work. To achieve this goal, the **Master in Imprenditorialità e Strategia Aziendale** offers an integrated approach that combines academic knowledge with practical application through individual projects. During the course, students will gain in-depth knowledge in business administration and entrepreneurship/innovation. These two pillars form the foundation of the academic pathway, providing students with the skills needed to excel in various facets of the corporate world. This combination of academic knowledge and practical application will best prepare them to become the change agents in tomorrow's corporate world. With a **'learning by doing’** teaching methodology, characterized by **integrated project works** which allow the theoretical concepts learned in the classroom to be put into practice, MISA aims to train a new generation of leaders capable of successfully meeting the challenges of the ever-changing corporate world. - ### Words from the Director ![Image]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/misa/video-gallery/) ![target]( ## Who is it for In 1 year full-time you will develop the skills and mindset needed to accelerate your professional growth. You will acquire solid business management skills in functional areas such as Administration and Finance, Sales, Marketing and Organization, but also strong innovative attitudes to generate value through significant trends such as sustainability, digitization, development of new services and products based on technologies such as blockchain and artificial intelligence. Specifically, MISA prepares you for three career paths: FAMILY BUSINESS MANAGEMENT & CONSULTING START-UP **MISA 2023 / 2024 / 2025** 32 Students 31 % Women 3 years Average work experience 25 years Average age [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/misa/class-profile/) ## Why MISA - ### For effective learning We offer you a pragmatic and hands-on learning method that engages you from the very beginning with real innovation and business development projects — the best way to test your skills and fully express your potential. - ### For the educational experience We offer you high-level management content and professional skills through high-impact teaching tools, direct and engaging experiences, and a practical edge that is always measured against the real dynamics of the working world. - ### For the opportunity to work on your project During the course, you will have the unique opportunity to work on your own personal project, whether it is an ambitious start-up, an improvement in your family business, or a research project in a company. - ### For international openness We have designed a

There are also courses dedicated to developing teamwork skills, effective communication in public, and the use of databases. This is a key time to confront real projects, face concrete business innovation challenges, and touch on the processes and strategies that can lead a business to change, grow and develop. In particular, this session of MISA is devoted to the practical application of three key themes: **Creativity and design thinking** It stimulates entrepreneurial attitude and allows you to experience firsthand the launch of a start-up, developing all stages of its creation, with final presentation in front of potential investors. **Evolving scenarios** Through a theoretical approach, the course provides an overview on the major trends that are shaping the future of business, stimulating reflection on the opportunities and challenges arising from them. **Digital transformation** Offers in-depth and applied knowledge of business models and digital innovation within traditional enterprises, showing their implications for all business functions. November 2027December 2027 #### Step 5 - Implementation ## A comprehensive learning experience - ### A balance between theory and practice The program combines face-to-face lectures on Monday through Wednesday, half a day on campus and half a day devoted to extra-campus activities (case-study analysis, individual and/or group exercises, learning and preparation for exams), with sessions devoted to project work on Thursday and Friday, offering a balance of theory and practical application. The program is taught mainly in Italian but also includes teaching materials and activities in English (international series, international camp). - ### Learning excellence MISA has achieved the AACSB international certification, which is awarded to the most important business schools in the world. In addition to constituting a guarantee of program quality, this accreditation certifies the educational objectives that are achieved through the Master's program. The certified objectives of MISA cover the development of the following skills: Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving Skills, Entrepreneurial Mindset and Creativity, Management Knowledge, Team Work and Leadership Skills, Project & Process Management Skills, Diversity and Global Business Issues, Ethics and Integrity. ## Faculty ![mario_daniele_amore_cv]( Mario Daniele Amore Academic Director [View CV](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty-research/faculty-knowledge/mario-daniele-amore/) To succeed in this environment, tomorrow's managers will need to possess a dual set of skills: management and entrepreneurial innovation. This rigorous approach aims to meet your expectations while providing a foundation for personal and professional growth. We select candidates from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds, as this diversity enriches the learning experience at both the individual and group levels. Our selection process involves a holistic evaluation of your application materials, considering key factors such as skills, professional experience, personal drive, and leadership and growth potential. Through this process, we aim to create a class of outstanding individuals who will benefit from the program—not only to achieve their career goals and personal aspirations but also to enrich their peers' learning experience. **DEADLINES** **Tuition waivers** 23 April 2026 8 July 2026 28 October 2026 **Application** 28 October 2026 ![MSM Class]( ## Your next steps - ### 1. Interview ## What we need from you The following documents must be uploaded to the relevant section of the [**Online Application**](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/en_US/courses/course/20-msm-master-sustainability-management) portal and submitted to the Admissions team: ### Degree certificate and transcript ### Professional experience, detailed CV ### GMAT/ GRE or SDA Test ### Two references ### Additional materials required ## Admissions results As soon as the selection process is completed, you will receive a formal letter from the Admissions committee notifying you of the decision. Selection results are never communicated by telephone. All decisions made by the Admissions committee are final. The selection process will result in one of the following outcomes: **Admission:** You will receive the official admission notice along with the participation contract. You must confirm your participation by the deadline specified by the Admissions committee. If all available spots have been filled, the school may place you on a waiting list or offer admission for the following edition. Admission to the program is valid for the year the application is submitted. However, you can request deferment to the following year, but approval of deferment is on a case-by-case decision by the Admissions committee. **Non-Admission:** Admission to the program is highly selective. Our selection process evaluates each candidate’s individual profile while also considering the overall composition of the MSM class, which must be consistent with the quality and diversity the school requires. While we acknowledge the significant effort all candidates invest in the application and the selection process, we do not provide personalized feedback to non-admitted candidates. ## How to apply The application form is available **exclusively online** and must be completed with accurate and precise information regarding your personal and professional experiences and your reasons for attending the program. **Please note that the online application portal

Only submitted applications will be considered for the selection process. The Admissions team will contact you in case any documentation is missing. text: Master in Sustainability Management [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/en_US/courses/course/20-msm-master-sustainability-management) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/msm/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/msm/wishlist/) # The MSM experience: learn, connect, transform - ![SDA Bocconi]( ## A world of perspectives: the value of diversity Diversity at SDA Bocconi is more than a value—it’s the driving force behind a transformative learning experience. Our classrooms bring together bright minds from across the globe, each contributing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. This exchange fosters innovation, broadens horizons, and prepares our participants to navigate the complexities of a global business environment. As part of this commitment, our [**Class profile**](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/msm/class-profile/) reflects an extraordinary mix of nationalities, industries, and professional experiences, ensuring that every discussion is enriched by a variety of viewpoints. But we don’t stop there. **International Student Care** is our way of ensuring that every participant, no matter where they’re from, feels at home at SDA Bocconi. Moving to a new country is exciting, but we know it comes with challenges. That’s why **Alice Dealessi** and **Valentina Grassi** are here to support you every step of the way, from visas and permits to stay, to cultural integration and daily life tips. Beyond this, our **Program Management team** plays a fundamental role in ensuring that every student is guided and supported throughout their on-campus journey. Acting as dedicated points of reference, our Program Managers provide personalized assistance, fostering an environment where students feel heard, valued, and cared for. We’re not just shaping your education - we’re shaping an experience that feels like home. Need more details? Reach out to Alice and Valentina at [studentcare@sdabocconi.it](mailto:studentcare@sdabocconi.it) ## Inside-out learning: an experience without borders At SDA Bocconi, learning extends far beyond the classroom. We believe that the most impactful experiences happen when knowledge is applied, connections are made, and perspectives are broadened. That’s why our **extracurricular activities** are designed to bring the business world to life and help you build lasting relationships along the way. The **architecture of our campus** also reflects this philosophy. Designed with **transparency, accessibility, and openness** in mind, our buildings feature vast glass facades, open spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. This unique structure symbolizes our commitment to breaking down barriers, creating a continuous exchange of ideas and knowledge that extends far beyond the classroom. ![campus Milano]( ## Extracurricular activities Every experience and challenge is an opportunity to refine your skills, expand your perspective, and step outside your comfort zone, deepening your understanding of diverse business landscapes. text: Master in Sustainability Management [Apply Now](https://apply.sdabocconi.it/en_US/courses/course/20-msm-master-sustainability-management) [Download brochure](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/msm/downloadbrochure/) [Open wishlist form](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/msm/wishlist/) # Fees and scholarships **A challenging but high-return investment** Participation in the MSM program implies a fair financial commitment. But it is a strategic investment that certainly offers high future returns—both personally and professionally. ![MSM studente]( ## Fees and expenses The tuition fee for the MSM 2027 program is € 30,000, payable in four installments - First installment **€ 8,000** upon acceptance of admission - Second installment **€ 8,000** by 25 February 2027 - Third installment **€ 7,000** by 29 April 2027 - Fourth installment **€ 7,000** by 30 June 2027 **Application fee: €120** **The fees include:** - Most teaching material (although some texts must be purchased separately) - Access to SDA Bocconi’s facilities and database - Courses in Italian language, with the possibility of attaining the CILS qualification of Italian language proficiency Participants must provide their own laptop. **Other expenses:** Personal expenses will vary significantly depending on each individual's lifestyle. In general, the cost of living in Milan is comparable to that of other major European cities. We aim to provide you with an accurate expectation of monthly expenses based on information provided by our full-time master students in recent years: - Housing: € 800-1500 - Meals: € 450 - Transport: € 100 - Misc. Expenses: € 350 Total € 1,700-2,400 ## Scholarships and tuition waivers _1st round_ 23 April 2026 _2nd round_ 08 July 2026 _3rd round_ 28 October 2026 Each year, SDA Bocconi School of Management makes multiple merit-based scholarships and tuition waivers available for outstanding candidates. **Applications are evaluated according to the following criteria:** - Analysis of the requirements indicated in the specific notice of competition - Analysis of academic and professional records - Results of the MSM selection process **To be eligible for a tuition waiver, applicants must:** - Submit their application for the MSM 2027 program - Review the pre-requisites for the tuition waiverl - Flag the tuition waiver option through the online application portal by the indicated deadline **Important:** - Applicants will be considered eligible for a tuition waiver only after completing the MSM application, including the online form and all supporting documents - You can apply for scholarships and tuition waivers even if your selection process is still in progress. However, only admitted candidates will be evaluated for the awarding of a tuition waiver or scholarship - If you meet multiple requirements, you may apply for more than one scholarship or tuition waiver The tuition waivers will be awarded during the selection process and no later than the starting date of the MSM 2027 Program. Participants are encouraged to explore various funding opportunities available in different countries, such as employer sponsorships or scholarships provided by private foundations, international organizations, or local governments. ### Tuition waivers MSM 2027 For the 2027 MSM edition, multiple tuition waivers (covering up to 50% of the total tuition fee) are available to outstanding candidates. Sustainability, diversity and inclusion _Start_ January 2027 _Duration_ 12 months _Where_ Milano _Format_ Full-time _Language_ English _Avg. working experience_ 3 years _Credits_ 70 ECTS/CFU **Climate change, biodiversity loss, energy transitions.** These aren’t just headlines. They’re the defining challenges of our time. While global political debates may shift perspectives, businesses, organizations, and civil society continue to treat sustainability as a priority. The need for skilled professionals who can drive real solutions remains stronger than ever. The **Master in Sustainability Management (MSM) is your chance** to be part of the solution. This intensive, one-year program **(70 ECTS credits)**, prepares you to tackle sustainability from every angle ‒ business, policy, and innovation. Whether you aim to work in industry, services, international agencies, nonprofits, or the public sector, MSM gives you the tools to make an impact where it matters most. - ### Words from the Director ![Master in Sustainability Management. Matteo Di Castelnuovo - MSM Director | SDA Bocconi]( [Watch all videosWatch all videos](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/msm/video-gallery/) ![MSM Class]( ## Who is it for The Master in Sustainability Management is right for you if: **You want to** be more than just a professional ‒ you want to drive the shift toward a sustainable future. **You see** your career on a global stage, working in sustainability, energy, or innovation with top organizations across public and private sectors. **You believe** that climate change and sustainability aren’t just challenges ‒ they’re opportunities to reshape economies and societies. **You’re looking for** a program that blends theory with real-world practice, all in just one year. **You value** earning an internationally recognized qualification from one of the world’s most prestigious business schools, alongside a diverse, global cohort. **You aim** to master the economic, regulatory, and managerial aspects of environmental and energy issues through a hands-on, well-rounded learning experience. If you see yourself in these statements, this is your next step. **MSM 2026** 22 Students 68 % Women 28 years Average age [Class profile](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/specialized-master-full-time-executive/msm/class-profile/) ## Why MSM - ### Shape the future of business with sustainability This Master isn’t just about learning ‒ it’s about leading. You'll gain deep expertise in corporate sustainability, green management, sustainable supply chains, energy markets, finance, and advanced management techniques, while integrating environmental and social sustainability into strategic decision-making. In a world where sustainability is no longer optional, you’ll be ready to drive change across organizations, creating value that is economic, environmental and social in fast-moving, global industries. - ### Learn from the best Our faculty isn’t just world-class ‒ they’re game-changers. Thought leaders in sustainability, energy, and climate change, they collaborate with top organizations worldwide. Their research and expertise fuel real impact, making our program a launchpad for future leaders. - ### An immersive, hands-on experience This full-time program (January–December) blends 450+ hours of coursework with real-world experience: an internship

Whether you’re starting fresh or pivoting your career, you’ll gain the skills, network, and mindset to make sustainability your competitive edge. - ### Management meeting purpose Management fundamentals are never neutral: they are tools to drive meaningful impact. During your journey you’ll master strategy, finance and operations while learning to anchor every decision to a cause, a responsibility, a broader vision. The goal is to shape purpose-driven leaders who can create value in any industry, aligning performance with impact and business with meaning. - ### Partners that move the world forward Our network isn’t just global ‒ it’s influential. SDA Bocconi collaborates with top international organizations leading the charge in sustainability and energy. These partnerships open doors for recruitment, research, and real-world projects, placing you at the intersection of learning and action. - ### Learn from those who lead Why learn about sustainability only from a textbook when you can hear it firsthand? Throughout the program, top executives from global organizations share how they turned sustainability challenges into opportunities. Their stories aren’t just inspiring ‒ they’re roadmaps to the kind of leader you can become. ## Highlights - 70 ECTS Credits - 450 + Hours of coursework - 320 h Of internship (minimum) Want to know more about MSM? January 2027April 2027 #### Core modules This phase of MSM consists of **9 in-class compulsory courses**, **1 seminar** and **1 compulsory workshop** in green economy with the purpose of providing the fundamental knowledge and skills to tackle issues related to sustainability and energy challenges.
