Field projects will be **organized with leading global organizations** in the fields of corporate sustainability, energy and environment. May 2027October 2027 #### Specialization modules: concentration track There are three specialization tracks: **• SUSTAINABLE ENERGY TRANSITION** **• SUSTAINABILITY MANAGEMENT AND STRATEGIES** **• SUSTAINABLE VALUE CREATION AND FINANCE (SCF)** Each track includes four specialized courses aiming at further training students in a particular subarea of sustainability depending on their professional ambitions. Each student must **choose one track** at the beginning of the master and then attend all four relevant courses; furthermore each student will have to attend **two more specialized courses from the other tracks**. September 2027December 2027 #### Final project (alternative options) In the last phase students can opt for **either a in-company experience**, for a minimum of 12 weeks **or** for **research project**. The in-company experience and research project will be tutored by the Master’s faculty members. February 2028 #### Wrapping up your experience Discuss and present your final project Engage with Bocconi Alumni Community February 2028 #### Graduation ## A comprehensive learning experience - ### Learning environment MSM integrates an intensive face-to-face teaching approach, essential for engaging with faculty and guest speakers, fostering participant interaction, and ensuring effective group dynamics. The program also includes self-directed learning moments such as case studies, group projects, virtual teamwork, simulations and experiential learning. - ### A balance between theory and practice The program combines in-class lectures, case study analysis, simulations and role playing, individual and group exercises, offering a well-rounded balance between theoretical learning and practical application. - ### Faculty and industry experts The program is led by SDA Bocconi faculty and enriched by contributions from managers, entrepreneurs, and business leaders, offering valuable professional and personal perspectives to enhance the learning experience. - ### Leaders in sustainability series Senior executives from Italian and international organizations will deliver seminars, sharing experience and insights in sustainability to enrich students’ knowledge and connect theory with real-world practice. ## Faculty ![Matteo Di Castelnuovo]( Matteo Giacomo Di Castelnuovo Academic Director [View CV](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty-research/faculty-knowledge/matteo-giacomo-di-castelnuovo/) There is a broad consensus that sustainability must become a priority in all decision-making processes within governments, corporations, and institutions at large. text: # Student Clubs ### Professional - ![consulting-club_logo]( Fosters interaction between aspiring consultants and the industry, offering resources and networking occasions to enhance skills and foster valuable relationships in management consulting. - ![entrepreneurship-club]( Gathers students passionate about new businesses, technology and innovation, encouraging business creation, innovative ideas, and a startup mindset for personal and professional success. - ![financeclub]( Focuses on finance knowledge, training, and networking. Provides workshops, events, and resources to deepen financial expertise and prepare members for success in diverse finance roles. - ![healthcare-club]( Aims to broaden understanding of the healthcare industry and career, bridging theory and practice through networking, workshops, company visits, seminars and collaboration with experts. - ![lux_club_logo]( Delves into luxury and arts industries with hands-on exposure and a deeper insight into the field, broadening knowledge of high-end markets, cultural expressions, and brand strategies. - ![sustainable-industry-and-energy_logo]( Promotes knowledge and awareness of sustainability across all industries, strengthening relationships with key sectors that play a crucial role in fighting climate change. - ![tech-club_logo]( Gathers tech enthusiasts eager to explore emerging technologies, collaborate on digital solutions, and connect with industry pioneers, fostering a forward-thinking culture of innovation. ### Social Impact - ![ethicaclub]( Promotes ethical thinking and responsible leadership, guiding members to incorporate integrity, transparency, social responsibility, and a commitment to charity and giving back into business. - ![out_club_logo]( Elevates LGBTQIA+ visibility and inclusivity in business, providing supportive networks and alliances that foster respectful work environments and advocate for equality for all professionals. - ![club_women_in_business_logo]( Empowers women’s leadership through mentorship, networking, and development programs, equipping future leaders to overcome barriers and stereotypes and achieve gender parity in business. ### Sport & Leisure - ![sailing-club]( Leverages sailing as a leadership tool, orchestrating regattas, training, social gatherings and events to strengthen communication, strategic thinking, and team spirit on and off the water. - ![ski-club]( Gathers skiers and snowboarders for trips, competitions, and shared experiences in the mountains, using the slopes to foster community spirit and cultivate an active, adventurous mindset. ![app]( ![Merchandising](

title: Sustainability, diversity and inclusion
text: Topic # Sustainability, diversity and inclusion For companies today, environmental sustainability cannot exist without a solid economic foundation, and vice versa. ESG factors must be integrated into business activities, starting from governance, developing a related strategy, and adapting human resources organization. It is therefore necessary to rethink the skills required to integrate social sustainability, ensuring fair treatment, equal opportunities, and representation at all levels. title: Milano | SDA Bocconi
text: ![SDA Bocconi - Milan Campus]( **Campus and culture** # Milano ## A Campus designed for the future Our Milan campus is our home – a place where architecture, sustainability, and innovation merge to create a truly unique learning experience. Designed by Japanese firm SANAA, it transformed a former industrial area (the Centrale del Latte) into a modern hub open to the city. Six fluid, transparent buildings host classrooms, offices, housing for over 300 students, and a sports center with an Olympic swimming pool, gyms, a running track, and sports fields. Sustainability is built into every detail, with architectural solutions that maximize energy efficiency and the well-being of those who live and study on campus. ### Key Features: ##### Near Zero Energy designed to minimize environmental impact through renewable energy ##### LEED Platinum Certification one of the most sustainable buildings in the world in terms of quality and innovation ##### \#1 Most sustainable B-School Campus Financial Times Carbon Footprint Rank ![SDA Bocconi - Milan Campus]( ## A tangible commitment to sustainability The Milan campus is the most sustainable business school campus in the world, according to the Financial Times Carbon Footprint Rank – a recognition of our commitment to achieving carbon neutrality by 2025. With over 1.2 MW of installed renewable energy from solar and geothermal sources, and 100% certified renewable electricity since 2017, we’ve turned sustainability into measurable action. The campus was awarded LEED Platinum certification – the highest global standard for sustainable buildings – thanks to a design approach focused on reducing environmental impact and improving quality of life. ![Certificazione LEED]( ### Numbers that make a difference - 74 % less energy consumed annually; solar energy covers 19% of costs - 42 % less water usage thanks to advanced conservation systems - 97 % of construction waste recovered - 32 % of building materials from recycled sources - 47 % of raw materials sourced locally to reduce transport emissions - ![campus Milano]( - ![SDA Bocconi - Milan Campus building]( - ![SDA Bocconi - Milan Campus building]( ## News A concrete model of sustainability – combining innovation, efficiency, and environmental responsibility - [**SDA Bocconi Campus tops the Financial Times’ Carbon Footprint Rank**\\ \\ The prestigious British newspaper has awarded our campus as the most sustainable in the world.\\ \\ ![Campus]( ### How to reach us SDA Bocconi Campus Via Sarfatti 10, 20136 Milano [Directions]( ### By plane ### By car ### By train ![app]( ![Merchandising](

title: Campus and culture | SDA Bocconi
text: ![Our locations - Milan]( # Campus and culture ## Different locations, same spirit SDA Bocconi is more than a school – it’s an ecosystem where knowledge, dialogue, and innovation come to life. Our campuses are designed to encourage the exchange of ideas, meaningful interaction, and a strong sense of community. Each location – Milan, Rome, Mumbai – reflects this vision, offering spaces that support learning beyond the classroom through experiences, connections, and new perspectives. MILAN ## The world’s most sustainable campus The Milan campus is the flagship of our vision: a place where architecture, sustainability, and research come together to create a cutting-edge learning environment. Built around the principles of Near Zero Energy, it was recognized by the **Financial Times** as the world’s most sustainable business school campus. It’s a space that embodies our commitment to the future – set in the economic and cultural heart of one of Europe’s most international cities. [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/who-we-are/campus-and-culture/milano/) ![campus]( ROME ### A place of heritage, institutions, and connections In the heart of the capital, the Rome campus blends historical charm with a forward-looking mindset. Villa Morgagni is a space for dialogue and growth, where culture, institutions, and business converge to shape new ideas and perspectives. It’s a welcoming environment for those seeking to connect with a network that extends beyond the city and region. [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/who-we-are/campus-and-culture/roma/) ![SDA Bocconi - Rome Campus]( Mumbai ### A crossroads of cultures and opportunity The Mumbai campus is a thriving hub of exchange and growth, where people, cultures, and ideas intersect within one of the world’s most dynamic economies. Located in Hiranandani Gardens, it’s a meeting place for academic excellence and international outlook – a space that captures our ability to understand and anticipate shifts in the global market. [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/who-we-are/campus-and-culture/mumbai/) ![SDA Bocconi - Asia Center Mumbai]( ![app]( ![Merchandising](

title: Rankings & accreditation | SDA Bocconi
text: ![ranking]( # Rankings & accreditation ## Rankings: a signal of value International rankings are one of the ways business schools are assessed and compared globally. They offer a useful perspective across multiple dimensions and are best understood through a multi-year view rather than as a single-year result. For everyone who chooses SDA Bocconi, they are a meaningful signal of the strength and consistency of our academic model over time. Studying at a globally recognized institution means entering a vibrant learning environment, accessing an international network, and unlocking long-term opportunities for current students and alumni alike. Academic rigor, relevance of research, and innovation are among the driving forces behind our impact. ## Ranking - 1 st European B-School 2025-26 ![Bloomberg]( - 6 th European B-School 2025 ![Financial Times]( - 4 th Worldwide Global MBA Ranking 2025 ![Financial Times]( > The SDA Bocconi full-time MBA is not included in the Financial Times Global MBA Ranking 2026 due to an alumni survey response threshold. Over recent years, SDA Bocconi MBA has consistently ranked among the top 5 business schools in Europe across multiple international rankings, supported by strong career outcomes and global employer recognition. This one-year absence does not reflect the quality of the program or the strength of its graduates. The class involved in this year’s survey has pursued international career paths that continue to reflect the impact of the MBA experience and further reinforcing the School’s reputation worldwide. The rigorous education we provide, our impactful research, our internationally oriented careers, a close-knit community and a transformational learning environment are core elements of the SDA Bocconi MBA experience. > > SDA Bocconi is firmly committed to academic rigor, responsible leadership, and the long-term growth of its students and alumni. > > ![Stefano Caselli]( > > **Stefano Caselli** > > Dean SDA Bocconi ### Bloomberg Businessweek - **1st European** B-Schools Ranking 2025-26 [https://www.bloomberg.com/business-schools/regions/emea/](https://www.bloomberg.com/business-schools/regions/emea/) ### Financial Times - **4th WW**- **2nd European** Global MBA Rankings 2025 [https://rankings.ft.com/rankings/2997/mba-2025](https://rankings.ft.com/rankings/2997/mba-2025) - **6th European** B-School Rankings 2025 - **1st WW** Environmental Impact Global MBA Rankings 2025 [https://rankings.ft.com/rankings/2997/mba-2025](https://rankings.ft.com/rankings/2997/mba-2025) - **3rd WW - 3rd European** Custom Education Rankings 2025 - **12th WW - 11th European** Executive Education Open Rankings 2025 - **27th WW - 14th European** Executive MBA Ranking 2025 [https://rankings.ft.com/rankings/3005/emba-2025](https://rankings.ft.com/rankings/3005/emba-2025) ## Accreditations: a mark of excellence SDA Bocconi is among a select group of business schools worldwide to hold the prestigious “triple crown” – the three most important international accreditations: AACSB, EQUIS, and AMBA. title: Diversity, equity and inclusion | SDA Bocconi
text: # Diversità, equità e inclusione ![Sostenibilità, diversità, equità e inclusione]( ## An inclusive environment SDA Bocconi is concretely committed to making diversity, equity and inclusion a reality. We have activated initiatives and tools that aim to remove barriers, support people's well-being and promote equal opportunities within our community. Each action reflects our commitment to building a more just, open and representative learning and working environment. ### Inclusion and non-discrimination services ### All-gender inclusive campus ### Services for students with disabilities ### Wellbeing and mental health ### International Students Care ### Subsidies and Scholarships - MBA Master in Business Administration - EMBA Modular Executive Master in Business Administration - EMBA Modular Executive Master in Business Administration - GEMBA Global Executive Master in Business Administration - EMF Executive Master in Finance - EMMIO Executive Master in Management of International Organizations - EMMS Executive Master in Marketing & Sales - MISA Master in Imprenditorialità e Strategia Aziendale ### Empowering female leadership SDA Bocconi is committed to encouraging management training for women. The educational dimension is one of the concrete levers that we can give men, women and our organizations to really change things, have impact. Providing training means offering a concrete tool for social change and transformation. To foster and contribute to women’s professional development, SDA Bocconi School of Management offers them **until 8 March 2027: a 20% discount** on the participation fee for all Executive Open Programs and Executive Online Programs. This promotion is valid only for SDA Bocconi's Executive Education and Online Executive Education programs starting in the above period, and cannot be combined with any other discount. [Executive Open Programs](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/on-campus-executive-education/) [Executive Online Programs](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/online-executive-education/) ![donne]( ### 30% Club “Growth through Diversity" SDA Bocconi demonstrates its commitment to diversity and inclusion through partnerships with leading associations in this area around the world. The [30% Club through Diversity](https://30percentclub.org/) is a global association that SDA Bocconi [partners](https://30percentclub.org/business-school/) with; their goal is to achieve a 30% representation of women on boards and in top positions at companies in more than 20 countries. title: Sustainability | SDA Bocconi
text: ![dei]( # Sustainability ## Generating sustainable value At SDA Bocconi, sustainability takes shape through concrete choices: in responsible campus design, multidisciplinary research, impact-oriented teaching, and programs that train responsible leaders. Four directions, one goal: to generate sustainable value for people, organizations and the planet. ### Our campuses Our campuses embody a concrete vision of sustainability. The one in Milano, designed according to Near Zero Energy principles, is at the heart of our commitment to a low-emission future. Powered 100 percent by energy from renewable sources and equipped with a photovoltaic system with over 1.2 MW of installed capacity, it represents a concrete model of energy transition. It has achieved LEED Platinum certification, the highest international recognition for sustainable architecture, and has been recognized by the Financial Times as the most sustainable campus globally. The Villa Morgagni campus in Roma also reflects this commitment: a space designed to foster connections, dialogue and growth, while respecting the historical context and looking toward the future. [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/who-we-are/campus-and-culture/) ![About us]( ### Research in sustainability Research is a fundamental pillar of our business, also when it comes to sustainability. Through laboratories, monitors and specialized centers such as the **Sustainability Lab**, we develop scientific knowledge useful in addressing the most pressing environmental, social and economic challenges. Our projects integrate quantitative and qualitative methodologies to support businesses, institutions and nonprofit organizations on their path to more sustainable models. Academic contributions, collaborations and shared research platforms strengthen the link between theory and practice, generating impact and expertise in line with the goals of Agenda 2030. [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/faculty-research/research/sustainability-lab/) ![sustainability lab]( ### Teaching sustainability Teaching sustainability means training leaders who are aware of their impact. The SDA Bocconi faculty integrates sustainability in content, methods and teaching tools, offering an approach that combines theoretical rigor and concrete application. Interactive lectures, field projects, case studies, and testimonials allow environmental, social, and governance issues to be addressed from a multidisciplinary and international perspective. Thus we prepare people capable of driving change and generating sustainable value in every sector. ![insegnare]( ![app]( ![Merchandising](

title: Sustainability, diversity, equity and inclusion | SDA Bocconi
text: ![dei]( # Sustainability, diversity, equity and inclusion ## Knowledge, responsibility and respect becoming impact Sustainability, in its environmental (E), social (S) and governance (G) dimensions, is an integral part of SDA Bocconi. Since our founding in 1971, we have believed that a school of management should be an example and driver of sustainable transformation, starting with its own practices. Every day we put training and research in the service of making a positive, concrete and lasting impact on people, organizations and communities. We promote dialogue between academia, business, institutions and civil society, with the aim of contributing to cultural and organizational change that makes the future more equitable, inclusive and sustainable for all people. ### esG: a governance of sustainability We are committed to ensuring equal opportunities for all people and building an inclusive environment in which each and every person receives fair treatment regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, age, or socioeconomic background. We work to attract and develop talent from an inclusive perspective so that our faculty and staff reflect the diversity and richness of our student community. Strengthening Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a key objective of the School's 2020-2025 Strategic Plan, and is being pursued with an approach that goes beyond regulatory obligations to generate real and lasting impact. As of 2021, sustainability governance is entrusted to the **Associate** **Dean for Sustainability**, **Francesco Perrini**, with delegated authority also on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: a choice that testifies to the strategic centrality of these issues for SDA Bocconi. title: The School | SDA Bocconi
text: ![Campus]( # The School ## Research, Rethink, Reimagine Joining SDA Bocconi means transforming your path and shaping the world of business, organizations, and society. At the heart of it all is research – the foundation that allows us to rethink scenarios, models, and strategies. And action – the way we turn knowledge into real-world impact. Our mission is to guide people and organizations through continuous growth, with a practical, innovative approach to learning. It’s more than skill-building – it’s about opening new perspectives and reimagining what’s possible. ![Research, rethink, reimagine]( ## Our values Our community is united around core values: ### Social, ethical, and environmental responsibility We believe the only real development is sustainable, and we cultivate responsible leaders. ### Independence We uphold genuine freedom of thought, free from cultural, political, and economic influences. ### Critical Re-Thinking We foster new perspectives for analysis, research, and the professionals who choose us. ### Scientific rigor We evolve our knowledge alongside the world to consistently ensure its quality and reliability. ### Imagination and creative passion We promote innovation through a pioneering spirit and the courage to change the world as we know it. ### Entrepreneurship We not only educate but also stimulate the continuous pursuit of opportunities. ### Centrality of people We support individuals at every step and cultivate a community made of lasting, valuable connections. ### Global vision We embrace diversity and understand its value in a global context. ## SDA Bocconi’s Roots Founded in 1971, SDA Bocconi is rooted in the long-standing tradition of Bocconi University. We draw from its academic excellence, entrepreneurial spirit, and research-driven approach. The vision of Claudio Dematté, who played a pivotal role in the School’s founding and development, still inspires our mission today: to combine scientific rigor with practical application, meeting the evolving needs of a constantly changing world. [Discover more](https://www.unibocconi.it/en) ![la scuola]( ## Our leadership Executive Committee Advisory Board ### Stefano Caselli Dean ### Bruno Mariani Managing Director ### Francesco Saita Dean for International Affairs - Bocconi University Associate Deans - Carlo Altomonte Stakeholder Engagement Programs - Enzo Baglieri Master Programs - Leonardo Caporarello Online Learning - Rossella Cappetta Corporate & Financial Institutions Executive Custom Programs - Paola Cillo Research (“Claudio Demattè” Research Division) - Leonardo Etro Special International Projects and India - Alessandro Minichilli Faculty - Francesco Perrini Sustainability - Emanuela Prandelli Open Programs - Rosanna Tarricone Government, Health and Not for Profit Directors - Amelia Compagni Cergas - Giampaolo Gabbi Financial Institutions Programs for CFI Division - Gimede Gigante Roma Campus - Monica Otto Executive Education for Government, Health and Not for Profit Division - Giovanni Tomasi Corporates Programs for CFI Division - Veronica Vecchi Research, Innovation and International Programs for Government & Society Staff Members - Francesco Arduini Administration, Control and Faculty Support - Marialuisa Ortini Business Development - Alessandro Pinna Marketing & Comunicazione - Debora Usai HR and Quality Process **Francesco Billari**(Rector - Bocconi University) and **Riccardo Taranto** (Managing Director - Bocconi University) are invited to attend the Management Board meetings.

title: Who we are | SDA Bocconi
text: ![SDA Bocconi]( # Who we are Watch the video ## Research, growth, and global impact SDA Bocconi School of Management is an international school that empowers people to drive change and make a meaningful impact on individuals, organizations, and society. In addition to our urban campus in Milan – the most sustainable business school campus in the world – we have a campus in Rome and a pan-Asian hub in Mumbai. Our educational offering is built on rigorous, original research and includes MBAs, specialized and executive masters, open-enrollment executive education, and custom programs for companies. According to Bloomberg Businessweek, SDA Bocconi is the third-best business school in Europe. The latest Financial Times rankings place our Full-Time MBA 4th in the world and the School 6th in Europe. ### Value and values: our idea of a Business School > We live in a time where opinions are abundant, but critical thinking – grounded in skills and evidence – is increasingly rare. At SDA Bocconi, we believe management is, above all, an act of responsibility: it means leading people, resources, and organizations with awareness and vision. > > Being a business school means creating and spreading knowledge that makes a difference. It’s not just about acquiring tools, but about developing a broad, interdisciplinary mindset – one that embraces complexity rather than avoiding it. > > For us, value and values are inseparable. Every program, every initiative, every research effort is designed to generate positive change for individuals, organizations, and communities. If this resonates with you, we invite you to explore our School – and become part of it. **Stefano Caselli, Dean SDA Bocconi** ![Dean]( ## Our programs MBA and Executive MBAsSpecialized mastersDBAExecutive education [View All](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/programs/) - [MBA\\ \\ **Full-Time MBA**\\ \\ ![MBA]( - [EMBA\\ \\ **Executive MBA**\\ \\ ![emba_card_hp]( - [GEMBA\\ \\ **The Rotman - SDA Bocconi Global Executive MBA**\\ \\ ![card_gemba_hp]( [Explore by topicExplore by topic](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/topics/) [Find your programFind your program](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/program-finder/) Our campuses Milano The most sustainable campus in the world [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/who-we-are/campus-and-culture/milano/) Roma Immersed in history, with an eye to the future [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/who-we-are/campus-and-culture/roma/) Mumbai A meeting point of international excellence [Discover more](https://www.sdabocconi.it/en/who-we-are/campus-and-culture/mumbai/) ## A global community, a lifelong connection The SDA Bocconi community is part of the broader Bocconi Alumni network – a growing ecosystem of people, ideas, and opportunities. The connection with the School doesn’t end with the classroom. It continues through dialogue, networking, and the exchange of experiences that enrich both personal and professional growth. text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Funding #### **Bocconi4Access to Education a.y. 2026-27** Bocconi has always been committed to making higher education available to all motivated and talented students through a financial aid system, based on both merit and need. The " **Bocconi4Access to Education**" support scheme aims at promoting access to a plural environment, to an open and accessible university for students who share progress, plurality and inclusion as fundamental values for their personal, cultural and professional growth. Opportunities may vary from year to year based in part on the funds made available by donors to the University. Please find below the **funding opportunities available for a.y. 2026-27**. These opportunities offer a different kind of support to families and, in most cases, take into consideration the economic and asset situation of students' families. Each opportunity consists of a full or partial tuition waiver, based on the student’s and family's economic needs. We suggest that each family, who considers it appropriate, applies through the single “ **Bocconi4Access to Education a.y. 2026-27**” application. All applications will be evaluated, and benefits will be allocated until all the available budget has been exhausted. Please visit our dedicated if you are an Italian candidate. Bocconi Access to Education Scholarships Bocconi aims to support deserving students who are willing to invest in their future, even in challenging and potentially constraining economic family conditions. title: Activating an extracurricular internship | Bocconi University
text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Activating an extracurricular internship **ATTENTION PLEASE! YOU'RE ACCESSING THIS PAGE VIA AN OLD LINK AND THE CONTENTS MAY BE NO LONGER VALID (LAST UPDATE: APRIL 2024).** **STARTING FROM MAY 2024, PLEASE REFER TO THE NEW CONTENTS AVAILABLE AT THE FOLLOWING LINKS FOR** [**STUDENTS**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/your-internship-start-credit-recognition "Your internship: from start to credit recognition") **AND** [**COMPANIES**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/employers-and-partners/activating-and-managing-internships "Activating and managing internships") **.** \\*\\*\\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* Starting from 9th June 2018 a new regulation entered in force: “Indirizzi regionali in materia di tirocini” (DGR 7763/2018), which introduces changes regarding the activation and the management of internships, particularly the extracurricular ones (the ones carried out after graduating). Such changes especially affect the hosting employer (company/institution) and the sponsoring institution (Università Bocconi), but interns are affected too. Here you can find the main changes introduced by the new regulation and the steps you have to follow in order to activate the internship. **1.Unemployment status**: since a graduate carrying out an extracurricular internship is considered unemployed (art.19 DLGS 150/2015), once you graduate you will have to prove – before the beginning of the internship – your unemployment status by uploading to your “Attachments Area” on JobGate (section “My Internships”) the following documents: - **"Dichiarazione di Immediata Disponibilità" (DID)**: this is the way identified by law to acquire the unemployment status. You can obtain it with an online procedure or, in case additional support is needed, at an accredited operator for employment services in Regione Lombardia or at an employment center (“Centro per l’impiego”). The online procedure can be completed: — on Sistema Informativo Unitario del Lavoro – SIUL ( [https://siul.servizirl.it](https://siul.servizirl.it/)), by SPID authentication or using your national/regional health insurance card (CNS) with the related reader/software and PIN. — on Agenzia Nazionale per le Politiche Attive del Lavoro – ANPAL portal ( [www.anpal.gov.it](https://www.anpal.gov.it/)), by SPID authentication or using your national/regional health insurance card (CNS) or eID (CIE) with the related reader/software and PIN. - **"Patto di Servizio Personalizzato" (PSP)**: **(NEW: PSP no more deeded for internships in Regione Lombardia.** [**Click here**]( **for more information)** _once you obtained DID, you will have to confirm your unemployment status by signing a personalized agreement of service (PSP), in which you commit to carry out certain activities in order to find a job. You can sign the PSP at an employment centre (“Centro per l’Impiego”) or at an operator for employment services accredited in Regione Lombardia._ _If the date of the appointment to sign the PSP is scheduled after the beginning of your internship, you can upload a self-certification on JobGate, in which you declare you booked the appointment to sign the PSP._ _If you choose an accredited operator different from a “Centro per l’impiego”, you can decide to refer from the beginning to this single operator, that will be able to support you in the process of obtaining both the DID and the PSP._ [You can download here the list of operators you can turn to in order to sign the “Patto di Servizio Personalizzato” (in Regione Lombardia) — _list to

Minimum compensation**: the minimum amount for extracurricular internships has been raised to 500€ gross per month, the compensation can be lowered to 400€ if meal vouchers or access to the canteen are offered or to 350€ if the daily commitment of the intern does not exceed 4 working hours. **3\. Minimum duration**: the minimum duration of an extracurricular internship (after graduation) in Italy is now 2 months. Please remember that in case of graduation during the internship, you will have to meet all the requirements of the extracurricular internships by the **day of the graduation**. If you fail to comply with the regulation by that date, your internship will be suspended until it meets all the above mentioned requirements. title: Activating a Field Project with an Employer | Bocconi University
text:
Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Activating a Field Project with an Employer **ATTENTION PLEASE! YOU'RE ACCESSING THIS PAGE VIA AN OLD LINK AND THE CONTENTS MAY BE NO LONGER VALID (LAST UPDATE: APRIL 2024).** **STARTING FROM MAY 2024, PLEASE REFER TO THE NEW CONTENTS AVAILABLE AT THE FOLLOWING LINKS FOR** [**STUDENTS**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/your-internship-start-credit-recognition "Your internship: from start to credit recognition") **AND** [**COMPANIES**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/employers-and-partners/activating-and-managing-internships "Activating and managing internships") **.** \\*\\*\\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* Field projects are **activities similar to curricular internships for credit**, for students in the Graduate School and in the Undergraduate School. They arise from an agreement between an Employer and the University, which provides for a research and analysis project on an organizational and/or business issue. Coordinated by the Career Services, **activities are completed in groups** (of between 2 and 4 students), under the supervision of a professional at the company with the possible involvement of a member of the Bocconi faculty. The project allows students to engage with business functions and professional roles by completing activities on concrete cases. Students can put into practice their knowledge, innovative ideas and skills, and experience the interactions and synergies of working on a team. With a minimum duration of 8 weeks (Graduate School) and 6 weeks (Undergraduate School), activities are held remotely or in a mixed mode (remote and in person) and include career guidance sessions. In terms of commitment and workload, field projects are in all respects equivalent to internships. They are therefore not compatible with other internships found before or during the experience. For information on activating a field project and the recognition procedure, please see the steps listed below. | | | | --- | --- | | **ACTIVATING A FIELD PROJECT** | | | **You** | You are selected by the Employer, in accordance with the university. Formally accept to participate in the project. | | **Internship**
**Office** | Enters the training project for the field project in JobGate. | | **You** | Access JobGate in the “My Internships” area, Training Project section and click on “Confirm training project” and then “Request credit recognition.” | | **Internship**
**Office** | Activates the field project. | | **You** | Download the field project document from JobGate, which needs to be signed by you and the Employer at the beginning of the experience and then sent to the Internship Office. | | | | | --- | --- | | **KICK-OFF MEETING** | | | **You** | Participate in a kickoff meeting held by the Employer, where you will meet the other members of your team, the company advisor and, if applicable, the faculty advisor. | | | | | --- | --- | | **WORK IN PROGRESS** | | | **You** | Participate in events to finetune the project, company presentations, networking and career guidance. | | | | | --- | --- | | **AFTER THE FIELD PROJECT** | | | **You** | You and your group will present the output of the project to the Employer and University representatives. | | **You** | After the

text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Activation of an internship abroad **ATTENTION PLEASE! Such document requires only the signature of the Employer and that of the intern, not that of the University. Thus, if the Employer provided you with **a contract of its own**, follow the **instructions given below**. **IMPORTANT: before proceeding, make sure that the Employer intends to formalize your internship with a contract of its own.** **Otherwise**, if the Employer wishes to formalize your experience through **Bocconi’s Internship Agreement** (drafted by the University and signed by you, the Company and the University), [click here](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/activation-through-bocconi-documents). **Steps to follow to register the foreign contract signed by you and the company on JobGate (two weeks before the start of the internship — Experiences communicated after the start date will therefore not be accepted.):** **1\. You: fill in the form you find in the yoU@B Agenda** From the left menu, open “Internships”– “Self-found internship abroad” **Enter the requested information**. Remember to **attach the contract**. Otherwise, your request will not be processed. **2\. The Internship Office: evaluates the contract and examines your training project** -if the [requirements of curricular internship](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/requirements-curricular-internships-credit) for credit are met, it will register the internship on JobGate and make available the request for credit (advance authorization); -if the requirements of curricular internship for credit are not met, but the experience is in line with your academic path and the University’s quality standards, it will register your internship on JobGate as curricular without credits. **3\. You: confirm the internship** Access JobGate, area “My internships”, section “Training project” and confirmthe internship through the appropriate button. Moreover, for any internship outside Italy, you must read and sign [Hold Harmless document.](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/helpful-information-internships-abroad) **4\. You: in the case of curricular internship for credit, requestadvance authorization** Click on the "Request for credit recognition” button on the same page. **5\. The Internship Office: activates your internship** Go to [the followinglink]( in order to learn more about the credit recognition procedure. Also check the web page [Helpful Information for internships abroad](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/helpful-information-internships-abroad) with updates about countries, necessary documents and travel safety. ### Links - [Activation through Bocconi documents]( - [Activation of an internship at Bocconi (Field research project)]( - [Requirements of curricular internships for credit]( - [Credit recognition procedure]( [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/activation-internship-abroad#addtoany "Show all")

title: Approaching the Job Market | Bocconi University
text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Approaching the Job Market _Discover the job market by **learning** **directly from company representatives**, and start testing your approach by engaging with them firsthand._ _You can join diverse initiatives serving different purposes._ ## Activities with company representatives Career Workshops: practice your skills with employers Series of **seminars held by company representatives** addressing the most important topics related to the job market and professional environment, typically focused on soft skills such as public speaking, or competences to be used during selection processes, like how to hack a case in consulting interviews. Click [here](https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0 "https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0") to find out the next appointments. Chat with Alumni: listen to testimonials from Bocconi graduates **Round tables with Bocconi graduates** talking about their jobs and responsibilities and delving into the needed skills to work in their fields. You should join if you wish to listen to former students describing in their own words what it feels like working in a certain role or business field. Click [here](https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0 "https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0") to find out the next appointments. Mentoring Programs: learn from the experience of a Mentor Thanks to these initiatives you can **establish connections with experienced professionals**. The journey will lead to mutual development and self-improvement, centered around sharing experiences and viewpoints. Two programs are available: Bocconi Mentoring Program, where mentors are young professionals Bocconi Alumni; CEO Connect - Your Executive Mentor, where mentors are CEOs of multinational companies. Mock Interviews: mimic a job interview with a recruiter Practice sessions with company representatives **mimicking real job interviews**. The aim is to refine your interview skills, identify areas for improvement (yes, the recruiter will give you a feedback!), and enhance your preparation to face a real job interview. Click [here](https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0 "https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0") to find out the next appointments. _**How to join**_ _You will find more info, including registration, in the_ [_Career Counseling Hub_](https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0 "https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0") _**,** accessible from you@B> Career Service menu > Career Counseling Hub > Initiatives and online tools._ "Show all")

text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Career Guidance _**Learn more about yourself and your fit in the job market** through online resources and dedicated activities with Bocconi Career Services professionals._ ## Activities with Bocconi Career Services professionals Distance Personalized Advice: meet a career counselor **One-to-one sessions to receive personalized guidance** from a Career Services expert: you can ask for a cv and cover letter review, or discuss about your professional goals and strategies for effective application. One-to-one advice on the International Job Market: meet a counselor for your career abroad **Individual sessions with Bocconi Career Services** professionals guiding you through the job market landscape of various Countries (curious about the UK, France, or United Arab Emirates? We have those covered and much more!). Get ready for the Job: join the seminars on the key tools in the job market Series of online **seminars held by Bocconi Career Services experts who will give you insights on the topics more typical in the job market**, such as CV and cover letter preparation, best practices for networking, hints&tips for the selection process, instructions to activate documents for internships. Click [here](https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0 "https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0") to find out the next appointments. Motivation & Aptitude Project (MAP): explore your aptitudes and move towards your best fit in the job market Guided by a team of counselors, you will complete a **self-orientation process** focusing on your choices: thanks to an **online questionnaire and an individual interview**, you will **explore your personal motivations and aptitudes** to establish a closer connection between your personal resources and professional projects. Thanks to this activity, you will be able to: discover and use your strengths to your fullest potential, consider improvement areas, feel more confident when approaching the job market, and make more informed decisions about your professional choices. Please note that this activity is available for MSc students and third-year BSc students. Click [here](https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0 "https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0") to find out the next appointments. _**How to join**_ _You will find more info, including registration, in the_ [_Career Counseling Hub_](https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0 "https://unibocconi-csm.symplicity.com/students/?signin_tab=0") _**,** accessible from you@B> Career Service menu > Career Counseling Hub > Initiatives and online tools._ ## DAL - DisAbilities and Work _The DAL Service- Disabilities and Work - supports Bocconi students and graduates with disabilities (both registered and not registered to Categorie Protette) in the search and identification of job and internship opportunities. Check that the correct activation procedure has been followed in the [appropriate section](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/internship) (Activating an internship). Below are the instructions to be followed in order to ensure recognition of an internship in your study plan. You can get a feedback on the evolution of the internship recognition process through the [**CHECK YOUR INTERNSHIP widget**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/check-your-internship) available in the INTERNSHIP section of your You@B diary. | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **WHO** | | **WHAT** | | **The Internship Office** | 1 | Evaluates the internship and makes available the “Request for credits recognition” button (advance authorization) on JobGate. | | **You** | 2 | Access JobGate in the Agenda and request prior authorization in the area "My internships", section "Training project", with a click on the "Request credits" button. | | **The Director of the degree course or his/her delegate** | 3 | Evaluates the internship and may grant or refuse **advance authorization** or, in case of need of further information, invite you either for a personal interview or a conversation via Help&Contact.
You may view the outcome of your request in the Calendar in the "My internships" area of JobGate, in the section "Training project", at the foot of the page (“Recognition of credits”) or directly in the Punto Blu in the "Career" section. | | **The employer / You** | 4 | On the first day of the internship, sends/send **the original of the internship document**, signed by all parties, to the Internships Office.
The internship document, bearing all required signatures, is made available in electronic format in the "Attachment Area" of JOBGATE (in "My internships") and is a fundamental element for recognition (this does not apply for internships abroad activated through a contract provided by the employer). | | **You** | 5 | Make sure that any suspensions or interruptions will not affect the **minimum duration** required for recognition of the internship (to check the requirements, [click here](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/requirements-curricular-internships-credit)). | | **The employer** | 6 | Completes its final evaluation of the internship (the tutor will receive a dedicated message via e-mail). | | **You** | 7 | Complete your final evaluation of the internship (you will receive a dedicated message in the Calendar).
_In case of a field project, upload in the "Attachment Area" of JobGate (in "My internships") a report on the research activity or any paper/material prepared during the project._ | | **The Internship Office** |

_For undergraduates and law students that don't have a mandatory internship in their degree course, they must modify their study plan so as to include it._
_Once you have obtained final recognition of the internship, you will be able to check the proper registration of the formative credits, also through the Calendar in the "My internships" area of JobGate, or in the Punto Blu in the "Career" section._ | _Recognition of a curricular internship for credits involves several actors: the time required to record credits depends on how rapid they all are. To keep this time to a minimum, make sure that both evaluation forms (of the intern and tutor) are filled out and that the internship document (in the case of activation through Bocconi documents) has been returned to the Internships Office._ Credits are usually registered in the study plan **after the end of an internship**. You will need to make a request for advance recognition to the Internship Office through B in touch. They will then make the final evaluation forms available in advance. In general, all requirements – including the minimum duration – must be met by the deadline for the study plan completion for graduation or the other deadlines related to the cases in indicated above. ### Links - [Requirements for credited curricular internships]( - [Activation through Bocconi documents]( - [Guide to the University – Bachelor of Science - [Guide to the University – Master of Science - [Guide to the University – Integrated Master of Arts in Law [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/credit-recognition-procedure#addtoany "Show all")

The internship, in order to be recognized in the curriculum of studies, must be carried out:

title: December extraordinary exam session | Bocconi University
text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # December extraordinary exam session The December 2023 extraordinary exam session is intended for regularly enrolled students engaged in internships (or activities similar to curricular internship for credits) in Italy or abroad during the ordinary sessions of **January-February 2024**. In order for a student to have access to this session, there must be an overlapping, even partial, of his/her internship period and the ordinary exam session. You may check the dates of the December extraordinary session and those of the ordinary January and February sessions at [this link](https://didattica.unibocconi.eu/esami/sessioni.php). Only certain types of internship allow access to the December extraordinary session: - **Master of Science**: credited or non-credited curricular internship; - **Bachelor and Master of Science in Law**: only credited curricular internship (including additional internships for credits) . In order for an internship to be considered for purposes of access to the extraordinary exam session, it must be included on JobGate (yoU@B Calendar, section "My internships") and three-year Bachelor and LawProgram students must have already requested the advance authorization. The students that meet all the above mentioned requirements for their internship will be automatically authorized to take part in the extraordinary session. In the event that the internship isn’t included on JobGate in due time to access the December extraordinary session, the student will have to submit through B in touch – Internship section a document, which confirms the experience about to start (eg. Foreign internship contract, commitment letter or an email communication by the company/hosting institution). During December extraordinary session the students are not admitted to exams regarding previous years’ courses that they have not yet completed. text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Early traineeship for Bar Examination (legal profession) **As of 20 February 2018, during the final year of** **studies**, it is possible **to carry out 6 of the total of 18 months** **of training** prescribed by the aw to access the **Bar Exam**. **REQUIREMENTS FOR ADMISSION TO** **THE ADVANCE TRAINEESHIP** Students meeting the following requirements may be admitted to the advance traineeship: - enrollment in the fifth year (not an out-of-program year) of the Integrated Master of Arts Degree in Law; - possession of credits in the following disciplinary sectors: Private Law (IUS/01), Civil Procedural Law (IUS/15), Criminal Law (IUS/17), Criminal Procedural Law (IUS/16), Administrative Law (IUS/10), Constitutional Law (IUS/08), European Union Law (IUS 14); - Possession and registration in curriculum of studies of the credits for all 1st, 2nd and 3rd year instructional activities. Moreover: - for students not having effected a period of study abroad in the 4th year: possession and registration in curriculum of studies of the credits for all 4th year instructional activities. - for students having effected a “lengthy” period of study abroad (at least one term) in the 4th year: possession and registration in curriculum of studies of at least 60 credits for all 4th or 5th year instructional activities. **CONDITIONS OF VALIDITY** In order for the advance traineeship to be valid, the following conditions must be met: - obtaining of initial authorization; - duration of at least 6 calendar months, and of at least 288 hours, with the student’s attendance at a minimum of 12 court hearings. If the student graduates before the end of such 6 month period, the advance traineeship will be valid if it has been of a duration of at least 5 months and, in any event, of at least 288 hours; - obtaining of final validation; - graduation not later than 12 months from the end of the advance traineeship; - confirmation of recording in the register of trainee attorneys within ninety days from graduation (the degree certificate or an equivalent document must be presented to the Bar association – _Ordine di_ _avvocati_). Furthermore, the traineeship must always be [formalized as an internship](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/activation-through-bocconi-documents). All detailed information on the rules and procedures to be followed for the advance traineeship (admission requirements, conditions, roles, responsibilities, procedures for applying for and formalizing the traineeship, documentation to be presented to the Bar association for authorization and requirements for validation) is provided on the site pages dedicated to the [Bar Exam](https://www.unibocconi.it/it/corsi-di-studio/esami-di-stato/esame-avvocato-tirocinio-anticipato) _(only in Italian)_. ### Links - [Activation through Bocconi documents]( "Show all")

text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Evaluation of the internship **ATTENTION PLEASE! YOU'RE ACCESSING THIS PAGE VIA AN OLD LINK AND THE CONTENTS MAY BE NO LONGER VALID (LAST UPDATE: APRIL 2024).** **STARTING FROM MAY 2024, PLEASE REFER TO THE NEW CONTENTS AVAILABLE AT THE FOLLOWING LINKS FOR** [**STUDENTS**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/your-internship-start-credit-recognition "Your internship: from start to credit recognition") **AND** [**COMPANIES**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/employers-and-partners/activating-and-managing-internships "Activating and managing internships") **.** \\*\\*\\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* The evaluation of the internship is a crucial moment of the experience, allowing you, on the one hand, to reflect on your current path of studies and, on the other, to receive feedback from your supervisor in a structured manner. Evaluations constitute a fundamental part of the [Recognition Procedure](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/credit-recognition-procedure) of the curricular internships for credit. Nevertheless the forms need to be filled out even in the case of a curricular internship without credits or an extracurricular internship, since an evaluation of the internship experience is **required by the law**. The final evaluation moment is planned just before the conclusion of the internship, involving both the intern and the company’s tutor. When the evaluation forms are available you will be notified by a message on the yoU@B Calendar, whereas your tutor will receive an e-mail with instructions to access the JobGate portal. You will be able to view the form filled out by your tutor in the section "My internships" > "Evaluation" of the yoU@B Agenda. In the same section, you can authorize your tutor to view the digital part of the form you have filled out. The text part of the form will never be viewable. Finally, keep in mind that, at the intern’s request, the employer is obliged to issue a **certificate of completion of internship**. You can get a feedback on the proper upload of the evaluation forms through the [**CHECK YOUR INTERNSHIP widget**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/check-your-internship) available in the INTERNSHIP section of your You@B diary. ### Links - [Requirements of curricular internships for credit]( - [Credit recognition procedure]( - [Guide to the University – Bachelor of Science - [Guide to the University – Master of Science - [Guide to the University – Integrated Master of Arts in Law [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/evaluation-internship#addtoany "Show all")

YOU'RE ACCESSING THIS PAGE VIA AN OLD LINK AND THE CONTENTS MAY BE NO LONGER VALID (LAST UPDATE: APRIL 2024).** **STARTING FROM MAY 2024, PLEASE REFER TO THE NEW CONTENTS AVAILABLE AT THE FOLLOWING LINKS FOR** [**STUDENTS**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/your-internship-start-credit-recognition "Your internship: from start to credit recognition") **AND** [**COMPANIES**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/employers-and-partners/activating-and-managing-internships "Activating and managing internships") **.** \\*\\*\\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* **Have you already found an internship?** Do you need to know how to activate, carry out or recognize it? The Internship office is at your disposal; choose one of the following contact points. _For any question regarding internship and placement opportunities, please refer to the_ [_Career Service Infopoint_](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/career-services-infopoint) _(Bachelor of Science programs) or the_ [_account of their Master of Science_](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/distance-personalized-advice-1) [_program_](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/distance-personalized-advice-1) _within the Career Service._ **B in Touch** Mailing service available on yoU@B, by selecting B in Touch, “Internships" topic. Take a look at our brand new FAQs; if you do not find an answer, send us a request. You will receive our support via email on your Bocconi account. **Who:** **all students and graduates** who have found an internship and need to start, carry out or end it. **When**: always on, from Monday to Friday. **ONE-TO-ONE SESSION (remote via Teams)** Before booking a meeting with the internship office, please read the module “Internship... let’s go!” available on Bboard (you may find there answers to all your questions). While booking, remember to indicate the reason for the appointment. **Who:** students and graduates whose **internship is about to start, it’s being carried out or it already ended**. **When:** Monday (afternoon) Tuesday (morning), Thursday (afternoon) and Friday (morning). **Where to book:** Appointments. Access your yoU@B Diary, left menu Internship> Internship activation and recognition, in the activities calendar select **Internship — One-to-One Session**. On the day and time of the appointment click on the link of Teams you will find in Appointments. **DEDICATED PHONE NUMBER** You may contact the Internship Office on the dedicated number +39.02.5836.2478. **Who:** **all students and graduates** who have found an internshipand need to activate, carry out or conclude it. **When:** **Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays (from 9.30 to 10.30); Tuesdays and Fridays (from 14.30 to 15.30).** **Wednesday 17 January:** _**suspended**_ _For urgent matters please get in touch with us through B in touch > Internship_ _Due to the high volume of calls, you might find the phone line busy (if so, the phone will not ring). We remind you that you can always reach us on B in touch._ **POSTAL MAIL** Use the following address **to send paper documents**: Internship Office Università Bocconi at Post Office Viale Bligny 12, 20136 Milan Italy or **deliver in person to**: Bocconi Post Office, Viale Bligny 12 Monday through Friday, 8.30am — 4.30 pm _**Note:**_ _Requests made through different modalities than those mentioned above (personal messages on Teams included) will not be processed._ [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/internship-office-contacts#addtoany "Show all")

title: JobGate: applying online | Bocconi University
text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # JobGate: applying online _**JobGate is Bocconi’ online portal to find an internship or a job**. The platform is **available 24/7** for applications, and every day new opportunities are published, both in Italy and abroad, dedicated to profiles with up to three years of work experience._ _You can apply for as many opportunities as you wish, and you can also sort the listings using **advanced filters** (starting date, business field, function, and much more), to carefully select offers that align with your professional goals._ ## 2025 wrapped 3,900+ active companies in JobGate to post offers or hosting internships 9,300+ internship and job opportunities in Italy or abroad, posted in JobGate ## Discover more How to access _From yoU@B > menu on the left, Career Services > button “Internship and placement Offers”._ _JobGate is open to **Bocconi University students and graduates**:_ - _If you are a student: access with the same login and password used for yoU@B._ - _If you are a graduate: you need to register on_ [_http://www.alumnibocconi.it_](http://www.alumnibocconi.it/ "http://www.alumnibocconi.it/") _to obtain new login and password._ Special collections of offers _On JobGate you can also browse the offers according to pre-filtered boxes showcasing different clusters of opportunities: by **geographical area**, by **business field**, or **linked to specific internship programs**. When available, you can access these collections from the JobGate homepage or following the path Home/Jobs/More filters/Jobs Source._ - _**Focus on**: Internship and job offers are grouped according to specific “topic-based” features, such as **geographical area** (e.g. Companies in the Americas, Companies in Asia etc.) and the **employer’s industry** (e.g. International Organizations, Law firms for legal profiles, Chambers of Commerce etc.)_ - [_**MAECI – MUR – "Opportunità di stage presso le sedi MAECI all'estero") _**:** This box collects internship opportunities at **Embassies, Permanent Representations of the OO.II, Consulates, Italian Institutes of Culture**. This program is only open to **Master of Science students with Italian citizenship**. You can find more info at the dedicated pages._ - [_**Curricular Internship Special**_](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/curricular-internship-special "Curricular Internship Special") _: Twice a year, this publication is exclusively aimed at **Master of Science students who have not yet activated a curricular internship** and offers internship opportunities provided by Companies which are part of Bocconi's partnership programs. You can find more info at the dedicated pages._ ## Contacts _You can access yoU@B>B in Touch> Career Services and send your request._ [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/jobgate-applying-online#addtoany "Show all")

title: July graduation session | Bocconi University
text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # July graduation session A solution is proposed to facilitate graduation in the July session for students pursuing curricular internships for credits in Italy or abroad in the period January/February 2023, when this is necessary for access to a graduate-level program. Students who at the end of the January-February 2023 exam session have not taken all the exams for first semester courses will be able to take those exams during the July session and, should they pass, will graduate in July. This opportunity is available to students: - engaged in curricular internships for credits in Italy or abroad in the period January/February 2023; i.e., who begin their internships before the end of the January/February exam session (4 February 2023) and attain the minimum duration required for [credit recognition](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/curricular-internships-credit) not later than 26 May 2023 (included); - who submit a request to that purpose to the Academic Services no later than 9 June 2023 together with documentation certifying admission to a graduate-level program which requires possession of the degree by July 2023. It is hereby specified that in order to be admitted to the graduation session students must still complete the [recognition procedure](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/current-students/services/credit-recognition-procedure) for their internships by the date set for completion of the curriculum of studies of the July session (21 June 2023). For further information on requirements for access to graduation, consult the Guide to the University (Chapter 10. Final Paper and Graduation), the graduation deadline calendar published on the [dedicated of the site, and/or contact the l'Academic Services through B in touch (topic Graduation > Graduation session and administrative deadlines). ### Links - [Guide to the University – Bachelor of Science programs – Final paper and - [Calendar of graduation sessions and deadlines]( [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/july-graduation-session#addtoany "Show all")

title: MAECI-MUR-FCRUI - Opportunità di stage presso le sedi MAECI all'estero | Bocconi University
text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # MAECI-MUR-FCRUI - Opportunità di stage presso le sedi MAECI all'estero **BANDO MAECI-MUR-CRUI** Attraverso il bando MAECI – MUR – CRUI è possibile candidarsi per stage presso **Ambasciate, Rappresentanze permanenti presso le OO.II, Consolati, Istituti italiani di Cultura** da svolgere **tra lunedì 15 gennaio e venerdì 12 aprile 2024**. **Sono offerti 335 tirocini, di cui 318 con svolgimento in presenza e 17 a distanza dall'Italia.** Il bando è aperto agli studenti delle principali Università italiane che aderiscono al Programma, Bocconi inclusa. Le candidature idonee - validate dalle Università di appartenenza sulla base dei requisiti indicati nel bando - vengono esaminate da una Commissione congiunta MAECI-MUR-FCRUI che effettua la selezione dei tirocinanti da destinare alle Sedi inserite nel bando, sulla base dei criteri stabiliti dalla Commissione stessa e pubblicati sul [sito](https://www.tirocinicrui.it/). I tirocinanti saranno impegnati nella realizzazione di ricerche, studi, analisi ed elaborazione di dati utili all'approfondimento dei dossier trattati da ciascuna Sede. Gli studenti potranno essere anche coinvolti nell'organizzazione di eventi ed assistere il personale del MAECI nelle attività di proiezione esterna. Si segnala che tali opportunità sono riservate **solo a studenti di laurea specialistica o a ciclo unico con cittadinanza italiana**, che possiedono **lo status di studente al momento della candidatura e mantengano tale status per tutta la durata del tirocinio.** Per il riconoscimento dello stage come curriculare con crediti lo studente è invitato a verificare la coerenza delle attività da svolgere con il contenuto del proprio corso di laurea. Per dettagli sulle sedi, i requisiti e le modalità di partecipazione consultare attentamente il bando a questo **[link](https://www.tirocinicrui.it/335-tirocini-bando-maeci-mur-crui/).** **Il** **termine per presentare la propria candidatura è mercoledì 18 ottobre 2023 alle ore 17:00 (ora italiana).** PROGRAMMA DI TIROCINI ALLA RAPPRESENTANZA PERMANENTE D'ITALIA PRESSO IL CONSIGLIO ATLANTICO (NATO) Attraverso il Programma di tirocini alla Rappresentanza Permanente d’Italia presso il Consiglio Atlantico (NATO) è possibile candidarsi per stage trimestrali da svolgere a Bruxelles nei seguenti periodi: - **maggio –** **giugno – luglio 2024**(1 posto disponibile) - **settembre** **– ottobre – novembre 2024**(2 posti disponibili) - **dicembre 2024 – gennaio – febbraio** **2025**(2 posti disponibili) I tirocinanti verranno coinvolti nell’elaborazione di studi e analisi di materiale sui principali temi strategici della NATO nonché nella predisposizione di note, documenti e relazioni di approfondimento sui temi specifici trattati dalla Rappresentanza. Si segnala che tale opportunità è riservata **solo a studenti di laurea triennale, laurea specialistica o a** **ciclo unico con cittadinanza italiana**, che possiedono **lo status di studente al momento della** **candidatura e mantengano tale status per tutta la durata del tirocinio.** È possibile candidarsi anche per tutti e tre i trimestri proposti, a condizione che si rispetti il vincolo sopra indicato. **Si può inoltrare la propria application, tramite portale JobGate, da lunedì 18 settembre a domenica 15 ottobre 2023.** Le candidature verranno pre-selezionate dal Career Services, con scelta finale a cura della Sede tramite video-intervista ed eventuale colloquio di approfondimento. text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Bespoke events _Each event is exclusively **centered around one employer** at a time, or, in the case of In-Company Trainings abroad, it is included in **wider** **programs.**_ _The following formats are available (online, on campus or at company premises): they serve specific purposes, but all of them are unique chances for **fostering your career opportunities, expanding your professional network, sharing your cv and facilitating recruitment processes**. Join if you are looking for an immediate internship or job to start, but also if you wish to gather information about potential employers and their future opportunities!_ ## Available activities Classroom Presentations: get a closer look at companies **Classroom meetings where employers showcase internship and job opportunities** as well as precious insights into their culture, values and vision. **What’s in it for you?** You will connect with the representatives to get to know them up close, learn about opportunities and selection processes, and understand the needed skills in different fields. Careers in Government & International Organizations: explore institutions and international organizations Classroom sessions during which **international organizations and public institutions present their activities,** job opportunities, and career paths. **What's in it for you?** You will have the opportunity to get to know these organizations more closely, explore the key professional profiles, understand selection processes, and make informed choices about pursuing a career in the international and public sector. Company Visits: live an in-house employer experience **Tours to companies’ facilities or offices, usually lasting 2 to 3 hours.** Each event is organized ad hoc, but they usually include presentations, Q&A sessions, networking moments, visit to production areas, research labs or other relevant spaces depending on the nature of the company’s business. **What’s in it for you?** You will have a privileged access to company facilities, gaining a firsthand experience on the company's culture, products, people and work environment, as well as getting valuable insights into career opportunities. Drop-in Sessions: meet the recruiters one-to-one **One-to-one 20-minute informal meetings** with company representatives (HR or Line Manager), designed to create an immediate connection with a potential employer, discover internship and job opportunities, and find out more on the selection process. **What’s in it for you?** You will discuss about your career perspectives with a recruiter, ask questions about current or future available job or internship offers, hand-in your cv. In-Company Trainings: challenge yourself in a hands-on project **Career programs organized at company premises and structured in a theoretical part** (company presentations, speeches) **plus a practical one** (business cases, group work, networking, etc.). **What’s in it for you?** You will gain better understanding of employers and the job market in different Countries, join hands-on projects, engage with company representatives to dive deep into their functional areas, career possibilities, and internship opportunities. - In-Company Trainings are available in [**Italy**](https://www.unibocconi.it/it/studenti-iscritti/career-services/company-training-italia) (please notice that the webpage is in Italian as the knowledge of the language is required to apply) and [**abroad**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/meet-employers/company-training-abroad "In-Company Training abroad") **:** calendars, activities and criteria of participation are program-specific, so make sure to

It is held twice a year and hosts employers from various countries and sectors, including Auditing, Consulting, Finance, Industrial & Consumer Goods, Services, Law and Tax Firms, Tech._ _A unique opportunity to **interact with recruiters** on-campus, **discover internship and job opportunities**, and **submit your application**._ ## 2025 wrapped 2 Editions in spring and fall 285 Participating Employers 5000+ Visitors ## Latest edition _The **spring edition** of Bocconi&Jobs was held in a hybrid format according to the following structure:_ - _**Preview days (10-12 April, 2026)**, to access the virtual booths of Employers, prepare for on-campus meetings, and view available internship and job offers;_ - _**Online webinars (13 April, 2026)**, consisting of a brief company presentation with a final Q&A session, to gather information directly from Employers in preparation for on-campus interactions;_ - _**Live days (14 and 15 April, 2026)**, dedicated to on-campus interaction with company representatives;_ - _**Extra application days (until 26 April, 2026)**, to continue applying online for available opportunities._ ## Info Bocconi&Jobs is dedicated exclusively to **students and graduates up to one year after graduation from the Undergraduate School, and students and graduates up to three years after graduation from the Graduate and Law School.** **Registration is mandatory** to join the event and must be completed through the **dedicated Bocconi&Jobs website,** madeavailable closer to the event. The list of participating employers can be found on the **landing page of the Bocconi&Jobs website,** made available closer to the event. ## Contacts _For further information you can reach us out at [bocconi.jobs@unibocconi.it](mailto:bocconi.jobs@unibocconi.it)_ ### Previous editions - [April 2026](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/TabellaSitoApr2026_0.pdf?VersionId=hYK21DVEO.yJkJcnJTG.oV7I4jvoXJoL) - [November 2025](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/TabellaSitoNov2025.pdf) - [April 2025](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/TabellaSitoApr2025.pdf) - [November 2024](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/TabellaAziendeNov2024%20%281%29_0.pdf) - [April 2024](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/TabellaSitoApr24%20%281%29_1.pdf) - [November 2023](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/TabellaSitoNov23%20%281%29.pdf) - [April 2023](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/TabellaSitoApr23%20%281%29.pdf) This is just an overview of the most recent Bocconi&Jobs. text: Career Services [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services) # Career fairs _Career fairs are **interactive events** where you can **meet with a range of employers under one roof**. Bocconi career fairs may be dedicated to specific industries or open to all professional sectors, and can be organized in Italy or abroad, in presence or online. Regardless of the format, **companies will showcase their internship and placement offers**, and you can engage with recruiters to **gather information about specific roles, share your CV and make connections** for immediate or future internship and job opportunities._ ## Available activities Bocconi&Jobs Two editions per year, it’s **the University’s main career event**, where you can meet companies from any business field and from different Countries. Check out the [dedicated page](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/current-students/career-services/meet-employers/bocconijobs "Bocconi&Jobs") to find out all the info about the event.
