Le compagnie che effettuano collegamenti diretti includono **Autostradale**, **Air Pullman** (Linate Shuttle) e **Flibco**, oltre al servizio di linea urbana ATM. ### Airport Bus Express – Autostradale La compagnia [Autostradale]( gestisce il servizio **Airport Bus Express**, che collega **Milano Centrale** (Piazza Luigi di Savoia) a Linate con una fermata intermedia a **Milano Lambrate**. Le corse partono ogni **10 minuti** dalle 05:35 alle 00:35, tutti i giorni. Il costo del biglietto è pari a un normale biglietto ATM: **2,20 euro**, valido 90 minuti su tutta la rete. Il tempo di percorrenza è di circa **35 minuti**. [ATM Milano](https://www.atm.it/) ### Linate Shuttle – Air Pullman **Air Pullman** gestisce il **Linate Shuttle**, che collega l’aeroporto di Linate (fermata in corrispondenza dell’accesso Arrivi) con la **Stazione Centrale di Milano**. Dal **17 luglio 2023**, il servizio effettua il percorso **diretto senza fermate intermedie**, con un tempo medio di percorrenza di circa **25-30 minuti**. Il costo del biglietto è di **7 euro**. Il servizio è operativo 7 giorni su 7. Air Pullman offre anche connessioni inter-aeroportuali **Linate–Malpensa**, nonché collegamenti verso **Rho Fiera** e **Fieramilano**. [Air Pullman Linate Shuttle](https://www.milano-aeroporti.it/linate-shuttle/en/index.html) ### Flibco – Linate Shuttle **Flibco** collega l’aeroporto di Linate con **Milano Centrale** (Piazza Luigi di Savoia) con un servizio navetta al costo di **7 euro** a persona. Il tempo di percorrenza è di circa **25-30 minuti** e le corse partono con frequenza di circa ogni ora. Il biglietto può essere acquistato online o tramite app, con la possibilità di scegliere l’orario preferito in anticipo. Il [Malpensa Express]( è l’opzione **più rapida**: i treni impiegano circa 40 minuti per raggiungere Milano Cadorna o circa 50 minuti per Milano Centrale, con partenze ogni 15 minuti. I **bus** sono invece la scelta **più economica**, con biglietti a partire da 6 euro, anche se nelle ore di punta possono risentire del traffico. Per chi preferisce la comodità porta a porta, il **taxi** raggiunge qualsiasi indirizzo di Milano con una **tariffa fissa di 114 euro**, mentre per Fiera Milano Rho la tariffa scende a 94 euro. Il collegamento Malpensa-Linate in taxi ha invece una tariffa fissa di 128 euro. ## Malpensa Express L’aeroporto internazionale di Milano Malpensa è dotato di una **stazione ferroviaria** in ognuno dei due terminal, collocata al livello -1. Il treno che collega lo scalo con la città è denominato [Malpensa Express]( ed è gestito dalla compagnia **Trenord**. Il servizio è operativo **dalle ore 04:00 alle ore 02:00** con una frequenza di **4 treni all’ora** (ogni 15 minuti) in entrambe le direzioni, per un totale di circa 146 corse giornaliere. Il Malpensa Express ferma sia al **Terminal 1** che al **Terminal 2**. ### Destinazioni principali - **Milano Cadorna**: percorso diretto, durata circa **40 minuti**. Eventuali bagagli aggiuntivi vengono imbarcati al costo di 5 euro a collo. I biglietti sono nominativi e acquistabili a bordo oppure online sul sito o sull’app, pagando con carta di credito. I biglietti sono flessibili: possono essere cancellati e riprogrammati fino a 6 ore prima della partenza. In caso di ritardo o anticipo del volo, è possibile utilizzare lo stesso biglietto per le 2 partenze successive o precedenti. Il servizio effettua fermate alla stazione Lingotto, a Porta Susa e a Corso G. Cesare, per poi raggiungere il Terminal 1 e il Terminal 2 di Malpensa. [Flibco Torino-Malpensa](https://www.flibco.com/it/shuttle/bus-torino-aeroporto-malpensa) ### Como **Flibco** offre il primo collegamento diretto tra il [centro di Como e l’aeroporto di Malpensa](https://www.flibco.com/it/shuttle/navetta-aeroporto-malpensa-como). Il servizio è disponibile **7 giorni su 7 e 24 ore su 24**. Le navette si fermano di fronte alla stazione San Giovanni (a pochi passi dal centro) e a Grandate Breccia. [Flibco Como-Malpensa](https://www.flibco.com/it/shuttle/navetta-aeroporto-malpensa-como) ### Novara La compagnia **STN** (Società Trasporti Novaresi) opera ogni giorno un collegamento tra la città piemontese e l’aeroporto di Milano Malpensa. Le corse partono tutti i giorni — eccezion fatta per il 25 dicembre — alle ore 6:30, 9:10, 11:10, 13:10, 15:10, 16:10, 17:10 e 18:10 dall’autostazione di Novara, effettuando fermate intermedie alla stazione ferroviaria di Novara, Veveri, Bellinzago e Oleggio. L’arrivo a Milano Malpensa (prima fermata al Terminal 1, seconda al Terminal 2) è previsto dopo circa un’ora. Il biglietto si acquista direttamente a bordo. [STN Novara-Malpensa](http://www.stnnet.it/novaramalpensa.html) ### Domodossola La cittadina di **Domodossola** e **Milano Malpensa** sono collegate da un servizio operato da **Comazzi Bus**, chiamato Alibus. È necessario prenotare il viaggio entro le ore 12:00 del giorno precedente alla data di partenza. Per le partenze di domenica e lunedì la richiesta deve essere effettuata entro le ore 12:00 del sabato. La corsa parte dalla stazione ferroviaria di Domodossola e ferma a Vogogna/Piedimulera, Gravellona Toce, Malpensa Terminal 2 (fermata bus numero 11) e Malpensa Terminal 1 (uscita 3, fermata 6). Il costo della tratta è di **15 euro**, con pagamento a bordo. [Comazzi Bus Domodossola-Malpensa](http://www.comazzibus.com/prenotazione_alibus.php) ### Genova Dall’aeroporto di Milano Malpensa è possibile **raggiungere Genova** grazie alla linea Genova-Alessandria-Casale-Malpensa effettuata da **Volpi Bus**. La frequenza è giornaliera: parte da Genova in Piazza della Vittoria alle 06:00 ed effettua fermate a Stazione Principe, Alessandria Ovest e Casale Sud, per arrivare al Terminal 1 di Milano Malpensa alle 08:55 (uscita 3 – posto 6) e al Terminal 2 (posto 3) alle 09:00. Il viaggio di ritorno parte dal Terminal 2 alle ore 12:30 e giunge a Genova alle 15:30. La tratta viene effettuata tutti i giorni, tutto l’anno. - Da **Genova** a Milano Malpensa: **25 euro** a tratta - Da **Alessandria**: **17 euro** - Da **Casale**: **15 euro** - Andata e ritorno in giornata: **30 euro** [Volpi Bus Genova-Malpensa](http://www.statturismo.com/pdf/malpensa.pdf) ### Svizzera (Lugano, Bellinzona, Mendrisio) L’aeroporto di Milano Malpensa è collegato direttamente con il **Canton Ticino** grazie ai

title: Pubblicazione orari del Trasporto Pubblico Locale in formato GTFS - Agenzia Mobilità Ambiente Territorio
text: Anno inizio: 2014 (in corso) Tra le attività di generazione e pubblicazione degli Open Data, **AMAT si occupa di produrre in formato GTFS** ( [General Transit Feed Specification](https://developers.google.com/transit/gtfs/reference)) **i dati del servizio programmato corrente esercitato da ATM S.p.A.** (Azienda Trasporti Milanesi) nell’ambito del Contratto di Servizio attivo con il Comune di Milano. Il GTFS definisce un formato comune per gli orari programmati del Trasporto Pubblico Locale e le relative informazioni geografiche. Il feed è pubblicato sul [portale Open data del comune di e si può scaricare direttamente al seguente link: [https://dati.comune.milano.it/gtfs.zip](https://dati.comune.milano.it/gtfs.zip) ### Temi collegati [**Trasporto Pubblico Locale**](https://www.amat-mi.it/it/temi/trasporto-pubblico-locale/) [**Open data**](https://www.amat-mi.it/it/temi/open-data/)

text: # Scopri _Milano_ ![Scopri Milano](https://media.camplus.it/images/2023/04/Camplus_citta_MILANO_large.jpg) #### Camplus è presente nel capoluogo lombardo con **collegi di merito** e **residenze** destinati agli studenti universitari che offrono anche soluzioni di breve permanenza per **viaggiatori** e **lavoratori**. Generally if your budget is low you can try to ask your university in Milan if they have availability in their student residences in order to try to get in the ranking and apply, matching their requirements; or you can try to use websites of portals that recommend rooms within your budget range. If, on the other hand, you have a more flexible budget and, above all, you have more comfortable and demanding expectations and habits, then the best solution is undoubtedly the student residence typology, because in that case you turn to specialised structures with high quality comforts, services and facilities. Student residences offer the option of renting a flat on your own for comfort and privacy, or arranging with a friend or university friend to rent it together and share the costs. **Habit and comfort** When choosing where you want to live in Milan it is natural that you should consider what your normal habits are. If living in a small room, far from the university, shared with a stranger or with 4 flatmates and only one bathroom can be a struggle for you, then you should turn to the student residence market. You should know that having an en-suite bathroom for every student is a luxury in Milan so if you come across this type of house, stick to it. Also consider that studying, preparing for exams is demanding and if you don’t intend to clean your house or throw the rubbish every day, then you should opt for the rent of a flat with the residence formula service that allows you to enjoy comforts such as cleaning service and change of linen and everything else that could make you lose time and energy. **The running costs of an apartment** When you are looking for a house and are presented with the price, you should always be careful to assess the cost (usually extra if you are looking for a private homeowner) that will affect your monthly expenditure. **The running costs of a flat**. What are these costs? Of course nowadays it has become essential to have a very good internet connection to do distance learning and to prepare for exams, that’s why the web connection is the most important item in your case. Then you have to consider the electricity and gas bills for heating your house in winter and air conditioning in summer. Imagine having to study a difficult exam in 40 degrees Celsius, it’s not the best. Finally, you have to pay for your building and waste disposal tax. Our strong interdisciplinary focus underpins high quality in teaching at all levels across a broad range of fields. Several factors affect the rent of student residences, including the type of student accommodation you book. The tradition began in the late 19th century, when Gaspare Campari, intent on serving a drink that stimulated rather than spoiled the appetite, began serving his eponymous bitter aperitif. We’d highly recommend a night out at this grand auditorium, it’s truly an experience like no other. But if you’re not feeling like sitting through an entire night of opera, why not visit the museum instead, where you can at least enjoy the aesthetic majesty of the glorious red and gold interior. - San Siro Stadium This colossal football shrine is a testament to the popularity of both AC Milan and Inter, the city’s two football teams. The stadium was consistently enlarged over the first half of the 20th century to accommodate more and more fans, eventually reaching a capacity of around 80,000 people (making it the largest in Italy and one of the largest stadiums in Europe). This also makes it a prime spot for concerts with the likes of Beyoncé, Jay-Z, Coldplay, Bruce Springsteen, One Direction and Madonna all gracing the stadium. ### Are there free things to do in Milan? - There are lots of free things to do in Milan. Tuttavia, trasferirsi qui per studiare comporta una serie di costi che vanno ben oltre le tasse universitarie. In questo articolo esamineremo le principali spese legate allo studio e alla vita quotidiana di uno studente a Milano, con consigli utili per gestire al meglio il proprio budget. ## **Quanto costano le università a Milano** Il costo delle università a Milano varia notevolmente a seconda che si tratti di istituzioni private o pubbliche. text: [Skip menu](https://www.italia.it/en/italy/practical-information/emergency-and-assistance#content) # Useful information in the event of an emergency When travelling abroad, knowing what numbers to call in an emergency can be of great help. 1 minute Like ![](https://tourismmedia.italia.it/is/image/mitur/1600X1000_emergenza_5-4?wid=1080&hei=660&fit=constrain,1&fmt=webp) 1/1 ### **Emergency numbers in Italy** If you find yourself in serious difficulty and need help, the single number to call for **emergencies in Italy is 112**. This is a free number to dial without any prefix: the operator will put you in touch with the most appropriate authority or service. For needs limited to specific areas, you can call the following numbers: - State Police: **113** (accidents, thefts, etc.). - Fire brigade: **115** (fires, weather emergencies). - Urgent and emergency medical attention: **118** (health-related needs). This number is also relevant for mountain or cave rescue. - Roadside Assistance: at all hours of the day for motorists in emergency, assistance is provided by the [Automobile Club d’Italia](https://www.aci.it/laci/sicurezza-stradale/servizi-di-assistenza.html) (ACI), a federation of 106 provincial Automobile Clubs, which represents and protects the interests of Italian motoring. You can contact them on **803.116** or visit the official ACI website. - Forest ranger: **1515** - Travel information: **1518** - Sea rescue: **1530** - Veterinary assistance **(** [my vet of Poste Italiane](https://www.poste.it/files/1476505981568/Assistenzaveterinaria.pdf) **)** Show more Useful info ## All you need to know Previous [![](https://www.italia.it/content/dam/tdh/loghi/slider-info/arrivi@1.5x.svg)**How to travel to Italy**](https://www.italia.it/en/italy/practical-information/how-to-travel-to-italy-transports) [![](https://www.italia.it/content/dam/tdh/loghi/slider-info/collegamenti@1.5x.svg)**How to get around**](https://www.italia.it/en/italy/practical-information/how-to-travel-around-italy) [![](https://www.italia.it/content/dam/tdh/loghi/slider-info/pagamenti@1.5x.svg)**How to pay**](https://www.italia.it/en/italy/practical-information/money-payments-and-tipping-in-italy) [![](https://www.italia.it/content/dam/tdh/loghi/slider-info/comunicazione@1.5x.svg)**Phone calls and Internet**](https://www.italia.it/en/italy/practical-information/phones-internet-and-data-roaming-italy) [![](https://www.italia.it/content/dam/tdh/loghi/slider-info/orari@1.5x.svg)**Daily schedules and public holidays**](https://www.italia.it/en/italy/practical-information/time-zones-and-public-holidays-italy) Next #### Save your favorite places Create an account or log in to save your wishlist Sign up Do you already have an account? Thanks to Vito, who delivered the phone to me at the bus stop, and thanks to everyone! ★★★★★ Anna D. Customer Excellent experience! The buses are always on time and the staff is so kind and helpful. They do their best to get you safely to your destination and give you the best experience without worrying about anything. The buses are comfortable with air conditioning and there's plenty of space for hand luggage on board. To make your trip smooth, I highly recommend choosing this company over the others! ★★★★★ FAQ How do I choose the right Malpensa Shuttle bus for my flight? We recommend booking the bus so that you arrive at the airport at least 4 hours before your flight. In most cases, your ticket can also be used on earlier or later trips on the same date, subject to service availability and free seats. Where are the Malpensa Shuttle bus stops located? The addresses of the stops and maps to find their exact location are available on the "Stops" page of our website. What are the Malpensa Shuttle bus timetables? All bus timetables are available on the "Stops" page of our website. [Read all FAQs](https://www.malpensashuttle.it/en/faq)

title: Student Care - Welcome book | SDA Bocconi
text: ![Campus]( # Student Care ## Research, Rethink, Reimagine \| SDA Bocconi > The trust placed in us by our students and their appreciation for our work drive us to devise programs and teaching methodologies able to develop skills and help young talents, experienced managers, companies and institutions be truly global. > > In welcoming you warmly, I would like to thank you for choosing us; I strongly believe that your time here will play an important part in your future success. **Stefano Caselli** Dean, SDA Bocconi School of Management ![Dean]( ### International Student Care Moving to a foreign country to study can be an unfamiliar and stressful experience, but we want to make the transition as smooth as possible and your time at SDA Bocconi enjoyable and worry-free. With an ever-greater awareness of the importance of student wellbeing and engagement, SDA Bocconi makes its **Student Care Service** available to anyone enrolled in a master program. We will continue to expand our services as we grow, to further provide everyone with the guidance they need to feel safe, protected and fulfilled during their time at SDA Bocconi. Our purpose is to give you a positive experience: we are particularly aware of the challenges for international students and therefore offer guidance throughout all of the processes involved in studying at SDA Bocconi. We provide services to help with a variety of bureaucratic and practical matters as well as help in the event of unexpected and difficult situations. To accompany you throughout these steps, we strongly encourage you to consult our **Roadmap**, a comprehensive and easy-to-follow guide designed to help you navigate essential steps both before and upon your arrival. The roadmap outlines key procedures, such as visas, tax codes, health insurance, accommodation, and residency requirements and offers useful resources to help you settle into Milan and fully prepare for your journey at SDA Bocconi. Just read it carefully, as it contains valuable information that will help make your transition smoother and more informed. title: Iscrizione al servizio sanitario regionale e scelta del medico | Servizi Territoriali ASST Milano
text: # Iscrizione al servizio sanitario regionale e scelta del medico L’assistenza sanitaria è garantita a tutti i cittadini (italiani e stranieri aventi diritto) attraverso una rete di servizi (assistenza medica e pediatrica, farmaceutica, specialistica ambulatoriale, ospedaliera, domiciliare e consultoriale) mediante l’iscrizione al Servizio Sanitario Regionale. **L’iscrizione è obbligatoria e comporta la scelta del medico curante**. Il cittadino, (o persona delegata) deve presentarsi presso gli uffici “Scelta e Revoca” con il **codice fiscale, autocertificazione di residenza, eventuale tessera sanitaria dell’Azienda Sanitaria di competenza, documento di identità** dell’interessato (anche nel caso di persona delegata) o **delega**(in caso di persona delegata all’iscrizione). Per i **nuovi nati** il genitore deve anche compilare un’autocertificazione attestante la nascita del figlio e la composizione della famiglia ed esibire il codice fiscale del neonato. All’atto dell’iscrizione al Servizio Sanitario Regionale il cittadino effettua la scelta del medico curante, di norma tra i medici inseriti nell’ambito territoriale di appartenenza. All’atto dell’iscrizione viene rilasciata una **tessera cartacea provvisoria** e successivamente, in genere entro un mese, viene recapitata all’indirizzo di residenza la Carta Regionale dei Servizi (una smart card elettronica), che sostituisce la tessera cartacea. Solo se l’iscrizione è inferiore a sei mesi non viene rilasciata tale Carta. ### Revoca e ricusazione del medico Al cittadino è data facoltà di interrompere il rapporto con il curante e di scegliere un altro medico per diversi motivi (es. trasferimento in altro comune, interruzione del rapporto di fiducia, ecc…). Anche al medico è data la possibilità, per giustificati motivi, di chiedere la revoca (ricusare) della scelta operata in suo favore. In questo caso l’ufficio “Scelta e revoca” invierà una comunicazione scritta all’assistito, con invito ad effettuare la scelta a favore di un altro medico. ### Scelta in deroga del medico Per garantire la continuità di cura e del rapporto di fiducia, il cittadino che trasferisce la residenza in un altro comune può mantenere l’iscrizione al proprio medico di famiglia. Il tal caso il cittadino deve compilare presso gli uffici “Scelta e revoca” il modello di “Richiesta in deroga”, corredato da eventuale documentazione sanitaria pertinente e produrre la dichiarazione di **accettazione sottoscritta dal medico curante**, anche attestata mediante compilazione del riquadro riservato al medico all’interno del modulo “Richiesta in deroga”. ## Iscrizione temporanea di assistito residente in altra ASL/ATS Nel caso in cui un cittadino soggiorni temporaneamente, per **un periodo non inferiore ai 3 mesi**, nel territorio di un’ATS/ASL diversa da quella di residenza, è possibile chiedere l’iscrizione all’ufficio “Scelta e revoca” di temporanea dimora, con scelta del Medico curante, solo se ricorre una delle seguenti condizioni: – essere in possesso di esenzione per patologia cronica o invalidità rilasciata dall’ASST/ATS di residenza; – essere studente; – svolgere attività lavorativa. Inoltre, in Regione Lombardia, l’iscrizione temporanea può essere estesa: – ai cittadini a partire dal compimento del 75° anno di età; – agli ospiti di comunità protetta; – ai minori in affido o in attesa di adozione; – ai familiari a carico di lavoratore (situazione già tutelata anche dal Circolare Ministero della Sanità 11.05.1984 n. 1000.1169).

Per ottenere l’iscrizione temporanea occorre recarsi presso gli uffici “Scelta e revoca” con documento d’identità, carta regionale dei servizi/cod.fiscale o tessera sanitaria nazionale, autocertificazione di domicilio, attestazione di revoca del medico nel precedente luogo di residenza e idonea documentazione che attesti una delle condizioni previste. Il cittadino viene cancellato temporaneamente dall’ATS di residenza e dal proprio medico; la riattivazione dell’iscrizione presso l’ATS di provenienza viene effettuata al rientro nel Comune di residenza, su richiesta dell’interessato. ## Iscrizione di cittadini italiani residenti all’estero I cittadini italiani che hanno spostato la residenza anagrafica all’estero ( AIRE- Anagrafe degli Italiani Residenti all’Estero ), anche se ivi domiciliati e con i **contributi attualmente versati in tale Paese, hanno diritto all’iscrizione gratuita al Servizio Sanitario Regionale, ma senza l’iscrizione col medico** e valida solo per **prestazioni ospedaliere urgenti**, per la durata massima di 90 giorni nell’anno solare, anche non consecutivi ( D.M. sanità-tesoro 1/2/96, circ. Min. San. 1000.V-19/833/630) I documenti da presentare sono: – Documento di identità – Codice fiscale – Autocertificazione attestante la non copertura assicurativa pubblica o privata nel Paese estero di provenienza – Autocertificazione dello stato di emigrante – Autocertificazione di eventuale pensione erogata da Enti previdenziali italiani – Autocertificazione di eventuale frazione dei 90 giorni di assistenza già fruiti per richiesta ad altra ASST/ASL I cittadini italiani che hanno spostato la residenza anagrafica all’Estero ( AIRE ), aventi attività lavorativa comportante invece **versamento dei contributi in Italia**, se temporaneamente domiciliati in Italia, possono iscriversi, con **scelta anche del medico**, per la durata massima dell’anno solare. I documenti da presentare sono: – Documento di identità – Codice fiscale – Autocertificazione attestante la non copertura assicurativa pubblica o privata nel Paese estero di provenienza – Documentazione comprovante il versamento dei contributi in Italia ## Mantenimento del pediatra oltre i 14 anni di età Su richiesta del genitore e previa accettazione del medico, è possibile continuare ad avvalersi dell’assistenza del Pediatra anche oltre i 14 anni e comunque non oltre il 16° anno di età, nel caso l’assistito presenti: – patologia cronica o handicap – documentata situazione di disagio psico-sociale. Il genitore deve presentarsi agli uffici “Scelta e revoca” con: – carta regionale dei servizi del figlio – richiesta di mantenimento della scelta del Pediatra oltre i 14 anni corredata da documentazione pertinente; – dichiarazione di accettazione sottoscritta dal Pediatra, anche attestata mediante compilazione del riquadro riservato al medico all’interno del modulo “Richiesta del mantenimento della scelta a favore del Pediatra per i cittadini con più di 14 anni”. ## Necessità occasionali di assistenza medica Nel caso in cui il cittadino si trovi occasionalmente nel territorio di un’ATS diversa da quella di residenza, per un periodo inferiore ai 3 mesi o per un periodo superiore ma legato a motivi diversi da quelli sopra indicati, non è possibile procedere all’iscrizione al Servizio Sanitario Regionale nella ASST di temporanea dimora. Per problematiche sanitarie non differibili, il cittadino può rivolgersi ad un medico o pediatra di famiglia che svolge la propria attività nel territorio, con pagamento della visita ambulatoriale o domiciliare. Presentando la ricevuta del pagamento della prestazione all’ATS di residenza, il cittadino ha diritto al rimborso della spesa sostenuta da parte della ATS di residenza. Per necessità sanitarie urgenti il cittadino può rivolgersi al Pronto Soccorso di una delle Strutture ospedaliere del territorio. ### Costo massimo rimborsabile – Prestazione del Medico di famiglia: € 15,00 per visita ambulatoriale e € 25,00 per visita domiciliare; – Prestazione del Pediatra di famiglia: € 25,00 per la visita ambulatoriale e € 35,00 per la visita domiciliare. _Si fa presente che non sono rimborsabili le visite effettuate presso la guardia medica, guardia turistica, pronto soccorso._ ## La carta regionale dei servizi La Carta Regionale dei Servizi è una te **ssera elettronica, dotata di microchip**, che garantisce il riconoscimento della identità del cittadino, tutelandone la privacy. La Carta Regionale dei Servizi è valida come: – Tessera **Sanitaria Nazionale**; – **Tessera Europea di Assicurazione Malattia (TEAM)** perché sostituisce il modello E-111 e garantisce l’assistenza sanitaria all’estero, secondo le normative dei singoli paesi; – Tesserino del **Codice Fiscale**; – **Carta Nazionale dei Servizi perché** è stata creata secondo gli standard tecnici internazionali previsti per le smart card e pertanto permette l’accesso ai servizi on-line che richiedono un’identificazione. Inoltre è il documento che consente di: – scegliere il medico e/o il pediatra di famiglia; – ottenere prestazioni sanitarie (ricoveri, visite ed esami specialistici); – ottenere prescrizione di farmaci. In ospedale, in ASST e in farmacia, la Carta permette una maggior rapidità e sicurezza nel riconoscimento dell’assistito e nell’erogazione dei Servizi. title: Bligny Residence | Bocconi University
text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Bligny Residence [VIA BLIGNY Inaugurated in September 2016, the **Bligny Residence** is located on campus. The Residence has: **A.** 4 single rooms with a private bathroom and shared kitchen; **B.** 60 single rooms with a gender - specific bathroom shared with another student and shared kitchen; **C.** 112 bedrooms in apartments with 4 single rooms, 3 bathrooms and a shared living room/kitchen area. **Description of the spaces** All rooms are furnished with a bed, a desk, a wardrobe and are equipped with WiFi internet. Blankets, sheets, pillowcases and towels are provided. Linens are changed and rooms are cleaned once a week. Guests in Bligny Residence may use shared kitchens located in each floor or the kitchen located in the common areas of the apartments. In addition, there are study rooms, break rooms, a coin laundry area and a relax area. ## Dorm amenities ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/wifi01.png.webp?itok=pWkMyOHT) ### Wifi ### Laundry ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/pc01.png.webp?itok=zAkNT_hw) ### Study area ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/bar01.png.webp?itok=LLjT3qmo) ### Recreation area Why live in University housing? First of all, **location**: university residence halls are on or near campus, close to classes and the university facilities, and just minutes from the center of town. Another important advantage of dorm life is constant **interaction** with your fellow students, Italian and international alike. You'll meet lots of different people with whom you'll have many things in common - interests, ambitions and dreams - in addition to your studies. It will be friendly environment where you'll soon feel at home. Only students who are attending Bocconi University or participating in exchange programs are allowed to access the residence halls. Plus, living in one of the university residence halls is both **safe and convenient**. All our residence halls have a doorman ready to help you 24/7, and the services included in your lodging fee will allow you to maintain your busy schedule without worrying about the electric bill or changing the sheets. All Bocconi residence halls are closed during summer period, according to the period of suspension of courses and exams. | | What the residents love about the Bligny Residence - The Bligny Residence is located inside the campus; - It is provided with large study rooms; - It is located in a central area and well served by public transport. How to book a room? **Booking a room in a Bocconi residence is simple**: participate in one of the online applications planned for the 2026-27 academic year, at preferential or full rate. Please check the information available on our homepage at the following [link](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs/housing "Housing"). ### Campus VR - [Take a Virtual Tour of the Residence](https://www.campusvr.unibocconi.it/en/Tour/Detail?id=2) [Join Us at Our Open Day](https://bocconiopenday.liveforum.space/membership/login?lang=en-GB&source=float_login "Join Us at Our Open Day") [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs/housing/bligny-residence#addtoany "Show all")

title: Cancellation and Revocation a.y. 2026-27 | Bocconi University
text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Cancellation and Revocation a.y. 2026-27 Bocconi Residence Halls _The content of this page applies exclusively to the 7 Bocconi Residence Halls. The partner facilities Aparto Giovenale and Olympic Village follow specific regulations and policies shared by their respective managers._ #### **Cancellation** Housing assignments will be cancelled by the office for students who fall into the following cases and who have not applied for RENUNCIATION or WITHDRAWAL in the prescribed time and manner: **Lack of the requirements to use the Housing Service (merit and academic year enrollment)** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who at any time during the year are found to lack one or more requirements to use the Housing service: merit requirement or enrollment requirement for the a.y. 2025-26. Such students will be required to vacate the accommodation immediately, will still be required to pay in full any housing installments already due and they will not be entitled to a refund if already paid. They will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. **Withdraw from studies or transfer to another university** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who will matriculate/enroll in a.y. 2025-26 and who after matriculation/enrollment, at any time during the academic year, **transfer to another university or withdraw their studies**. Such students will be required to vacate the accommodation immediately, **will still be required to pay in full any housing installments already due** and they will not be entitled to a refund if already paid. They will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. **Failure to comply with payment deadlines** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who fail to pay the housing installment after 15 days from the due date. Such students will be required to vacate the accommodation immediately, **will still be required to pay in full any housing installments already due** and they will not be entitled to a refund of installments already paid. The student will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. In this case, also the **suspension of the academic and administrative position of the student is applied** until he/she submits proof of completed payment regarding the amounts due. The university also reserves the right in this case to order the ineligibility of the student to use the Housing Service for the entire duration of the study cycle. **Graduation** The housing assignments will be cancelled for those who graduate during the year. Such students will have to leave their assigned housing permanently by the end of the same month of graduation. They will be due (or not refunded) in this case the exit month and the following month. The student will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. **Missing economic requirement Right to university Education (for assignees at preferential rate)** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who are found to be assignees of preferential rate housing for a.y. 2025-26, but submit

In this case the student will have to permanently leave the housing assigned to him/her. A student who receives a disciplinary sanction of suspension from exams and partial exams during the year will not incur revocation of the housing assignment, however, if he or she has an assignment at preferential rate, he or she will undergo the **change of rate from preferential to full rate**, and will therefore be required to pay the housing fee at the full rate starting from the first installment due after the sanction is communicated. **Serious violation of the Bocconi Residence Regulations** A student who during the course of the year incurs disciplinary sanctions in excess of a warning imposed by the university incurs **revocation of the housing assignment resulting in the expulsion from the residence hall** and loss of the security deposit. In this case, the student must permanently leave the housing assigned. The university reserves the right to refer the student to the Disciplinary Committee. The university also reserves the right in this case to order the ineligibility of the student to use the Housing Service for the entire duration of the study cycle. **False declarations** A student who submits/has submitted/ untrue statements incurs **revocation of the housing assignment resulting in expulsion from the residence hall** and loss of the security deposit. In this case, the student must immediately and permanently leave the housing assigned. text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Cancellation a.y. 2025-26 Housing assignments will be cancelled by the office for students who fall into the following cases and who have not applied for RENUNCIATION or WITHDRAWAL in the prescribed time and manner: **Lack of the requirements to use the Housing Service (merit and academic year enrollment)** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who at any time during the year are found to **lack one or more requirements to use the Housing service:** merit requirement or enrollment requirement for the a.y. 2025-26. Such students will be required to vacate the accommodation immediately, **will still be required to pay in full any housing installments already due** and they will not be entitled to a refund if already paid. They will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. **Withdraw from studies or transfer to another university** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who will matriculate/enroll in a.y. 2025-26 and who after matriculation/enrollment, at any time during the academic year, **transfer to another university or withdraw their studies**. Such students will be required to vacate the accommodation immediately, **will still be required to pay in full any housing installments already due** and they will not be entitled to a refund if already paid. They will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. **Failure to comply with payment deadlines** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who fail to pay the housing installment **after 15 days** from the due date. Such students will be required to vacate the accommodation immediately, **will still be required to pay in full any housing installments already due** and they will not be entitled to a refund of installments already paid. The student will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. In this case, also the **suspension of the academic and administrative position of the student is applied** until he/she submits proof of completed payment regarding the amounts due. The university also reserves the right in this case to order the ineligibility of the student to use the Housing Service for the entire duration of the study cycle. **Graduation** The housing assignments will be cancelled for those who graduate during the year. Such students will have to leave their assigned housing permanently by the end of the same month of graduation. They will be due (or not refunded) in this case the exit month and the following month. The student will not be entitled to a refund of the security deposit. **Missing economic requirement Right to university Education (for assignees at preferential rate)** The housing assignment will be cancelled to those who are found to be assignees of preferential rate housing for a.y. 2025-26, but submit for the purpose of the Bocconi ISU Scholarship application a.y. 2025-26 an ISEE/ISEEU parificato whose values do not fall within the limits provided to benefit from preferential rate. Such students will be required to vacate the accommodation immediately,

title: Castiglioni Residence | Bocconi University
text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Castiglioni Residence VIA CASTIGLIONI Inaugurated in 2018, the **Castiglioni Residence** is located on campus and has: **A.** 200 single rooms in 4-bedroom apartments with 2 bathrooms and a shared living room/kitchen area; **B.** 90 single rooms in 2-bedroom apartments with 1 bathroom and a living room/kitchen area; **C.** 10 studio apartments with bedroom, bathroom and living room/kitchen area. **Description of the spaces** All rooms are furnished with a bed, a desk, a wardrobe and are equipped with WiFi internet. Blankets, sheets, pillowcases and towels are provided. Linens are changed and rooms are cleaned once a week. Kitchens are located in the common areas of the apartments. In addition, there are study rooms, break rooms, a coin laundry area and a relax area. ## Dorm amenities ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/wifi01.png.webp?itok=pWkMyOHT) ### Wifi ### Laundry ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/pc01.png.webp?itok=zAkNT_hw) ### Study area ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/bar01.png.webp?itok=LLjT3qmo) ### Recreation area ### Paid parking Why live in University housing? First of all, **location**: university residence halls are on or near campus, close to classes and the university facilities, and just minutes from the center of town. Another important advantage of dorm life is constant **interaction** with your fellow students, Italian and international alike. You'll meet lots of different people with whom you'll have many things in common - interests, ambitions and dreams - in addition to your studies. It will be friendly environment where you'll soon feel at home. Only students who are attending Bocconi University or participating in exchange programs are allowed to access the residence halls. Plus, living in one of the university residence halls is both **safe and convenient**. All our residence halls have a doorman ready to help you 24/7, and the services included in your lodging fee will allow you to maintain your busy schedule without worrying about the electric bill or changing the sheets. All Bocconi residence halls are closed during summer period, according to the period of suspension of courses and exams. What the residents love about the Castiglioni Residence - The Castiglioni Residence was inaugurated in 2018 and is furnished with modern furniture and appliances; - It is right on campus; - It is located close to green areas and parks. How to book a room? **Booking a room in a Bocconi residence is simple**: participate in one of the online applications planned for the 2026-27 academic year, at preferential or full rate. Please check the information available on our homepage at the following [link](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs/housing "Housing"). ### Campus VR - [Take a Virtual Tour of the Bocconi campus](https://www.campusvr.unibocconi.it/en/Tour/List) [Join Us at Our Open Day](https://bocconiopenday.liveforum.space/membership/login?lang=en-GB&source=float_login "Join Us at Our Open Day") [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs/housing/castiglioni-residence#addtoany "Show all")

I see this spirit most clearly at the Olympic Games, where athletes from every corner of our world compete with passion: yet they respect, support, and inspire one another. In 2026, Bocconi University proudly takes up the legacy of the Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games by transforming the Olympic Village into a new home for its students. Through this project, the campus expands and integrates even further with the city of Milan, and it’s ready to welcome hundreds of new students. **The new rooms available at the Olympic Village will be specifically** **reserved for freshmen** starting their journey at Bocconi in the 2026-27 academic year. This offer adds to the roughly 2,000 rooms already available in Bocconi Residences, further strengthening the housing experience provided by the University. The Village was designed to leave a lasting legacy for both the city and the students beyond the Olympic event, becoming a new hub for university life in a prestigious Milanese neighborhood. Those who live there will become part of an already vibrant and international area, fueled by the presence of approximately 900 students hosted in the Isonzo, Dubini, and Spadolini Residences. The architectural project, centered on the quality of student life, was developed to foster interaction, sharing, and a sense of community. The values expressed by athletes during the Olympic Games - commitment, respect, and dedication - find continuity in this symbolic location. It is destined to become the backdrop for a dynamic and inclusive international community, united by the same determination in both academic and personal pursuits. The complex comprises six residential buildings and two pre-existing historic buildings, restored and enhanced to house functional and easily accessible services, including dining facilities, gyms, and shops. In order to attest their economic eligibility, applicants will be required to submit all the [**necessary "Necessary documentation - ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2025-26") **Economic Requirements** The ISEE/ISEEU parificato and ISPE/ISPEU parificato values are defined annually by the Lombardy Region with its own resolution. For a.y. 2025-26, the values set by the Lombardy Region have been the following: >\> ISEE/ISEEU parificato no higher than € 26.516,70 >> ISPE/ISPEU parificato no higher than € 57.645,03 In order to apply for a benefit of the Right to University Education students whose family household resides and has sources of income **in Italy** will need to obtain an "Attestazione ISEE per prestazioni agevolate per il diritto allo studio universitario"issued in2025 whose "ISEE" and "ISPE" values fall within the limits provided. Otherwise, the application cannot be accepted. Students whose family household resides and has sources of income **outside of Italy** must obtain the **ISEEU Parificato Certificate** issued in 2025,whose "ISEEU" and "ISPEU" values fall within the limits provided.This document can only be issued by the CAF partnered with Bocconi University. It is specified that the **ISPE/ISPEU parificato** value is calculated by the University by dividing the ISP/ISPU parificato value by the equivalence scale. **It is specified that, for all applicants, all declarations attesting an annual income lower than 6.542,51 euros for fiscal year 2023 will not be considered valid for the purpose of housing assignment.** **Economic requirements for INDEPENDENT STUDENTS** For the purpose of adequately accounting for individuals who bear the burden of the student's support, the student is considered independent only if, in addition to the economic requirements described above, **both** of the following requirements are met: - **Residence**, as proven by registry data, outside the housing unit of the family of origin for at least two years before the date of the ISEEU parificato certificate, in an accommodation that is not owned or in usufruct by one of its members and therefore he/she uses an accommodation upon payment that must be documented; - **Income** from employment or similar work, declared for tax purposes for at least the past two years, not less than €9,000.00annually. The work may not be performed under the employment of a family member within the third degree of kinship. The preferential rate of the accommodation service is applied to students who meet the requirements defined by the Right to University Education, based on the economic condition of the applicant's family evaluated on the basis of the value of the ISEE/ISSEU parificato indicator for services for the Right to University Education and the ISPE/ISPEU parificato value. For all other students the full rate is applied. These students will be able to submit the application only for full rate housing. The students assigned with a preferential rate accommodation for whom the contemporary enrollment with the request of the benefit connected with the Right to University Education Assistance at the other University or AFAM is verified, will be requested to pay full rate. title: Housing deposit a.y. 2026-27 | Bocconi University
text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Housing deposit a.y. 2026-27 A security deposit of € 600.00 is required from students who accept the housing assignment to guarantee the fulfillment of all commitments made with the acceptance itself. Payment of the security deposit must be made by credit card through StoreUB, following the instructions available within the housing application at the time of the reservation. Please note that students who renew the accommodation occupied will not have to repeat the payment of the previously paid security deposit. The security deposit will be returned to the student, without interest, and thereafter at the time the student finally vacates their assigned place at the end of the academic year, but no later than January of the following year. This refund timeline will apply to all housing assignments related to the standard assignment period (end of August — end of June), including annual open reservations. The deposit will be refunded under condition that the student has completed all the due housing payments and that he/she has no debts towards Bocconi University or the residence management. In addition, in case the student will not take in charge the possible restoration costs for damages made to the structures of the residence or for recovery of sanitary and general conditions of the room, the housing deposit will also be used for covering the related expenses. When foreseen, the housing deposit refund will be made on a bank account in the student’s name that he/she will need to register on Punto Blu (Home > Personal data > Data Bank Account > Refunds). The security deposit will NOT be refunded and will be kept as a penalty deposit in case of withdrawal from the housing assignment. The security deposit will NOT be refunded in cases of housing renunciation not substantiated by the specific academic reasons provided for the acceptance of the request for withdrawal. More details on this page of the website. The security deposit will NOT, moreover, be returned in cases of revocation and cancellation of housing assignment. text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Isonzo Residence [VIALE ISONZO The Isonzo Residence is located a 15-minute walk from campus and close to the M3 subway line. It was inaugurated in September 2014 and it has two units: Isonzo 23 and Torre Isonzo. The **Isonzo Residence** has: **A.** 11 single rooms with a private bathroom; **B.** 86 single rooms with a gender-specific bathroom shared with another student; The **Torre Isonzo Residence** has: **C.** 116 rooms in 4-bedroom apartments with 2 bathrooms and a shared living room/kitchen area. **Description of the spaces** All rooms are furnished with a bed, a desk, a wardrobe and are equipped with WiFi internet. Blankets, sheets, pillowcases and towels are provided. Linens are changed and rooms are cleaned once a week. Guests in Isonzo Residence may use shared kitchens located on each floor or kitchen located in the common areas of the apartments. In addition, there are study rooms, break rooms, a coin laundry area and a relax area. ## Dorm amenities ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/wifi01.png.webp?itok=pWkMyOHT) ### Wifi ### Laundry ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/pc01.png.webp?itok=zAkNT_hw) ### Study area ![](https://www.unibocconi.it/sites/default/files/styles/scale_h60/public/media/images/bar01.png.webp?itok=LLjT3qmo) ### Recreation area Why live in University housing? First of all, **location**: university residence halls are on or near campus, close to classes and the university facilities, and just minutes from the center of town. Another important advantage of dorm life is constant **interaction** with your fellow students, Italian and international alike. You'll meet lots of different people with whom you'll have many things in common - interests, ambitions and dreams - in addition to your studies. It will be friendly environment where you'll soon feel at home. Only students who are attending Bocconi University or participating in exchange programs are allowed to access the residence halls. Plus, living in one of the university residence halls is both **safe and convenient**. All our residence halls have a doorman ready to help you 24/7, and the services included in your lodging fee will allow you to maintain your busy schedule without worrying about the electric bill or changing the sheets. All Bocconi residence halls are closed during summer period, according to the period of suspension of courses and exams. What the residents love about the Isonzo Residence - The Isonzo Residence is located close to areas of great interest and development; - It is located close to the Metro Station. How to book a room? **Booking a room in a Bocconi residence is simple**: participate in one of the online applications planned for the 2026-27 academic year, at preferential or full rate. text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # July 2027 Accommodation availability and Summer School opportunity _The content of this page refers exclusively to the options available to students already residing in the 7 Bocconi residences during the 2026–27 academic year._ Standard accommodation assignments end for everyone on **27 of June, 2027**. It will not be possible to request an extension in your current assignment for the month of July, but any student who has already been assigned accommodation in one of the Bocconi residences in June 2027 may still request a room in the residence indicated on this page, subject to availability. Please read the paragraphs below carefully with regard to check-out in June and the options available for July. Check out June 2027 Regardless of the end date of your housing assignment, we remind you that **at the end of your housing assignment period, you must completely clear your room and apartment of all your belonging** s, even if you will return to the same room the following year. In fact, as specified in the Bocconi Residences Regulations: _At the time of check-out for the end of the assignment period or during the year, the student is required to completely empty their room and other areas of their accommodation (bathroom, kitchen, living room, where present), including completely emptying refrigerators and freezers. Bocconi University is not responsible for goods left in the apartment/room after check-out._ Attention: rooms are reassigned to Summer School students during the summer, so it is not possible to leave anything inside your room or apartment. **Any issues related to missing or deteriorated items during the summer, a period when the room is not assigned, cannot be considered by Bocconi University or the residence management.** In case of need of storage, we suggest you to evaluate very common luggage storage services in Milan, such as BoxOK, Red Box Storage, Radical storage, Casaforte Milano Staying in Milan: book your accommodation Students already staying in the residence halls during the a.y. 2026-27 (during the month of June of 2027) who need to stay in Milan in July as well, the University has reserved an entire building which will be able to **accommodate all students in need of staying in Milan in July**. In August, however, all Bocconi residence halls will be closed. It will be possible to check the availability and **book a room for the month of July** through a dedicated application, available around February until all available places are filled. Rooms will be assigned following the application order and until all available places are filled. text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Life in the Bocconi dorms a.y. 2026-27 Bocconi Residence Halls _The content of this page refers exclusively to the 7 Bocconi residences. The partner facility Olympic Village provides services detailed on the dedicated page (Dedicated to Freshmen) and on the operator’s pages._ Bocconi University is committed to welcoming you into an environment designed to make Milan your second home: the university residences offer well-maintained spaces, practical services, and an international community that allows you to fully enjoy the university experience. Living in a residence means having the opportunity to share moments of study and leisure with students from all over the world, building relationships that enrich your personal and academic journey. It is a stimulating experience, but one that requires a willingness to engage and share: **living together means respecting others, accepting compromises, and adapting your habits for the good of the group.** In this way, you will develop valuable transferable skills (flexibility, mediation skills, team spirit) that will be useful not only during your years of study but also in your future career. Before making this choice, **consider whether this lifestyle aligns with your needs and well-being**: it is the foundation for successfully navigating the university journey that awaits you. Find out here what to expect from our facilities and all the useful information for your stay in residence. When your accommodation is assigned, you will be informed of the type of room you have been assigned. The bedrooms at Bocconi-owned residences are all **single** rooms and are furnished with a bed, bedside table, desk, and wardrobe. The **bathroom** will be as follows, depending on the type of room: - single room with private bathroom: private for exclusive use - studio apartment: private for exclusive use - single room with shared bathroom: shared with only one student of the same gender - single room in a 2-bedroom apartment: shared with only one student of the same gender - single room in a 4-bedroom apartment: shared with only one student of the same gender As for the **kitchen**, here is how it is provided for each type of room: - single room with private bathroom: has access to a shared kitchen located on the same floor, which serves approximately 15-20 students - single room with shared bathroom: has access to a shared kitchen located on the same floor, which serves approximately 15-20 students - Studio apartment: has a private kitchenette located inside the apartment. - Single room in a 2-bedroom apartment: has a private kitchen, which is shared only with another bedroom. In this case, the room is shared with a student of the same gender. - Single room in a 4-bedroom apartment: has a private kitchen, which is shared only with 3 other bedrooms. Please note that in this case, sharing may be between 4 students of the same gender, but also between students of the opposite gender: it is possible that 4-room apartments may be assigned to 2

In this case, the room is shared with a student of the same gender. - Single room in a 4-bedroom apartment: has a private kitchen, which is shared only with 3 other bedrooms. Please note that in this case, sharing may be between 4 students of the same gender, but also between students of the opposite gender: it is possible that 4-room apartments may be assigned to 2 males and 2 females. When living in residence, you will always have access to a kitchen where you can prepare your meals: it may be inside your apartment or shared on your floor, depending on the type of accommodation you have booked. All kitchens in Bocconi residences are equipped with cooking stoves, so you can only use pots and pans marked with the relevant symbol. Plates, glasses, and other kitchenware are not provided: you can decide to bring them from home before you arrive, although we suggest you wait until you arrive at the residence so that you can organize sharing the purchase or use of these items with your roommates. Near the residences, you will find supermarkets and other well-stocked stores where you can buy everything you need, either for yourself or to share. To ensure a positive experience for everyone, it is essential that all guests cooperate in **leaving the kitchen tidy and clean after each use**: tidying and cleaning must be carried out by each guest after preparing their meal. The cleaning service included in the fee certainly covers the kitchens, but the staff will not be able to complete it properly if the kitchens are found cluttered with dirty dishes and pots. All residences have common areas where you can spend your free time, focus on your studies, or relax with your friends. In particular, you will find: - study room: dedicated to individual or group study and reserved for residence guests, - games room: a recreation area designed in collaboration with student representatives for socializing with other residence guests, - relaxation room: where you can do bodyweight exercises or relax after a long day of studying. All Bocconi Residences and campus buildings are equipped with drinking water dispensers. Check [this page](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/about-us/sustainability/drink-sustainably "Drink Sustainably!") to see where they are located and commit to reducing plastic consumption. In addition, in the break areas of the residences, you will find vending machines selling sweet and savory snacks, coffee machines, and even vending machines selling personal care products. All residences have a laundry area with automatic washing machines and dryers. Each wash and dry cycle is subject to a fee, based on the rates displayed in the laundry rooms of each residence. Ironing boards and irons are not provided. All Bocconi Residences offer a 24-hour reception desk service. After checking in and settling into your accommodation, you can also receive mail at the reception. The common areas of the apartments, bathrooms, and bedrooms are cleaned once a week. The

Submitting the request will allow the residence management to intervene promptly to resolve the problem you have encountered, replacing any defective parts or carrying out all necessary checks with the relevant technicians. Please note that the residence management and Bocconi University staff will be able to access your accommodation even in your absence in case of necessity or urgency. All utilities (electricity, heating/air conditioning, water) are included in the accommodation fee, as is WiFi connection, which is guaranteed in all common areas and rooms. Please refer to Article 16 of the Residence Regulations and the Addendum for some important notes on the use of the connection. Bocconi University is committed to ensuring the health and safety of all its students, both on campus and in its residences, in order to prevent accidents and minimize all risks associated with university life. In order to live in the residences, it is essential to be aware of the potential risks that may arise from the improper use of the facilities and equipment provided in the building or owned by guests. The cooperation of all guests is essential to prevent dangers arising from improper behavior (inappropriate use of kitchens, use of electrical appliances or tools that are not provided and are potentially dangerous, smoking outside of designated areas). It's up to you to do your part too! ♻️ **Separate waste collection** In your room, apartment, and common areas, remember to separate your waste: - Organic → brown - Paper/cardboard → white - Glass → green - Plastic/metal → yellow - Non-recyclable → black If you have any doubts, take a look at the **AMSA** website: it will only take you 2 minutes. 👉 NB: PCs, smartphones, and small appliances do NOT go in unsorted waste: take them to collection points (recycling centers or CAM). 🚫 **Less plastic and paper** - Use the water fountain in the Residence instead of plastic bottles. - Only print if really necessary. - Choose recycled materials. ⚡ **Be mindful of consumption** - Turn off lights when not in use. - Do not leave windows open with the heating/AC on. - Do not waste water. 🏠 **Respect the spaces (they are your home!)** - Dispose of waste in the correct bins. - Clean and tidy up after using the common areas. - Do not throw food in the sink. - Keep your room tidy. - Do not damage furniture or rooms: other students will be here after you! ❗ **Important** If the accommodation is found to be in **poor condition**, the management may: - Charge you for **extra cleaning**; - Give you an **official warning**; - In serious cases → **expulsion** from the Residence, loss of deposit, and referral to the Disciplinary Committee. The temperature control system in university residences is set in accordance with municipal ordinances governing the correct temperatures to be maintained in buildings, as well as the maximum number of hours allowed for the operation of the systems, with the aim of reducing energy consumption and limiting environmental impact. The system operates according to a technical protocol implemented in 2017, which regulates the activation of air conditioning systems using standardized parameters, in particular: for heating, a set point of 19 degrees Celsius is set, which is the temperature indicated as compliant by the Municipality of Milan, with a margin of tolerance of 1-2 degrees. The activation of air conditioning depends on the outside temperature, which must reach at least 26 degrees Celsius and ONLY if the window is closed (when the window is open, the system switches off automatically). The system operates during specific time slots, which are shared with guests by the manager of each residence and updated seasonally. Any malfunction of the systems must be reported promptly using the dedicated QR code: in this way, technicians will immediately check for any faults or the need to replace spare parts in the individual appliances in the rooms (fan coils), or they will be able to carry out all the necessary checks in the event of centralized problems. The perception of heat/cold is entirely personal, but the settings applied are certainly suitable to ensure everyone's thermal comfort. Bocconi is confident that it can count on the sensitivity of all members of its community to protect environmental sustainability. Bocconi University has accommodation in each residence designed to accommodate students with disabilities, offering them the opportunity to enjoy their university experience in a communal setting that meets their needs. Students with disabilities who have special accommodation requirements can contact the Fees, Funding and Housing Office, which will work with each student to assess the most suitable accommodation for their specific needs. All issues reported and documentation provided will be treated confidentially and subject to current privacy regulations. In order for the Office to be able to meet the requests received, it is advisable to specify the needs in advance. Interested students are therefore advised to contact the Fees, Funding and Housing Office before submitting their accommodation application. text: Applying to Bocconi [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi) Bachelor and Law Programs [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs) # Open reservation - recovery session a.y 2025-26 In order to satisfy all the need of students of the Right to University, according to the housing application timeline for a.y. 2025-26, a new "recovery" session of Open reservation has been introduced. This session will allow students who will result eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2025-26 during the autumn 2025 to request the housing rate change with respect to the rate already applied for a.y. 2025-26 (if already assignees of a room at full rate) or to request a housing new admission at preferential rate for a.y. 2025-26 (if not yet assignees of a room). | | | --- | | Only students who will result eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2025-26 will be entitled to participate to the Open reservation — recovery session (preferential rate) | By participating to the Open reservation — recovery session, one of the following requests may be submitted: **1\. Housing rate change for a.y. 2025-26** This request may be submitted only by students who: - are assignees of a room at full rate for a.y. 2025-26 (in any previous assignment session); - resulted eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2025-26. In case the request will be accepted: - the preferential rate will be applied starting from the second housing installment and there will be no adjustment of the first housing installment already paid; - the rate change will be applied only if the student who is requesting it will be eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2025-26; - the rate change will be applied only if the room occupied by the student for a.y. 2025-26 is one of the room types available also at preferential rate. It is specified that the rate change will be subject to availability of rooms that can be assigned at preferential rate possibly left after all the previous preferential rate applications, or after the "Renunciation/ Withdrawal" period, and always up to the number of rooms defined in the Housing Application Requirements and Regulations a.y. 2025-26. **2\. Preferential rate new admission housing application for a.y. 2025-26** This request may be submitted only by students who: - are NOT assignees of a room at full rate for a.y. 2025-26 - resulted eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2025-26 The housing assignment, valid from January 2026, will be subject to availability of rooms that can be assigned at preferential rate and up to the number of rooms defined in the Housing Application Requirements and Regulations a.y. 2025-26. For these room assignments, all the preferential rate rooms possibly left after all the previous preferential rate applications (included the housing rate change requests) or after the "Renunciation/ Withdrawal" period, will be used. In the event that the number of applicants will exceed the number of rooms available, the room assignments will happen by giving priority to: - non resident students - 1st year students - increasing amount of the

This session will allow students who will result eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2026-27 during the autumn 2026 to request the housing rate change with respect to the rate already applied for a.y. 2026-27 (if already assignees of a room at full rate) or to request a housing new admission at preferential rate for a.y. 2026-27 (if not yet assignees of a room). | | | --- | | **Only students who will result eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2026-27 will be entitled to participate to the Open reservation — recovery session (preferential rate)** | By participating to the Open reservation — recovery session, one of the following requests may be submitted: **1\. Housing rate change for a.y. 2026-27** This request may be submitted only by students who: - are assignees of a room at full rate for a.y. 2026-27 (in any previous assignment session); - resulted eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2026-27. In case the request will be accepted: - the preferential rate will be applied starting from the second housing installment and there will be no adjustment of the first housing installment already paid; - the rate change will be applied only if the student who is requesting it will be eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2026-27; - the rate change will be applied only if the room occupied by the student for a.y. 2026-27 is one of the room types available also at preferential rate. It is specified that the rate change will be subject to availability of rooms that can be assigned at preferential rate possibly left after all the previous preferential rate applications, or after the "Renunciation/ Withdrawal" period, and always up to the number of rooms defined in the Housing Application Requirements and Regulations a.y. 2026-27. **2\. Preferential rate new admission housing application for a.y. 2026-27** This request may be submitted only by students who: - are NOT assignees of a room at full rate for a.y. 2026-27 - resulted eligible for the ISU Bocconi Scholarship a.y. 2026-27 The housing assignment, valid from January 2027, will be subject to availability of rooms that can be assigned at preferential rate and up to the number of rooms defined in the Housing Application Requirements and Regulations a.y. 2026-27. For these room assignments, all the preferential rate rooms possibly left after all the previous preferential rate applications (included the housing rate change requests) or after the "Renunciation/ Withdrawal" period, will be used. In the event that the number of applicants will exceed the number of rooms available, the room assignments will happen by giving priority to: - non resident students - 1st year students

For the preferential rate, 3 different fee levels based on the ISU brackets (1st, 2nd and 3rd ISU bracket) are foreseen, depending on the values indicated on the ISEE/ISEEU Parificato Certificate submitted at the moment of the application. For all other students the full rate is applied. On this webpage, all the details about requirements, methods and deadlines of application, results and requirements needed to use the accommodation are explained. Before applying, be sure to carefully read the contents of paragraphs 1-9 on this page. You can access the application you are interested in through the boxes at the top of the page; links will be available during the application period. Bocconi University is not responsible for goods left in the apartment/room after check-out._ Attention: rooms are reassigned to Summer School students during the summer, so it is not possible to leave anything inside your room or apartment. **Any issues related to missing or deteriorated items during the summer, a period when the room is not assigned, cannot be considered** by Bocconi University or the residence management. If necessary, we suggest you consider luggage storage services that are very common in Milan, such as Boxok, Redbox Storage, Radical Storage, and Casaforte Milano. Regarding stays during extraordinary opening periods (Winter break 2026 and July 2027), a separate request will be necessary (information available soon). 9\. Students with disabilities Bocconi University has accommodations in each residence hall that are designed to accommodate students with disabilities in order to offer them the possibility to easily live their university experience in a collective context that meets their needs. Students with disabilities who require special housing needs may contact the Office of Fees, Funding and Housing, which will evaluate, with each student, which housing is best suited to their specific needs. All reported issues and provided documentation will be treated confidentially and subject to applicable privacy regulations. In order for the Office to be able to satisfy the requests received, it is best to clarify your needs in advance. Interested students are advised to contact the Fees, Funding and Housing Office before submitting their housing application. The partner facilities Aparto Giovenale and Olympic Village follow specific regulations and policies shared by their respective managers._ #### **Renunciation** It is possible to renounce from the housing assignment exclusively for expected academic reasons and only within the time windows detailed below. **Renunciation from June 3-7, 2026 – only for students who:** Have received confirmation of departure for exchange or internship for a.y. 2026-27. **The application will be immediately accepted and the room assigned for 2026-27 will be cancelled.** The office will verify afterwards with the competent offices the truthfulness of the statement, in case of substantiated statements the security deposit will be refunded and the student will not be burdened with penalties or further payments. **Please note: In case of declarations NOT substantiated by the specific academic reasons provided for the acceptance of the renunciation request, the student will not be refunded the security deposit, will still have the obligation to pay one month's fees and will also be subject to the payment of 200 euros for administrative management charges**. Please note: Students who fall under the categories for subsequent windows (e.g., lack of credits or withdrawal from studies) and are already certain they want to give up their accommodation can also submit a withdrawal request during this window. **Renunciation from June 15-21, 2026** **– only for students enrolled in a Bachelor or Master’s program who:** a) Have realized that they will not achieve the credits required for the merit requirement by 10 August, 2026; b) Withdraw from their studies or transfer to another university; c) They are Bachelor students and, despite having participated in the selections for admission to a Master’s program for the a.y. 2026-27, were not admitted. Please note: Bachelor students who are guests at a preferential rate and are not admitted to a Master’s program, but will enroll in the first year fuori corso, will not be able to submit a renunciation request. **The application will be immediately accepted and the room assigned for 2026-27 will be cancelled.** The office will verify afterwards with the competent offices the truthfulness of the statement, in case of substantiated statements the security deposit will be refunded and the student will not be burdened with penalties or further payments. **Please note: In case of declarations NOT substantiated by the specific academic reasons provided for the acceptance of the renunciation request, the student will not be refunded the security deposit, will still have the obligation to pay one month's fees and will also be subject to the payment of 200 euros for administrative management charges**. **Renunciation from July 6-12, 2026 - only for students with exams taken after the previous renunciation window deadline:** Have realized that they will not achieve the credits required for the merit requirement by 10 August, 2026. **The application will be immediately accepted and the

In this case, the deadline for submitting the withdrawal request will be communicated to you in the result of the Open reservation - recovery session.
