text: Programs Master of Science [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science-programs) # Study Abroad Programs Explore the Program [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science/international-management) [Study Plan](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science/international-management/study-plan) [IM Global Experience](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science/international-management/im-global-experience) [IM Concentrations](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science/international-management/im-concentrations) [IM CEMS MIM](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science/international-management/im-cems-mim) [IM Asia - China MIM](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science/international-management/im-asia-china-mim) [IM Asia - ESSEC-Bocconi Double [IM Concentration – DD ESSEC Luxury Study Abroad Programs [Program Placement](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/master-science/international-management/program-placement) The MSc in International Management offers students different study abroad options, both for short periods (such as Exchange programs) and for longer periods (Double Degree and special programs). **Some of these options can be chosen after enrollment, while others have to be selected at the time of application.** The special programs that must be **selected during your online application** are the following: - **IM CEMS MIM** is recognized as a one-of-a-kind global community, founded in 1988, bringing together the world’s best students, schools, alumni, and corporate and social partners. Admitted students will spend their first year at Bocconi University and one semester of their sophomore year at one of the premier universities in the **CEMS alliance** (33 schools across 6 continents). - **IM Asia - China MIM** is a Double Degree program with Fudan University, one of the top universities in Asia. Students attending this program will study at the Bocconi Milan campus in Italy during the first year and at the Fudan Shanghai campus in China in the second year. They will have the chance to live and study in one of the world’s most influential and rapidly evolving countries. Students will deepen their understanding of China and the global economy, acquiring the expertise and insights needed to start an international career. - **IM Asia - DD ESSEC** is a Double Degree program with ESSEC Business School, offering students the incredible opportunity to study at three different locations: the ESSEC Cergy campus in France, the ESSEC Singapore campus, and the Bocconi Milan campus in Italy. This unique format provides a comprehensive understanding of both Europe and Asia, allowing students to explore economic, political and management issues from diverse global perspectives. In addition to a rich mix of courses and internships, participants will gain valuable research experience while working on their thesis. - **IM Concentration - DD ESSEC Luxury Management** is a Double Degree program with ESSEC Business School, offering a global outlook on luxury management. Students start their journey in Milan — Italy’s fashion and design capital — then learn more about luxury business at ESSEC’s dynamic campus near Paris. Participants in the program will gain global exposure, hands-on experience and a powerful network to launch their careers in one of the most exciting industries in the world. _Exchange Programs_ If you are attending IM Global Experience and IM Concentrations you have the opportunity to participate in an Exchange program, which will allow you to study abroad for one term at a top partner university. title: Info and Applying | Bocconi University
text:
Programs Summer School [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/summer-school) # Info and Applying [MyApplication](https://admissions.unibocconi.it/admissions?cod_lingua=eng) Bocconi Summer School for Bachelor Students will be held from **June 29** to **July 17**, **2026\.** Please find below all the information to apply. How to Apply Bocconi Summer School offers a three-week study program open to motivated **students enrolled in a Bachelor program**. The summer school is dedicated to **students from Italian and non-Italian Universities** (it is not open to Bocconi students). In order to apply, candidates must fill out the **online application** through the My Application portal (applications must include the most recent university transcript in English. If a transcript is unavailable, a certificate of enrollment will suffice). Applicants are asked to **select their desired course, proceed to the payment section and submit their application** to secure their spot. Spots may fill up quickly. After this step, course changes will not be accepted. Application Timeline **Applications for Bocconi Summer School 2026 are now open.** NEW DEADLINE: Applications will close on **May 7** ( **6 p.m. Italian time**). Spots may fill up quickly, it is strongly recommended to apply as soon as possible to secure the participation. Course Structure Each course consists of **48 hours.** The sessions include: - **teaching activities** running from **Monday to Friday,** usually **between 9:30am and 12:30pm** - **company visits** In addition to the above activities, students will be required to complete individual/class assignments and will have the possibility to take part in **extracurricular activities**, which will take place outside of the time reserved for the academic activities. Students fulfilling attendance requirements will receive a digital certificate attesting their participation in the course. Important: students who are also interested in earning **6 credits\*** are required to sit a **final exam (on the last day)** on campus in Milan. \*in accordance with the ECTS - European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System - on average 1 credit point corresponds to 25 hours of work for student; about 8 hours (but no more than 10) are spent in the classroom. Sample schedule | | | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | | **9:30am - 12:30pm** | Lecture | Lecture | Lecture | Company Visit | Lecture | | **12:30pm - 2:00pm** | Lunch break | Lunch break | Lunch break | Lunch break | Lunch break | | **2:00pm - 5:00pm** | Lecture | Group work | Group work | Lecture | Group work | Participation Fee The Summer School participation fee **includes** the following: - academic program (including guest speakers testimonies) and access to materials (for the duration of the program) - one company visit - extracurricular activities - official certificate (electronic format) - transportation card The Summer School participation fee **does not include** the following: - accomodation - meals - airport pick-up - visa support | Fee structure | | | --- | --- | | **Regular fee** | €2,700 | | **Reduced fee**

Fee The Summer School participation fee **includes** the following: - academic program (including guest speakers testimonies) and access to materials (for the duration of the program) - one company visit - extracurricular activities - official certificate (electronic format) - transportation card The Summer School participation fee **does not include** the following: - accomodation - meals - airport pick-up - visa support | Fee structure | | | --- | --- | | **Regular fee** | €2,700 | | **Reduced fee**
Students enrolled in a program at:
\- a Bocconi partner university/school (see list [here](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/international-network/partner-schools))
\- a university/school part of the ELFA network (see list [here](https://elfa-edu.org/elfa-members/)) | €2,500 | | | **Refund policy** A refund of the participation fee will only be granted in cases of **force majeure** **and supported by official documentation**(e.g., visa rejection letter, medical certificate). Each request will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis by the Summer School Committee. In such cases, an **administrative fee of €350** will be retained by Bocconi. No refunds will be provided for other reasons. Housing Summer School participants will have the possibility to be accommodated at **Aparto Residence Giovenale**, in front of the campus ( **limited availability**). Students interested in reserving a room will be required to fill out a separate application. **More information are available** [**here**](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/applying-bocconi/bachelor-and-law-programs/housing/summer-school-2026-housing) **.** Visa Obtaining a visa for Italy is a **responsibility of students** and Bocconi recommends starting the process as soon as possible. Students unsure whether they need a visa or where to find more information can take a quick **survey** [here](https://vistoperitalia.esteri.it/?lang=en_US) (when selecting the "Reason for your stay," please choose "Study - UNIVERSITY SINGLE COURSE"). For visa applications, students should contact their local Italian Embassy or Consulate. Bocconi provides an **official letter of acceptance** **to the program**, which can be used as part of the visa application process. This document can be downloaded directly from the admission portal once the application has been successfully submitted. ### Contact Us - [Contact us](https://bit.unibocconi.it/hc/en-us/p/212943827889373?language=en) [More…](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/summer-school/bachelor-students/info-and-applying#addtoany "Show all")

title: Health and Safety | Bocconi University
text: Programs Summer School [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/summer-school) # Health and Safety _Please find below useful information on security and safety measures for your staying during our Summer School programs._ International SOS Bocconi has partnered with **International SOS** to offer medical, safety and security advice to its international students coming here on campus. International SOS - **that is not an insurance company and does not replace personal medical insurance** \- provides Bocconi students with quality health care and **medical** and **security advice** services worldwide 24/7. Services are designed to help with medical, personal, travel, security, logistical and legal problems that may arise when away from home. International SOS services include **advice** on health and security issues as well as **assistance** in case of medical or security emergency. Through the International SOS Assistance App you will be able to contact the Assistance Centre, read Italy country guide and receive notifications. **Please check your e-mail for further details on how to activate and use International SOS.** Control Room On the Bocconi Campus, a system of prevention and security is in place to respond to any emergencies that may occur. The Control Room monitors the security of our Campus on a daily basis. Two professional operators are in charge of presiding **the Room 24 hours a day, 7 days a week** controlling the most crowded spaces in our Campus as well as the most hidden ones through **96 screens** and approximately **500 AI-powered cameras and the SOS Alarm Columns**, which are placed in several areas of the University buildings. The room is also constantly connected with the police forces and health emergency enforcement in case of emergency. Emergency Number - 02.5836.2121 The Emergency Number **02.5836.2121** is available on campus for anyone who detects a dangerous situation or an emergency within the Bocconi Campus. According to the specific needs, the operators in the Control Room, who will promptly get in touch with the occupational safety workers, police forces and medical supplies (including the ambulance which is always on Campus), will answer. **Reported details should be as clear and complete as possible, to allow operators and emergency teams to intervene promptly.** The single emergency number **can also be called through the SOS Alarm Columns** widespread on Campus. First Aid on Campus An ambulance and two paramedics are present on campus from **Monday to Friday** **from 9:30am to 6:00pm** to ensure immediate availability of an ambulance for transport to the nearest Hospital, along with the support of specialized personnel for the management of illnesses and other health emergencies. The service can be activated **through the internal emergency management number +39 025836 2121.** Read the paragraph "On Campus Medical Center" for all further info on the services available on campus. On Campus Medical Assistance Bocconi University has set up an on-campus **medical center**, a clinic on the mezzanine floor of the Piazza Sraffa 11 building to meet the needs of non-residents in Milan. **The doctor is available from Monday to Friday from 9:00am to 6:00pm.** The Medical Center is a first-level

You will receive an e-mail with the meeting time. **Lectures and group work** **Monday 6 July, afternoon** The first lecture will take place on the first day, after lunch. text: Programs Summer School [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/summer-school) # How to get to Bocconi and beyond #### **How to reach the Bocconi Campus** From an airport If you arrive in Milan by plane, you are going to land at one of the following airports: Malpensa International Airport, Linate Airport or Orio Al Serio International Airport. Several services (public and private) connect Milan's city center with these airports. _**From Malpensa Airport (T1 and T2)**_ Airport Code: MXP Distance from city center: 45Km **Taxi:** it takes about 50 minutes and it costs around € 100 (fixed rate). For all further information on taxi please see the section below. **Malpensa Express (train) + public transport:** it takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes. Malpensa airport is easily connected to downtown Milan through the [Malpensa Express Train](https://www.malpensaexpress.it/en/) (13€ single ride): you can choose to get off either at the Central Station or at Cadorna Station. For all further information on public transport see the section below. - If you take the train to the Central Station ("Centrale F.S."), from there you can take the metro (yellow line – direction "San Donato") to "Duomo" (4 stops). Then, go to the stop "Duomo" of tram n.15. Take tram n.15 in the "Rozzano" direction and get off at the stop "Porta Ludovica" (4 stops). - If you take the train to Cadorna Station, from there you can take the metro (red line - direction "Sesto 1 Maggio FS") to "Duomo" (3 stops). Then, go to the stop "Duomo" of tram n.15. Take tram n.15 in the "Rozzano" direction and get off at the stop "Porta Ludovica" (4 stops). **Malpensa Shuttle (bus) + public transport**: it takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes. For all further information on public transport see the section below. As an alternative to the Malpensa Express train, you can take the [Malpensa Shuttle](https://www.malpensashuttle.it/). The ticket costs around €10. From Central Station ("Centrale F.S.") you can take the metro (yellow line –direction "San Donato") and get off at "Duomo" (4 stops). From there you can go to the stop "Duomo" of tram n.15. Take tram n.15 in the "Rozzano" direction and get off at the stop "Porta Ludovica" (4 stops). _**From Linate Airport**_ Airport Code: LIN Distance from city center: 7Km **Taxi:** it takes about 20 minutes and costs approximately € 15. You can **pay directly with your credit card at any metro station or on the bus/tram**. As an alternative, you can be buy a rechargeable card at any tobacconist or newsstand shop, or at the vending machines at every underground station. The ticket must be stamped at the start of every journey and is valid for 90 minutes after stamping. Tickets are available also online through the ATM app, or by sending an SMS with the message "ATM" to the number 48444. Please refer to [www.atm.it/en](https://www.atm.it/en) for all further information as well as for any possible updates on metro and bus lines. Taxi Outside every airport or station there is an area reserved for taxis. Taxis in Italy are white cars with a sign saying "TAXI" on top. If you decide to take a taxi, make sure to take an official one. Do not agree to a ride with any other driver who may approach you. It is also possible to book official Milan's Taxi from these Apps: appTaxi; free now; itTaxi; WeTaxi; TaxiMilano; inTaxi. text: Programs Summer School [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/summer-school) # Summer School for Bachelor Students [Info and Applying](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/summer-school/bachelor-students/info-and-applying) [MyApplication](https://admissions.unibocconi.it/admissions) **Applications for Bocconi Summer School 2026 are now open.** Bocconi Summer School for Bachelor Students will be held from **June 29** to **July 17**, **2026\.** Study leading-edge subjects taught by faculty members of a top European University. Choose the program that is right for you and plan your next learning experience in Milan. Watch the highlights from old editions and get ready for your Summer in Milan! _Explore all our courses and take the next step to a new learning experience!_ ### Make Your Summer Matter Watch video #### On campus courses Digital Marketing **Prof. Cristian Chizzoli, Armando Cirrincione** This course describes the growing relevance of digital marketing in the competitive arena, both for customers and firms. The contents aim at educating participants on how innovative digital tools (Internet, smartphones, etc.) and methods (such as SEO, SEM, content marketing, social media marketing, emailing, marketing automation, etc.) are revolutionizing the world of marketing, often determining the strategies implemented by global players to develop products, to persuade customers, to distribute items effectively and to price them correctly. The course will focus on the potential that all electronic media have and the most important keys to success as well as on the challenges faced. Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management **Prof. Carlo Salvato** This course provides real world, experience-based learning on what it’s like to actually start and develop a new venture, either within an existing company, or as a new startup company. The main objective is to allow you to directly experience the earliest phases of an entrepreneurial startup process. Focus will thus be on building and testing a novel business idea. In this course you will be asked to actively engage in developing the initial business idea, but also in talking to potential customers, suppliers, partners, and competitors, as you confront the chaos and uncertainty of how a real new venture actually emerges from the entrepreneurs’ efforts. Equity and Venture Capital Financing **Prof. Gimede Gigante, Matteo Arpe** Discover all the key factors in value creation by private equity and venture capital firms, taking a close look at management issues, business models and investment opportunities. Bocconi Summer School for High School Students will be held from **July 6** to **July 17**, **2026**. Communication and Advertising - sold out **Prof. Arianna Brioschi, Prof. Stefano Prestini, Prof. Elena Bellio** Just how familiar are you with an advertising campaign? A business may live or die based on its ability to communicate successfully. Through this lab you will understand the most important issues when planning and evaluating marketing communications and executions. You will have the chance to meet with some of the best in class in the advertising industry and take a peek at what happens behind the scenes of a communication campaign. Computer Coding - sold out **Prof. Massimo Ballerini** In recent times, coding has emerged as a primary skill not only for IT specialists, but also for managers, professionals and researchers in a wide spectrum of fields. Learning the basics of programming is therefore a valuable chance to develop a new approach to work and technologies. This lab explores the basics and the logic of programming using Python, one of the most widely used programming languages. Data Science - sold out **Prof. Omiros Papaspiliopoulos, Prof. Pieralberto Guarniero** The laboratory will introduce participants to some fundamental ideas in Data Science with the primary goal to develop and understand sufficiently well some core methodologies in order to apply them to some really cool current applications, ranging from visualizing complex data to understanding criminal networks. The laboratory will start with a lecture dealing on the fundamentals of Data Science and a discussion of the relation between predictive modelling and causal inference. Digital Marketing - sold out **Prof. Deborah Raccagni, Prof. Laura Colm** The lab focuses on a theoretical rather than a technical understanding of e-marketing and the digital environment, adopting a customer journey approach to explore the main practices and exploit tools and techniques that can be used to this purpose. Il laboratorio fornirà un'ampia panoramica delle implicazioni legali delle nuove tecnologie e di come l'attuale quadro giuridico stia affrontando le sfide che esse presentano. Scopri di più sulla Bocconi Summer School in Law [cliccando qui](https://www.unibocconi.it/it/corsi-di-studio/giurisprudenza/summer-school-law "Summer School in Law")! Management of Entertainment (NEW) - sold out **Prof. Simone Autera** Movies, TV series, games, live shows, songs, reels, memes — entertainment content travels fast, shapes identities, and fuels global culture. Across the entertainment industries, content is more than “fun”: it is an economic asset that behaves differently from traditional goods. Why do some releases spark global conversations while others disappear into the endless scroll? What happens behind the scenes to turn creative content into something that captures attention instead of getting lost in the dark? To explore these broader entertainment dynamics in a concrete and hands-on way, the course will focus on the music industry as its primary laboratory. In a world of digital convergence, music no longer lives in one format or one channel. Artists move between TikTok, Spotify, live shows, gaming spaces, and social media ecosystems, competing in an intense attention economy where visibility is scarce and algorithms shape discovery. Students will analyse how strategy adapts to new consumption patterns, platform logics, and the growing power of fandoms. The lab includes a group project where participants become label managers responsible for launching a new single by their favourite artist. Curiosity about entertainment and global culture is essential. This course invites students to look beyond the ‘playlist’ and understand the strategic thinking that makes content a ‘big hit’. Strategy - sold out **Prof. Charles Williams, Silvia Zamboni** Why do some companies succeed while others fail? How does strategy contribute to success? What is strategy? How do we identify and describe a firm’s strategy? This course will equip you with the concepts, tools, and skills required to formulate and implement strategy across a range of business contexts — from a single-business firm to a multiproduct, multinational corporation. Our emphasis will be on applying the tools of competitive strategy analysis to real business situations through case studies, examples, and our own experiences. #### Are you an Italian student with a passion for law? text: Programs Summer School [Overview](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/summer-school) # Info and Applying The Summer School in Law for University Students is part of the Summer School for Bachelor Students. Students interested in joining this course are required to apply through MyApplication portal, selecting the program "Summer School for Bachelor Students" and then choosing the course in Law. [MyApplication](https://admissions.unibocconi.it/admissions?cod_lingua=eng) Bocconi Summer School for Bachelor Students will be held from **June 29** to **July 17**, **2026\.** Please find below all the information to apply. How to Apply Bocconi Summer School offers a three-week study program open to motivated **students enrolled in a Bachelor program**. The summer school is dedicated to **students from Italian and non-Italian Universities** (it is not open to Bocconi students). In order to apply, candidates must fill out the **online application** through the My Application portal (applications must include the most recent university transcript in English. If a transcript is unavailable, a certificate of enrollment will suffice). Applicants are asked to **select their desired course, proceed to the payment section and submit their application** to secure their spot. Spots may fill up quickly. After this step, course changes will not be accepted. Application Timeline **Applications for Bocconi Summer School 2026 are now open.** NEW DEADLINE: Applications will close on **May 7** ( **6 p.m. Italian time**). Spots may fill up quickly, it is strongly recommended to apply as soon as possible to secure the participation. Course Structure Each course consists of **48 hours.** The sessions include: - **teaching activities** running from **Monday to Friday,** usually **between 9:30am and 12:30pm** - **company visits** In addition to the above activities, students will be required to complete individual/class assignments and will have the possibility to take part in **extracurricular activities**, which will take place outside of the time reserved for the academic activities. Students fulfilling attendance requirements will receive a digital certificate attesting their participation in the course. Important: students who are also interested in earning **6 credits\*** are required to sit a **final exam (on the last day)** on campus in Milan. \*in accordance with the ECTS - European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System - on average 1 credit point corresponds to 25 hours of work for student; about 8 hours (but no more than 10) are spent in the classroom. The topic of sustainability will be examined as a new model for integrating the ethical and aesthetical dimension with the economic one, for the creation of a new competitive advantage. Digital technologies are essential enablers for the sustainable and circular transition: AI and IoT, blockchain, recycling technologies, waste management platforms, Digital Product Passports and 3D printing are just some examples of leading technologies which will be presented during the course. Students will be engaged during the course through individual and team assignments, in-class discussions and company visits. By the end of the course, students will be able to understand the strategic and financial rationale of a deal, carry out a financial analysis of the parties involved in the transaction, understand how to value a potential target, and understand how to finance an acquisition. The course offers the training needed to participate in the valuation and structuring of acquisitions, divestitures and complex equity financings. In pursuit of this mission, this course focuses on different relevant issues (fiscal, legal, financial and managerial) through the extended use of guest speakers and case studies. The course is useful for students who are considering careers in investment banking, management and strategy consulting. text: ## Page 1 Bocconi # EXCHANGE PROGRAM 2024-25 Undergraduate School Università Bocconi MILANO ## Page 2 1. Before applying to the Exchange program, you are required to **carefully read** the following documents: - ☑ Bocconi Students TRAVEL RISK POLICY Available on yoU@B – International SOS - ☑ Guide to the Exchange Program Available on our website More specifically, among others, we invite you to take note of the following: - ☑ Preparing for Travel (par.2 - Bocconi Students TRAVEL RISK POLICY) - ☑ Accommodation information (par.1 - Guide to the Exchange Program) - ☑ Recognition of exams taken abroad (par. 6 - Guide to the Exchange Program) 2. Please also note that: - ☑ This brochure has been released in **February 2024** and reflects the current situation to date. Slots available and teaching methods (physical, blended, online) at Partner Universities **may be subject to change**. - ☑ During their participation in the Exchange Program, students **must comply with** the rules, regulations, and codes of conduct established by the Host Institution. - ☑ Additionally, **students are responsible for covering living expenses**, including rent, food, healthcare, recreation, travel and transportation, health insurance, textbooks, school supplies, visa documents, and other related costs. - ☑ Exchange Students **can enroll in** courses offered by the Host Institution, provided that these courses are not exclusively reserved for local students. Additionally, it's important to note -when planning studies at Bocconi and abroad- that **enrollment in specific courses at the host institution is never guaranteed** and depends on various factors, such as meeting prerequisites, seat availability, etc. - ☑ Concerning slots available, requirements, and restrictions, only the information contained in this list will be applied to the **current selection** of the Exchange Program. - ☑ In light of the general uncertainty and fluidity of the global situation, whether the overall conditions would not safeguard the well-being and security of students Bocconi University does not guarantee that students will be able to take part in the Exchange semester. Moreover, travel and medical risks can rapidly change and lead Bocconi University and host Institutions or Countries to increase travel and medical restrictions. Therefore, **the Exchange Program can be canceled**. - ☑ International students or students with **dual citizenship** cannot apply for some Schools in the countries for which they hold current citizenship. Carefully check the note section for each destination. More information Università Bocconi MELANO ## Page 3 Timeline # CEMS semester abroad ## TIMELINE - From 1st to 7th March: apply online during the application period through www.cems.org/selection registering your personal data and ranking the whole list of CEMS universities. - By the end of March the final allocation will be published on the CEMS Restricted Area on Bocconi website. Università Bocconi MILANO ## Page 4 Allocation # CEMS semester abroad ## RANKING – RULES OF THE GAME - Please indicate the preferred destinations and preferred term and what is your **priority** between destination and term. Ranking of the destinations and priority expressed for the term or for the destination will be taken into consideration when working on the final allocation. - Check on the **CEMS Restricted Area** all the destinations specificities are available (Nationality requirements, Home School degree requirement, language requirements). 4 Università Bocconi MILANO ## Page 5 Allocation # CEMS semester abroad ## RANKING – RULES OF THE GAME - The final allocation will take into consideration the average weighted on credits, according to the following formula: Student academic weighted credit average (WA) * [Number of credits earned (NC) divided by the maximum number of credits that can be earned (MAX NC)]. - The calculation of credits includes all the exams of the 1st semester of the 1st Master of Science year (study plan officially taken by February 4th, 2023 included, end of the ordinary exam session). Exams that are not part of the 1st semester of the 1st Master of Science year study plan (internship, languages, anticipated exams and anticipated curricular supplementary activities) are not included. - Courses subdivided into modules: the credit points and the grades earned for the single modules passed will be taken into account and they can be viewed by printing the unofficial academic transcript at the Punto Blu. title: Bocconi Graduate Merit Awards a.y. 2026-27
text: # Bocconi Graduate Merit Awards a.y. 2026-27 The Bocconi Graduate Merit Award for first-year MSc applicants in a.y. 2026-27 is a **100% waiver on Bocconi ordinary academic tuition and fees**. The award format is a **full tuition and fees waiver**. The page does not describe the standard Graduate Merit Award as a cash stipend. Key rules: - Merit Awards are for first-year Graduate applicants for the 2026-2027 academic year. - Candidates are considered based on the admission application submitted to Bocconi; a separate application is not required. - The award is based primarily on academic achievement, with the full admissions dossier also evaluated. - Award assignment is communicated together with admission results. - Awarded students must complete the online scholarship acceptance procedure within the enrollment deadline. - The award can be renewed for the legal duration of the regular course of study if enrollment and merit requirements are met. - For second-year renewal, the page states that awardees must earn at least 50 credits by 10 September 2027.

title: ATM urban travel pass fares for Milan
text: # ATM urban travel pass fares for Milan ATM urban passes cover travel within the Municipality of Milan on ATM urban transport and the city sections of Trenord and S lines. For Milan urban passes: - Young people under 27 can buy an annual urban pass for **EUR 200**. - Young people under 27 can buy a monthly urban pass for **EUR 22**. - The ordinary adult annual urban pass costs **EUR 330**. - The ordinary adult monthly urban pass costs **EUR 39**. The under-27 annual urban pass is therefore **EUR 130 cheaper** than the ordinary annual urban pass. Relative to the ordinary EUR 330 annual fare, the under-27 EUR 200 annual fare is about **39% cheaper**.
